# Task-type: code-review-adversarial

Anchor: `.hopper/tasks/code-review-adversarial.md::root`

## Purpose

Independently review a change, hunting for defects the author would miss. Review only — no edits.

## Input shape

- The task spec section from `.hopper/handoffs/leader-tasklist.md` (matched by task ID)
- Acceptance criteria (prefer machine-checkable: a runnable command or grep per criterion)
- Positive scope (files allowed) and negative scope (files that must not change)
- Budget: time and vendor-cost ceiling

## Output shape (output.md)

The output should contain, in this order:

- **Summary**: what was delivered, in two to four sentences
- **Files touched**: paths with a one-line rationale each (or "none")
- **Acceptance verification (N/N)**: each criterion with evidence (command output, file:line, grep match)
- **Decisions / deviations**: judgment calls or scope changes (or "none")
- **Open questions**: list, or "none"
- **Verdict**: PASS | PASS_WITH_NOTE | REWORK | FAIL
- **Next recommendation**: what should happen next

## Notes

This frame describes the SHAPE of the work and the expected output, not an
identity to adopt. The vendor CLI brings its own behavior; the frame only states
what the protocol expects back.

   135	  return (update: InternalSessionTranscriptUpdate): void => {
   136	    // Preserve transcript update order even when counting messages requires an
   137	    // async read from the session file.
   138	    broadcastQueue = broadcastQueue

   140	      .catch(() => undefined);

   143	
   144	async function handleTranscriptUpdateBroadcast(
   145	  params: {
   146	    broadcastToConnIds: GatewayBroadcastToConnIdsFn;
   147	    sessionEventSubscribers: SessionEventSubscribers;
   148	    sessionMessageSubscribers: SessionMessageSubscribers;
   149	    chatAbortControllers: Map<string, ChatAbortControllerEntry>;
   150	  },
   151	  update: InternalSessionTranscriptUpdate,
   152	): Promise<void> {
   153	  const sqliteMarker = parseSqliteSessionFileMarker(update.sessionFile);
   154	  const storageAgentId = update.target?.agentId ?? update.agentId ?? sqliteMarker?.agentId;
   155	  const sessionKey =
   156	    update.target?.sessionKey ??
   157	    update.sessionKey ??
   158	    (sqliteMarker
   159	      ? resolveTranscriptSessionKeyBySessionId({
   160	          agentId: storageAgentId,
   161	          sessionId: sqliteMarker.sessionId,
   162	          storePath: sqliteMarker.storePath,
   163	        })
   164	      : undefined) ??
   165	    (update.sessionFile ? resolveSessionKeyForTranscriptFile(update.sessionFile) : undefined);
   166	  if (!sessionKey || update.message === undefined) {
   167	    return;
   168	  }
   169	  const effectiveAgentId = update.target?.agentId ?? update.agentId;
   170	  const defaultGlobalAgentId =
   171	    sessionKey === "global"
   172	      ? normalizeAgentId(resolveDefaultAgentId(getRuntimeConfig()))
   173	      : undefined;
   174	  const visibleAgentId =
   175	    effectiveAgentId ??
   176	    (effectiveAgentId && effectiveAgentId !== defaultGlobalAgentId ? effectiveAgentId : undefined);
   177	  const connIds = new Set<string>();
   178	  for (const connId of params.sessionEventSubscribers.getAll()) {
   179	    connIds.add(connId);
   180	  }
   181	  for (const broadcastKey of resolveSessionMessageBroadcastKeys(sessionKey, effectiveAgentId)) {
   182	    for (const connId of params.sessionMessageSubscribers.get(broadcastKey)) {
   183	      connIds.add(connId);
   184	    }
   185	  }
   186	  if (connIds.size === 0) {
   187	    return;
   188	  }
   189	  let messageSeq = asPositiveSafeInteger(update.messageSeq);
   190	  if (messageSeq === undefined) {
   191	    // Updates from raw transcript events may not carry seq; fall back to the
   192	    // current transcript line count for cursor-compatible live history.
   193	    const markerEntry = sqliteMarker
   194	      ? loadAccessorSessionEntry({
   195	          agentId: storageAgentId,
   196	          sessionKey,
   197	          storePath: sqliteMarker.storePath,
   198	        })
   199	      : undefined;
   200	    const fallbackTarget = markerEntry
   201	      ? undefined
   202	      : loadSessionEntryReadOnly(sessionKey, { agentId: visibleAgentId });
   203	    const entry = markerEntry ?? fallbackTarget?.entry;
   204	    const storePath = sqliteMarker?.storePath ?? fallbackTarget?.storePath;
   205	    messageSeq = entry?.sessionId
   206	      ? asPositiveSafeInteger(
   207	          await readSessionMessageCountAsync({
   208	            agentId: storageAgentId ?? visibleAgentId,
   209	            sessionEntry: entry,
   210	            sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   211	            sessionKey,
   212	            storePath,
   213	          }),
   214	        )
   215	      : undefined;
   216	  }
   217	  const sessionRow = loadGatewaySessionRow(sessionKey, {
   218	    agentId: visibleAgentId,
   219	    transcriptUsageMaxBytes: 64 * 1024,
   220	  });
   221	  const activeRunState = sessionRow
   222	    ? resolveVisibleActiveSessionRunState({
   223	        context: params,
   224	        requestedKey: sessionKey,
   225	        canonicalKey: sessionRow.key,
   226	        sessionId: sessionRow.sessionId,
   227	        ...(sessionRow.key === "global" && visibleAgentId ? { agentId: visibleAgentId } : {}),
   228	        defaultAgentId: normalizeAgentId(resolveDefaultAgentId(getRuntimeConfig())),
   229	      })
   230	    : null;
   231	  const sessionSnapshot = buildGatewaySessionSnapshot({
   232	    sessionRow,
   233	    agentId: visibleAgentId,
   234	    includeSession: true,
   235	    hasActiveRun: activeRunState?.active,
   236	    activeRunIds: activeRunState?.runIds,
   237	  });
   238	  const idempotencyKey = readMessageIdempotencyKey(update.message);
   239	  const senderIsOwner = readMessageSenderIsOwner(update.message);
   240	  const rawMessage = attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(update.message, {
   241	    ...(typeof update.messageId === "string" ? { id: update.messageId } : {}),
   242	    ...(idempotencyKey ? { idempotencyKey } : {}),
   243	    ...(messageSeq !== undefined ? { seq: messageSeq } : {}),
   244	  });
   245	  const message = projectChatDisplayMessage(rawMessage);
   246	  if (message) {
   247	    params.broadcastToConnIds(
   248	      "session.message",
   249	      {
   250	        sessionKey,
   251	        ...(senderIsOwner === undefined ? {} : { senderIsOwner }),
   252	        ...(visibleAgentId ? { agentId: visibleAgentId } : {}),
   253	        message,
   254	        ...(typeof update.messageId === "string" ? { messageId: update.messageId } : {}),
   255	        ...(messageSeq !== undefined ? { messageSeq } : {}),
   256	        ...sessionSnapshot,
   257	      },
   258	      connIds,
   259	      { dropIfSlow: true },
   260	    );
   261	    return;
   262	  }
   263	
   264	  // Messages suppressed from display can still change transcript state, so
   265	  // notify broad session listeners even when no session.message is emitted.
   266	  const sessionEventConnIds = params.sessionEventSubscribers.getAll();
   267	  if (sessionEventConnIds.size === 0) {
   268	    return;
   269	  }
   270	  params.broadcastToConnIds(
   271	    "sessions.changed",
   272	    {
   273	      sessionKey,
   274	      ...(visibleAgentId ? { agentId: visibleAgentId } : {}),
   275	      phase: "message",
   276	      ts: Date.now(),
   277	      ...(typeof update.messageId === "string" ? { messageId: update.messageId } : {}),
   278	      ...(messageSeq !== undefined ? { messageSeq } : {}),
   279	      ...sessionSnapshot,
   280	    },
   281	    sessionEventConnIds,
   282	    { dropIfSlow: true },
   283	  );
   284	}

   286	/** Creates a lifecycle-event broadcaster for session list refreshes. */
   287	export function createLifecycleEventBroadcastHandler(params: {
   288	  broadcastToConnIds: GatewayBroadcastToConnIdsFn;
   289	  sessionEventSubscribers: SessionEventSubscribers;
   290	  chatAbortControllers: Map<string, ChatAbortControllerEntry>;
   291	}) {
   292	  return (event: SessionLifecycleEvent): void => {
   293	    const swarmEvent = event as SessionLifecycleEvent & {
   294	      swarmGroupId?: string;
   295	      kind?: "phase" | "log";
   296	      text?: string;
   297	    };
   298	    const connIds = params.sessionEventSubscribers.getAll();
   299	    if (connIds.size === 0) {
   300	      return;
   301	    }
   302	    const sessionRow = loadGatewaySessionRow(event.sessionKey);
   303	    const activeRunState = sessionRow
   304	      ? resolveVisibleActiveSessionRunState({
   305	          context: params,
   306	          requestedKey: event.sessionKey,
   307	          canonicalKey: sessionRow.key,
   308	          sessionId: sessionRow.sessionId,
   309	          defaultAgentId: normalizeAgentId(resolveDefaultAgentId(getRuntimeConfig())),
   310	        })
     1	// Session and transcript event subscription handlers.
     2	import {
     3	  ErrorCodes,
     4	  errorShape,
     5	  validateSessionsMessagesSubscribeParams,
     6	  validateSessionsMessagesUnsubscribeParams,
     7	} from "../../../packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.js";
     8	import { resolveDefaultAgentId } from "../../agents/agent-scope.js";
     9	import { normalizeAgentId } from "../../routing/session-key.js";
    10	import { canReviewOperatorApproval } from "../operator-approval-authorization.js";
    11	import { APPROVALS_SCOPE } from "../operator-scopes.js";
    12	import { resolveRequestedSessionAgentId as resolveRequestedGlobalAgentId } from "../session-create-service.js";
    13	import { loadSessionEntryReadOnly } from "../session-utils.js";

    18	function resolveSessionMessageSubscriptionKey(params: {
    19	  canonicalKey: string;
    20	  agentId?: string;
    21	  defaultAgentId?: string;
    22	}): string {
    23	  const agentId = params.agentId
    24	    ? normalizeAgentId(params.agentId)
    25	    : params.canonicalKey === "global" && params.defaultAgentId
    26	      ? normalizeAgentId(params.defaultAgentId)
    27	      : undefined;
    28	  // Global session message subscriptions need per-agent channels to avoid cross-agent fanout.
    29	  return params.canonicalKey === "global" && agentId
    30	    ? `agent:${agentId}:global`
    31	    : params.canonicalKey;
    32	}

    34	export const sessionSubscriptionHandlers: GatewayRequestHandlers = {
    35	  "sessions.subscribe": ({ client, context, respond }) => {
    36	    const connId = client?.connId?.trim();
    37	    if (connId) {
    38	      context.subscribeSessionEvents(connId);
    39	    }
    40	    respond(true, { subscribed: Boolean(connId) }, undefined);
    41	  },
    42	  "sessions.unsubscribe": ({ client, context, respond }) => {
    43	    const connId = client?.connId?.trim();
    44	    if (connId) {
    45	      context.unsubscribeSessionEvents(connId);
    46	    }
    47	    respond(true, { subscribed: false }, undefined);
    48	  },
    49	  "sessions.messages.subscribe": ({ params, client, context, respond }) => {
    50	    if (
    51	      !assertValidParams(
    52	        params,
    53	        validateSessionsMessagesSubscribeParams,
    54	        "sessions.messages.subscribe",
    55	        respond,
    56	      )
    57	    ) {
    58	      return;
    59	    }
    60	    const connId = client?.connId?.trim();
    61	    const p = params;
    62	    const key = requireSessionKey(p.key, respond);
    63	    if (!key) {
    64	      return;
    65	    }
    66	    if (p.includeApprovals === true && !canReviewOperatorApproval(client)) {
    67	      respond(
    68	        false,
    69	        undefined,
    70	        errorShape(
    71	          ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST,
    72	          `sessions.messages.subscribe includeApprovals requires a paired device and gateway scope: ${APPROVALS_SCOPE}`,
    73	        ),
    74	      );
    75	      return;
    76	    }
    77	    const cfg = context.getRuntimeConfig();
    78	    const requestedAgent = resolveRequestedGlobalAgentId(cfg, key, p.agentId);
    79	    if (!requestedAgent.ok) {
    80	      respond(false, undefined, requestedAgent.error);
    81	      return;
    82	    }
    83	    const requestedAgentId = requestedAgent.agentId;
    84	    const { canonicalKey } = loadSessionEntryReadOnly(key, { agentId: requestedAgentId });

    86	      canonicalKey,
    87	      agentId: requestedAgentId,
    88	      defaultAgentId: resolveDefaultAgentId(cfg),
    89	    });

    91	      let approvalReplay;
    92	      if (p.includeApprovals === true) {
    93	        // Subscribe before the authoritative snapshot so a transition cannot
    94	        // land between replay and live delivery. Clients reconcile by id.
    95	        const rollbackSubscription = context.subscribeSessionMessageEvents(
    96	          connId,
    97	          subscriptionKey,
    98	          { includeApprovals: true, provisional: true },
    99	        );
   100	        try {
   101	          approvalReplay = context.listSessionPendingApprovals?.(subscriptionKey, client);
   102	        } catch (error) {
   103	          rollbackSubscription?.();
   104	          context.logGateway.error(`session approval replay failed: ${String(error)}`);
   105	          respond(
   106	            false,
   107	            undefined,
   108	            errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "session approval replay unavailable"),
   109	          );
   110	          return;
   111	        }
   112	        if (!approvalReplay) {
   113	          rollbackSubscription?.();
   114	          respond(
   115	            false,
   116	            undefined,
   117	            errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, "session approval replay unavailable"),
   118	          );
   119	          return;
   120	        }
   121	        rollbackSubscription?.commit?.();
   122	      } else {
   123	        context.subscribeSessionMessageEvents(connId, subscriptionKey);
   124	      }
   125	      respond(
   126	        true,
   127	        {
   128	          subscribed: true,
   129	          key: canonicalKey,
   130	          ...(p.includeApprovals === true
   131	            ? {
   132	                approvalReplay,
   133	              }
   134	            : {}),
   135	        },
   136	        undefined,
   137	      );
   138	      return;
   139	    }

    51	function resolveSessionHistoryPath(req: IncomingMessage): string | null {
    52	  const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
    53	  const match = url.pathname.match(/^\/sessions\/([^/]+)\/history$/);
    54	  if (!match) {
    55	    return null;
    56	  }
    57	  try {
    58	    return normalizeOptionalString(decodeURIComponent(match[1] ?? "")) ?? null;
    59	  } catch {
    60	    return "";
    61	  }
    62	}
    63	
    64	function shouldStreamSse(req: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    65	  const accept = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(getHeader(req, "accept"));
    66	  return accept.includes("text/event-stream");
    67	}
    68	
    69	function getRequestUrl(req: IncomingMessage): URL {
    70	  return new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
    71	}
    72	
    73	function resolveLimit(req: IncomingMessage): Result<number | undefined, string> {
    74	  const raw = getRequestUrl(req).searchParams.get("limit");
    75	  if (raw == null) {
    76	    return ok(undefined);
    77	  }
    78	  const trimmed = raw.trim();
    79	  const value = parseStrictPositiveInteger(trimmed);
    80	  if (value !== undefined) {
    81	    return ok(Math.min(MAX_SESSION_HISTORY_LIMIT, value));
    82	  }
    83	  if (/^\d+$/.test(trimmed) && /[1-9]/.test(trimmed)) {
    84	    return ok(MAX_SESSION_HISTORY_LIMIT);
    85	  }
    86	  return err("limit must be a positive integer");
    87	}

    89	function sseWrite(res: ServerResponse, event: string, payload: unknown): void {
    90	  res.write(`event: ${event}\n`);
    91	  res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`);
    92	}

    94	/** Handle `/sessions/:sessionKey/history` JSON/SSE requests. */
    95	export async function handleSessionHistoryHttpRequest(
    96	  req: IncomingMessage,
    97	  res: ServerResponse,
    98	  opts: {
    99	    auth: ResolvedGatewayAuth;
   100	    getResolvedAuth?: () => ResolvedGatewayAuth;
   101	    trustedProxies?: string[];
   102	    allowRealIpFallback?: boolean;
   103	    rateLimiter?: AuthRateLimiter;
   104	  },
   105	): Promise<boolean> {
   106	  const sessionKey = resolveSessionHistoryPath(req);
   107	  if (sessionKey === null) {
   108	    return false;
   109	  }
   110	  if (!sessionKey) {
   111	    sendInvalidRequest(res, "invalid session key");
   112	    return true;
   113	  }
   114	  if (req.method !== "GET") {
   115	    sendMethodNotAllowed(res, "GET");
   116	    return true;
   117	  }
   118	
   119	  // Session history intentionally uses the shared-secret HTTP trust model:
   120	  // token/password bearer auth grants default operator scopes so simple API key
   121	  // callers can read their own history without a scope header.
   122	  const authResult = await authorizeScopedGatewayHttpRequestOrReply({
   123	    req,
   124	    res,
   125	    auth: opts.auth,
   126	    trustedProxies: opts.trustedProxies,
   127	    allowRealIpFallback: opts.allowRealIpFallback,
   128	    rateLimiter: opts.rateLimiter,
   129	    operatorMethod: "chat.history",
   130	    resolveOperatorScopes: resolveSharedSecretHttpOperatorScopes,
   131	  });
   132	  if (!authResult) {
   133	    return true;
   134	  }
   135	  const { cfg } = authResult;
   136	
   137	  const target = resolveGatewaySessionStoreTargetWithStore({ cfg, key: sessionKey });
   138	  const entry = resolveFreshestSessionEntryFromStoreKeys(target.store, target.storeKeys);
   139	  if (!entry?.sessionId) {
   140	    sendJson(res, 404, {
   141	      ok: false,
   142	      error: {
   143	        type: "not_found",
   144	        message: `Session not found: ${sessionKey}`,
   145	      },
   146	    });
   147	    return true;
   148	  }
   149	  const limitResult = resolveLimit(req);
   150	  if (!limitResult.ok) {
   151	    sendInvalidRequest(res, limitResult.error);
   152	    return true;
   153	  }
   154	  const limit = limitResult.value;
   155	  const cursor = normalizeOptionalString(getRequestUrl(req).searchParams.get("cursor"));
   156	  const effectiveMaxChars = DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS;
   157	  let boundedSnapshot:
   158	    | Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readRecentSessionMessagesWithStatsAsync>>
   159	    | undefined;
   160	  let fullSnapshot: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readSessionMessagesWithSourceAsync>> | undefined;
   161	  try {
   162	    boundedSnapshot =
   163	      cursor === undefined && typeof limit === "number"
   164	        ? await readRecentSessionMessagesWithStatsAsync(
   165	            {
   166	              agentId: target.agentId,
   167	              sessionEntry: entry,
   168	              sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   169	              sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   170	              storePath: target.storePath,
   171	            },
   172	            {
   173	              ...resolveSessionHistoryTailReadOptions(limit),
   174	              allowResetArchiveFallback: true,
   175	            },
   176	          )
   177	        : undefined;
   178	    // Cursor reads still need an arbitrary historical window. The common first
   179	    // page path is bounded above so `limit=1` cannot materialize huge transcripts.
   180	    fullSnapshot =
   181	      boundedSnapshot === undefined && entry?.sessionId
   182	        ? await readSessionMessagesWithSourceAsync(
   183	            {
   184	              agentId: target.agentId,
   185	              sessionEntry: entry,
   186	              sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   187	              sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   188	              storePath: target.storePath,
   189	            },
   190	            {
   191	              mode: "full",
   192	              reason: "session history cursor pagination",
   193	              allowResetArchiveFallback: true,
   194	            },
   195	          )
   196	        : undefined;
   197	  } catch (error) {
   198	    if (!isSessionTranscriptProjectionUnavailableError(error)) {
   199	      throw error;
   200	    }
   201	    res.setHeader("Retry-After", "1");
   202	    sendJson(res, 503, {
   203	      ok: false,
   204	      error: {
   205	        type: "unavailable",
   206	        message: "session history is rebuilding; retry shortly",
   207	        retryable: true,
   208	      },
   209	    });
   210	    return true;
   211	  }
   212	  const rawSnapshot = boundedSnapshot?.messages ?? fullSnapshot?.messages ?? [];
   213	  const historySnapshot = buildSessionHistorySnapshot({
   214	    rawMessages: rawSnapshot,
   215	    maxChars: effectiveMaxChars,
   216	    limit,
   217	    cursor,
   218	    rawTranscriptSeq: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   219	    totalRawMessages: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   220	  });
   221	  const history = historySnapshot.history;
   222	
   223	  if (!shouldStreamSse(req)) {
   224	    sendJson(res, 200, {
   225	      sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   226	      ...history,
   227	    });
   228	    return true;
   229	  }
   230	
   231	  const transcriptCandidates = entry?.sessionId
   232	    ? new Set(
   233	        resolveSessionTranscriptCandidates(
   234	          entry.sessionId,
   235	          target.storePath,
   236	          entry.sessionFile,
   237	          target.agentId,
   238	        )
   239	          .map((candidate) => resolveTranscriptPathForComparison(candidate))
   240	          .filter((candidate): candidate is string => typeof candidate === "string"),
   241	      )
   242	    : new Set<string>();
   243	
   244	  let sentHistory = history;
   245	  const sseState = SessionHistorySseState.fromRawSnapshot({
   246	    target: {
   247	      agentId: target.agentId,
   248	      sessionEntry: entry,
   249	      sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   250	      sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   251	      storePath: target.storePath,
   252	    },
   253	    rawMessages: rawSnapshot,
   254	    rawTranscriptSeq: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   255	    totalRawMessages: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   256	    transcriptPath: boundedSnapshot?.transcriptPath ?? fullSnapshot?.transcriptPath,
   257	    maxChars: effectiveMaxChars,
   258	    limit,
   259	    cursor,
   260	  });
   261	  sentHistory = sseState.snapshot();
   262	  let streamStopped = false;
   263	  let streamQueue = Promise.resolve();
   264	  const streamResources: {
   265	    heartbeat?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
   266	    unsubscribe?: () => void;
   267	  } = {};
   268	
   269	  function releaseStreamResources() {
   270	    if (streamStopped) {
   271	      return;
   272	    }
   273	    streamStopped = true;
   274	    if (streamResources.heartbeat) {
   275	      clearInterval(streamResources.heartbeat);
   276	    }
   277	    if (streamResources.unsubscribe) {
   278	      streamResources.unsubscribe();
   279	    }
   280	  }
   281	
   282	  function detachStreamListeners() {
   283	    req.off("close", handleRequestStreamClose);
   284	    req.off("error", handleRequestStreamError);
   285	    res.off("close", handleResponseStreamClose);
   286	    res.off("finish", handleResponseStreamFinish);
   287	    res.off("error", handleResponseStreamError);
   288	  }
   289	
   290	  function closeStream() {
   291	    releaseStreamResources();
   292	    if (!res.writableEnded && !res.destroyed) {
   293	      res.end();
   294	    }
   295	  }
   296	
   297	  function handleRequestStreamClose() {
   298	    releaseStreamResources();
   299	    req.off("close", handleRequestStreamClose);
   300	    req.off("error", handleRequestStreamError);
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  function handleRequestStreamError(error: Error) {
   304	    // Node HTTP streams emit process-fatal `error` events without listeners.
   305	    // Request-side failures mean the SSE owner should release and end locally.
   306	    log.warn("session history SSE request stream errored; closing stream", { error });
   307	    closeStream();
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function handleResponseStreamFinish() {
   311	    releaseStreamResources();
   312	    // `finish` only means Node handed the response bytes to the OS. Keep the
   313	    // error listener until `close` so a late flush failure stays stream-local.
   314	    res.off("finish", handleResponseStreamFinish);
   315	  }
   316	
   317	  function handleResponseStreamClose() {
   318	    releaseStreamResources();
   319	    detachStreamListeners();
   320	  }
   321	
   322	  function handleResponseStreamError(error: Error) {
   323	    // The response stream is already failing, so only release local resources;
   324	    // writing an end frame here can re-enter the errored ServerResponse.
   325	    log.warn("session history SSE response stream errored; cleaning up stream", { error });
   326	    releaseStreamResources();
   327	  }
   328	  const isStreamClosed = () => streamStopped || res.writableEnded || res.destroyed;
   329	
   330	  req.on("close", handleRequestStreamClose);
   331	  req.on("error", handleRequestStreamError);
   332	  res.on("close", handleResponseStreamClose);
   333	  res.on("finish", handleResponseStreamFinish);
   334	  res.on("error", handleResponseStreamError);
   335	
   336	  setSseHeaders(res);
   337	  res.write("retry: 1000\n\n");
   338	  if (isStreamClosed()) {
   339	    return true;
   340	  }
   341	  sseWrite(res, "history", {
   342	    sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   343	    ...sentHistory,
   344	  });
   345	  if (isStreamClosed()) {
   346	    return true;
   347	  }
   348	
   349	  const queueStreamWork = (work: () => Promise<void>) => {
   350	    streamQueue = streamQueue
   351	      .then(async () => {
   352	        if (streamStopped || res.writableEnded) {
   353	          return;
   354	        }
   355	        await work();
   356	      })
   357	      .catch((error: unknown) => {
   358	        // Surface the underlying error so operators can distinguish transient
   359	        // infrastructure failures (for example a `getRuntimeConfig()` read error
   360	        // inside the reauth path) from deliberate revocation, then fail closed.
   361	        log.warn("session history SSE stream work failed; closing stream", { error });
   362	        closeStream();
   363	      });
   364	  };
   365	
   366	  const isStreamStillAuthorized = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   367	    const cfgLocal = getRuntimeConfig();
   368	    const currentRequestAuth = await checkGatewayHttpRequestAuth({
   369	      req,
   370	      auth: opts.getResolvedAuth?.() ?? opts.auth,
   371	      trustedProxies: cfgLocal.gateway?.trustedProxies,
   372	      allowRealIpFallback: cfgLocal.gateway?.allowRealIpFallback,
   373	      rateLimiter: opts.rateLimiter,
   374	      cfg: cfgLocal,
   375	    });
   376	    if (!currentRequestAuth.ok) {
   377	      return false;
   378	    }
   379	    const requestedScopes = resolveSharedSecretHttpOperatorScopes(
   380	      req,
   381	      currentRequestAuth.requestAuth,
   382	    );
   383	    return authorizeOperatorScopesForMethod("chat.history", requestedScopes).allowed;
   384	  };
   385	
   386	  streamResources.heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
   387	    queueStreamWork(async () => {
   388	      if (!(await isStreamStillAuthorized())) {
   389	        closeStream();
   390	        return;
   391	      }
   392	      if (!res.writableEnded) {
   393	        res.write(": keepalive\n\n");
   394	      }
   395	    });
   396	  }, 15_000);
   397	
   398	  streamResources.unsubscribe = onInternalSessionTranscriptUpdate((update) => {
   399	    // Filter to candidate sessions synchronously before enqueueing any async
   400	    // work. Transcript updates use a global fan-out listener, so every
   401	    // transcript write in the gateway would otherwise append a Promise-chain
   402	    // entry capturing `update.message` to every open SSE stream's queue —
   403	    // O(streams × updates) for busy deployments.
   404	    if (!entry?.sessionId) {
   405	      return;
   406	    }
   407	    const updateMatchesIdentity =
   408	      update.target?.sessionId === entry.sessionId &&
   409	      normalizeAgentId(update.target.agentId) === normalizeAgentId(target.agentId);
   410	    const updatePath = resolveTranscriptPathForComparison(update.sessionFile);
   411	    if (!updateMatchesIdentity && (!updatePath || !transcriptCandidates.has(updatePath))) {
   412	      return;
   413	    }
   414	    queueStreamWork(async () => {
   415	      if (res.writableEnded) {
   416	        return;
   417	      }
   418	      if (!(await isStreamStillAuthorized())) {
   419	        closeStream();
   420	        return;
   421	      }
   422	      if (update.message !== undefined) {
   423	        if (limit === undefined && cursor === undefined) {
   424	          if (sseState.shouldRefreshForTranscriptPath(updatePath)) {
   425	            sentHistory = await sseState.refreshAsync();
   426	            sseWrite(res, "history", {
   427	              sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   428	              ...sentHistory,
   429	            });
   430	            return;
   431	          }
   432	          const nextEvent = sseState.appendInlineMessage({
   433	            message: update.message,
   434	            messageId: update.messageId,
   435	            messageSeq: update.messageSeq,
   436	          });
   437	          if (!nextEvent) {
   438	            return;
   439	          }
   440	          if (nextEvent.shouldRefresh) {
   441	            sentHistory = await sseState.refreshAsync();
   442	            sseWrite(res, "history", {
   443	              sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   444	              ...sentHistory,
   445	            });
   446	            return;
   447	          }
   448	          if (nextEvent.message === undefined) {
   449	            return;
   450	          }
   451	          sentHistory = sseState.snapshot();
   452	          sseWrite(res, "message", {
   453	            sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   454	            message: nextEvent.message,
   455	            ...(typeof update.messageId === "string" ? { messageId: update.messageId } : {}),
   456	            messageSeq: nextEvent.messageSeq,
   457	          });
   458	          return;
   459	        }
   460	      }
   461	      sentHistory = await sseState.refreshAsync();
   462	      sseWrite(res, "history", {
   463	        sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   464	        ...sentHistory,
   465	      });
   466	    });
   467	  });
   468	  return true;
   469	}

    63	function readMessageIdempotencyKey(message: unknown): string | undefined {
    64	  if (!message || typeof message !== "object" || Array.isArray(message)) {
    65	    return undefined;
    66	  }
    67	  const value = (message as Record<string, unknown>).idempotencyKey;
    68	  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value : undefined;
    69	}

    71	/** Computes an oversized raw transcript tail window for projected chat history. */
    72	export function resolveSessionHistoryTailReadOptions(limit: number): {
    73	  maxMessages: number;
    74	  maxLines: number;
    75	} {
    76	  const requested = Math.max(1, Math.floor(limit));
    77	  const rawWindow = requested * 20 + 20;
    78	  return {
    79	    maxMessages: rawWindow,
    80	    maxLines: rawWindow,
    81	  };
    82	}

    84	function resolveCursorSeq(cursor: string | undefined): number | undefined {
    85	  if (!cursor) {
    86	    return undefined;
    87	  }
    88	  const normalized = cursor.startsWith("seq:") ? cursor.slice(4) : cursor;
    89	  if (!/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
    90	    return undefined;
    91	  }
    92	  const value = Number(normalized);
    93	  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value > 0 ? value : undefined;
    94	}

    96	function toSessionHistoryMessages(messages: unknown[]): SessionHistoryMessage[] {
    97	  return messages.filter(
    98	    (message): message is SessionHistoryMessage =>
    99	      Boolean(message) && typeof message === "object" && !Array.isArray(message),
   100	  );
   101	}

   103	function buildPaginatedSessionHistory(params: {
   104	  messages: SessionHistoryMessage[];
   105	  hasMore: boolean;
   106	  nextCursor?: string;
   107	}): PaginatedSessionHistory {
   108	  return {
   109	    items: params.messages,
   110	    messages: params.messages,
   111	    hasMore: params.hasMore,
   112	    ...(params.nextCursor ? { nextCursor: params.nextCursor } : {}),
   113	  };
   114	}

   116	function resolveMessageSeq(message: SessionHistoryMessage | undefined): number | undefined {
   117	  return asPositiveSafeInteger(message?.["__openclaw"]?.seq);
   118	}

   120	function isMessageToolMirrorMessage(message: SessionHistoryMessage): boolean {
   121	  return message.openclawMessageToolMirror !== undefined;

   123	
   124	function paginateSessionMessages(
   125	  messages: SessionHistoryMessage[],
   126	  limit: number | undefined,
   127	  cursor: string | undefined,
   128	): PaginatedSessionHistory {
   129	  // Cursors point at transcript sequence watermarks. The returned page is the
   130	  // window before that cursor, matching "older messages" pagination.
   131	  const cursorSeq = resolveCursorSeq(cursor);
   132	  let endExclusive = messages.length;
   133	  if (typeof cursorSeq === "number") {
   134	    endExclusive = messages.findIndex((message, index) => {
   135	      const seq = resolveMessageSeq(message);
   136	      if (typeof seq === "number") {
   137	        return seq >= cursorSeq;
   138	      }
   139	      return index + 1 >= cursorSeq;
   140	    });
   141	    if (endExclusive < 0) {
   142	      endExclusive = messages.length;
   143	    }
   144	  }
   145	  const start = typeof limit === "number" && limit > 0 ? Math.max(0, endExclusive - limit) : 0;
   146	  const paginatedMessages = messages.slice(start, endExclusive);
   147	  const firstSeq = resolveMessageSeq(paginatedMessages[0]);
   148	  return buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   149	    messages: paginatedMessages,
   150	    hasMore: start > 0,
   151	    ...(start > 0 && typeof firstSeq === "number" ? { nextCursor: String(firstSeq) } : {}),
   152	  });
   153	}

   155	/** Builds the display history snapshot and raw transcript sequence watermark. */
   156	export function buildSessionHistorySnapshot(params: {
   157	  rawMessages: unknown[];
   158	  maxChars?: number;
   159	  limit?: number;
   160	  cursor?: string;
   161	  rawTranscriptSeq?: number;
   162	  totalRawMessages?: number;
   163	}): SessionHistorySnapshot {
   164	  const projected = projectChatDisplayMessagesWithState(params.rawMessages, {
   165	    maxChars: params.maxChars ?? DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS,
   166	  });
   167	  const visibleMessages = toSessionHistoryMessages(projected.messages);
   168	  const history = paginateSessionMessages(visibleMessages, params.limit, params.cursor);
   169	  if (
   170	    !params.cursor &&
   171	    typeof params.totalRawMessages === "number" &&
   172	    params.totalRawMessages > params.rawMessages.length &&
   173	    history.messages.length > 0
   174	  ) {
   175	    const firstSeq = resolveMessageSeq(history.messages[0]);
   176	    history.hasMore = true;
   177	    if (typeof firstSeq === "number") {
   178	      history.nextCursor = String(firstSeq);
   179	    }
   180	  }
   181	  const rawHistoryMessages = toSessionHistoryMessages(params.rawMessages);
   182	  return {
   183	    history,
   184	    rawTranscriptSeq:
   185	      params.rawTranscriptSeq ??
   186	      resolveMessageSeq(rawHistoryMessages.at(-1)) ??
   187	      rawHistoryMessages.length,
   188	    turnBoundaryPending: projected.turnBoundaryPending,
   189	  };
   190	}

   254	  snapshot(): PaginatedSessionHistory {

   257	
   258	  appendInlineMessage(update: {
   259	    message: unknown;
   260	    messageId?: string;
   261	    messageSeq?: number;
   262	  }): InlineSessionHistoryAppend | null {
   263	    if (this.limit !== undefined || this.cursor !== undefined) {
   264	      return null;
   265	    }
   266	    const carriedSeq = asPositiveSafeInteger(update.messageSeq);
   267	    if (carriedSeq !== undefined) {
   268	      if (carriedSeq <= this.rawTranscriptSeq) {
   269	        return { shouldRefresh: true };
   270	      }
   271	      this.rawTranscriptSeq = carriedSeq;
   272	    } else {
   273	      this.rawTranscriptSeq += 1;
   274	    }
   275	    const idempotencyKey = readMessageIdempotencyKey(update.message);
   276	    const nextMessage = attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(update.message, {
   277	      ...(typeof update.messageId === "string" ? { id: update.messageId } : {}),
   278	      ...(idempotencyKey ? { idempotencyKey } : {}),
   279	      seq: this.rawTranscriptSeq,
   280	    });
   281	    const hadPendingTurnBoundary = this.turnBoundaryPending;
   282	    const nextProjection = projectChatDisplayMessagesWithState([nextMessage], {
   283	      maxChars: this.maxChars,
   284	      turnBoundaryPending: hadPendingTurnBoundary,
   285	    });
   286	    this.turnBoundaryPending = nextProjection.turnBoundaryPending;
   287	    // Projection can split, drop, or rewrite raw transcript messages. When one
   288	    // raw append changes multiple visible rows, callers must refresh instead of
   289	    // emitting a misleading single SSE item.
   290	    const projectedMessages = toSessionHistoryMessages(
   291	      projectChatDisplayMessages([...this.sentHistory.messages, nextMessage], {
   292	        maxChars: this.maxChars,
   293	      }),
   294	    );
   295	    if (projectedMessages.length > this.sentHistory.messages.length) {
   296	      const addedMessages = projectedMessages.slice(this.sentHistory.messages.length);
   297	      if (hadPendingTurnBoundary && !this.turnBoundaryPending && addedMessages[0]) {
   298	        const firstAdded = attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(addedMessages[0], {
   299	          turnBoundary: true,
   300	        }) as SessionHistoryMessage;
   301	        addedMessages[0] = firstAdded;
   302	        projectedMessages[this.sentHistory.messages.length] = firstAdded;
   303	      }
   304	      if (addedMessages.length > 1) {
   305	        this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   306	          messages: projectedMessages,
   307	          hasMore: false,
   308	        });
   309	        return { shouldRefresh: true };
   310	      }
   311	      const projectedMessage = addedMessages[0];
   312	      if (projectedMessage !== undefined) {
   313	        const emittedMessage: SessionHistoryMessage =
   314	          isMessageToolMirrorMessage(projectedMessage) ||
   315	          resolveMessageSeq(projectedMessage) === undefined
   316	            ? (attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(projectedMessage, {
   317	                seq: this.rawTranscriptSeq,
   318	              }) as SessionHistoryMessage)
   319	            : projectedMessage;
   320	        const nextMessages = [...this.sentHistory.messages, emittedMessage];
   321	        this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   322	          messages: nextMessages,
   323	          hasMore: false,
   324	        });
   325	        return {
   326	          message: emittedMessage,
   327	          messageSeq: resolveMessageSeq(emittedMessage),
   328	        };
   329	      }
   330	    }
   331	    const [sanitizedMessage] = toSessionHistoryMessages(nextProjection.messages);
   332	    if (!sanitizedMessage) {
   333	      if (projectedMessages.length < this.sentHistory.messages.length) {
   334	        this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   335	          messages: projectedMessages,
   336	          hasMore: false,
   337	        });
   338	        return { shouldRefresh: true };
   339	      }
   340	      return null;
   341	    }
   342	    if (projectedMessages.length <= this.sentHistory.messages.length) {
   343	      this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   344	        messages: projectedMessages,
   345	        hasMore: false,
   346	      });
   347	      return { shouldRefresh: true };
   348	    }
   349	    const projectedMessage = projectedMessages.at(-1) ?? sanitizedMessage;
   350	    const nextMessages = [...this.sentHistory.messages, projectedMessage];
   351	    this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   352	      messages: nextMessages,
   353	      hasMore: false,
   354	    });
   355	    return {
   356	      message: projectedMessage,
   357	      messageSeq: resolveMessageSeq(projectedMessage),
   358	    };
   359	  }
   360	
   361	  shouldRefreshForTranscriptPath(updatePath: string | undefined): boolean {
   362	    const nextPath = normalizeTranscriptPathForComparison(updatePath);
   363	    return Boolean(this.transcriptPath && nextPath && this.transcriptPath !== nextPath);
   364	  }

   366	  async refreshAsync(): Promise<PaginatedSessionHistory> {
   367	    const rawSnapshot = await this.readRawSnapshotAsync();
   368	    const snapshot = this.buildSnapshot(rawSnapshot);
   369	    this.rawTranscriptSeq = snapshot.rawTranscriptSeq;
   370	    this.turnBoundaryPending = snapshot.turnBoundaryPending;
   371	    this.transcriptPath = normalizeTranscriptPathForComparison(rawSnapshot.transcriptPath);
   372	    this.sentHistory = snapshot.history;
   373	    return snapshot.history;
   374	  }

kernels/openclaw/docs/concepts/session-state.md:44:- **Implicit (spawn edges).** When a session spawns a sub-agent or ACP child, the parent's cursor is seeded automatically at the child's spawn version. Parents never subscribe manually.
kernels/openclaw/docs/concepts/session-state.md:49:Watches clean themselves up: cursor rows expire with signal-log retention, are removed when the watcher session resets, and are deleted with either session. There is no unwatch verb in v1.
kernels/openclaw/docs/concepts/session-state.md:57:When a notify-eligible event lands and a watcher's cursor is behind, the watcher receives one system notice on its next turn:
kernels/openclaw/docs/concepts/session-state.md:68:- **Frozen watermark.** The cursor freezes its notified position when a notice is queued. Further material events advance only the material watermark; they do not re-notify.
kernels/openclaw/docs/concepts/session-state.md:69:- **Acknowledge on drain, reopen only for interleaved work.** When the watcher's turn consumes the notice, the cursor advances. If more material events arrived between queueing and draining, exactly one fresh notice is opened for the remainder.
kernels/openclaw/docs/concepts/session-state.md:71:- **Restart recovery.** Pending notices live in an in-memory queue; a startup sweep re-materializes them from durable cursors after a gateway restart.

kernels/openclaw/docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md:202:    For transcript reads and writes, import `openclaw/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime` and use `resolveSessionTranscriptIdentity(...)`, `resolveSessionTranscriptTarget(...)`, `readSessionTranscriptEvents(...)`, `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta(...)`, `readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta(...)`, `readVisibleSessionTranscriptMessageEntries(...)`, `appendSessionTranscriptMessageByIdentity(...)`, `publishSessionTranscriptUpdateByIdentity(...)`, or `withSessionTranscriptWriteLock(...)` with `{ agentId, sessionKey, sessionId }`. These APIs let plugins identify a transcript, read raw events or visible branch-safe message entries, append messages, publish updates, and run related operations under the same transcript write lock without depending on active transcript file paths. `readVisibleSessionTranscriptMessageEntries(...)` returns ordered read metadata; its `seq` field is not a resumable cursor.
kernels/openclaw/docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md:204:    `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta(...)` returns a bounded `page`, `reset`, or `missing` result. Pass the opaque `page.cursor` into the next call. Pure appends preserve the cursor, while transcript replacement returns `reset` with a new bootstrap cursor. Pages default to 1,000 events and 1,000,000 serialized bytes; callers may request up to 10,000 events and 64 MiB. When the next event alone exceeds `maxBytes`, the page is empty and reports `requiredBytes`; retry with at least that byte limit when it is no greater than 64 MiB. Larger individual events require the complete-read API. A cursor identifies position only and never grants access to another session.
kernels/openclaw/docs/plugins/sdk-runtime.md:206:    `readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta(...)` provides the same bounded bootstrap-and-resume shape over the host-owned active message projection. It returns messages from oldest to newest, so context engines can drain initial history and persist the opaque cursor as their watermark. Store and return the cursor unchanged; it is a continuation hint, not an authorization credential. Linear appends resume after the last returned message. Transcript replacement, a cursor whose anchor left or moved within the active branch, malformed cursors, and cross-session cursors return `reset` with a fresh bootstrap cursor. The count and byte defaults and caps match the raw delta API. While the active projection is rebuilding after a branch change, the result is `unavailable` with reason `projection_rebuilding`; retry later rather than falling back to an active transcript file.

kernels/openclaw/docs/web/control-ui.md:365:Drag one or more files onto the active terminal, or use the paperclip button to choose files. OpenClaw stages each file on the machine that owns the PTY and pastes shell-quoted absolute paths at the cursor; it never presses Enter or executes the input.     92	function serializeFrameField(name: "payload" | "stateVersion", value: unknown): string {
    93	  // Serialize one field through JSON.stringify so embedded values keep JSON
    94	  // escaping, then splice it into the shared per-client frame body.
    95	  const fieldJSON = JSON.stringify({ [name]: value });
    96	  const keyJSON = JSON.stringify(name);
    97	  const prefix = `{${keyJSON}:`;
    98	  return fieldJSON.startsWith(prefix) ? `,${keyJSON}:${fieldJSON.slice(prefix.length, -1)}` : "";
    99	}
   100	
   101	function hasEventScope(
   102	  client: GatewayWsClient,
   103	  event: string,
   104	  explicitPluginScope?: GatewayPluginEventScope,
   105	): boolean {
   106	  if (client.connectionKind === "worker") {
   107	    return false;
   108	  }
   109	  if (explicitPluginScope) {
   110	    if ((client.connect.role ?? "operator") !== "operator") {
   111	      return false;
   112	    }
   113	    const scopes = Array.isArray(client.connect.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
   114	    if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
   115	      return true;
   116	    }
   117	    return explicitPluginScope === READ_SCOPE
   118	      ? scopes.includes(READ_SCOPE) || scopes.includes(WRITE_SCOPE)
   119	      : explicitPluginScope === WRITE_SCOPE && scopes.includes(WRITE_SCOPE);
   120	  }
   121	  const required = EVENT_SCOPE_GUARDS[event];
   122	  // Plugin-defined gateway broadcast events (plugin.* namespace) are allowed
   123	  // for operator.write and operator.admin scopes. Explicit plugin.* entries
   124	  // in EVENT_SCOPE_GUARDS take precedence (e.g., plugin.approval.*).
   125	  if (!required && event.startsWith("plugin.")) {
   126	    const role = client.connect.role ?? "operator";
   127	    if (role !== "operator") {
   128	      return false;
   129	    }
   130	    const scopes = Array.isArray(client.connect.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
   131	    return scopes.includes(WRITE_SCOPE) || scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE);
   132	  }
   133	  if (!required) {
   134	    return false;
   135	  }
   136	  if (required.length === 0) {
   137	    return true;
   138	  }
   139	  const role = client.connect.role ?? "operator";
   140	  if (role !== "operator") {
   141	    return false;
   142	  }
   143	  const scopes = Array.isArray(client.connect.scopes) ? client.connect.scopes : [];
   144	  if (scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE)) {
   145	    return true;
   146	  }
   147	  if (required.includes(READ_SCOPE)) {
   148	    return scopes.includes(READ_SCOPE) || scopes.includes(WRITE_SCOPE);
   149	  }
   150	  return required.some((scope) => scopes.includes(scope));
   151	}

   153	export function createGatewayBroadcaster(params: {
   154	  clients: Set<GatewayWsClient>;
   155	  sessionMessageSubscribers?: SessionMessageSubscriberRegistry;
   156	}) {
   157	  const clientSeq = new WeakMap<GatewayWsClient, number>();
   158	  const reportedSlowPayloadClients = new WeakSet<GatewayWsClient>();
   159	
   160	  const broadcastInternal = (
   161	    event: string,
   162	    payload: unknown,
   163	    opts?: GatewayBroadcastOpts,
   164	    targetConnIds?: ReadonlySet<string>,
   165	    explicitPluginScope?: GatewayPluginEventScope,
   166	  ) => {
   167	    if (params.clients.size === 0) {
   168	      return;
   169	    }
   170	    const isTargeted = Boolean(targetConnIds);
   171	    if (shouldLogWs()) {
   172	      const logMeta: Record<string, unknown> = {
   173	        event,
   174	        seq: isTargeted ? "targeted" : "per-client",
   175	        clients: params.clients.size,
   176	        targets: targetConnIds ? targetConnIds.size : undefined,
   177	        dropIfSlow: opts?.dropIfSlow,
   178	        presenceVersion: opts?.stateVersion?.presence,
   179	        healthVersion: opts?.stateVersion?.health,
   180	      };
   181	      if (event === "agent") {
   182	        Object.assign(logMeta, summarizeAgentEventForWsLog(payload));
   183	      }
   184	      logWs("out", "event", logMeta);
   185	    }
   186	    let frameBase:
   187	      | {
   188	          eventJSON: string;
   189	          payloadFragment: string;
   190	          stateVersionFragment: string;
   191	        }
   192	      | undefined;
   193	    const getFrameBase = () => {
   194	      if (!frameBase) {
   195	        frameBase = {
   196	          eventJSON: JSON.stringify(event),
   197	          payloadFragment: serializeFrameField("payload", payload),
   198	          stateVersionFragment:
   199	            opts?.stateVersion === undefined
   200	              ? ""
   201	              : serializeFrameField("stateVersion", opts.stateVersion),
   202	        };
   203	      }
   204	      return frameBase;
   205	    };
   206	    for (const c of params.clients) {
   207	      if (c.invalidated === true) {
   208	        continue;
   209	      }
   210	      if (targetConnIds && !targetConnIds.has(c.connId)) {
   211	        continue;
   212	      }
   213	      if (!hasEventScope(c, event, explicitPluginScope)) {
   214	        continue;
   215	      }
   216	      if (
   217	        (isBrowserCopilotClient(c.connect.client) ||
   218	          hasGatewayClientCap(c.connect.caps, GATEWAY_CLIENT_CAPS.SESSION_SCOPED_EVENTS)) &&
   219	        SESSION_SUBSCRIPTION_EVENTS.has(event) &&
   220	        (!opts?.sessionKeys?.length ||
   221	          !opts.sessionKeys.some((sessionKey) =>
   222	            params.sessionMessageSubscribers?.get(sessionKey).has(c.connId),
   223	          ))
   224	      ) {
   225	        // Scoped clients opt out of legacy broadcast fanout. The server-side
   226	        // subscription registry is the authority, so client filtering cannot leak a sibling tab.
   227	        continue;
   228	      }
   229	      const nextSeq = (clientSeq.get(c) ?? 0) + 1;
   230	      const slow = c.socket.bufferedAmount > MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES;
   231	      if (!slow) {
   232	        reportedSlowPayloadClients.delete(c);
   233	      } else if (!reportedSlowPayloadClients.has(c)) {
   234	        reportedSlowPayloadClients.add(c);
   235	        logRejectedLargePayload({
   236	          surface: "gateway.ws.outbound_buffer",
   237	          bytes: c.socket.bufferedAmount,
   238	          limitBytes: MAX_BUFFERED_BYTES,
   239	          reason: opts?.dropIfSlow ? "ws_send_buffer_drop" : "ws_send_buffer_close",
   240	        });
   241	      }
   242	      if (slow && opts?.dropIfSlow) {
   243	        if (!isTargeted) {
   244	          clientSeq.set(c, nextSeq);
   245	        }
   246	        continue;
   247	      }
   248	      if (slow) {
   249	        try {
   250	          c.socket.close(1008, "slow consumer");
   251	        } catch {
   252	          /* ignore */
   253	        }
   254	        continue;
   255	      }
   256	      try {
   257	        const eventSeq = isTargeted ? undefined : nextSeq;
   258	        if (!isTargeted) {
   259	          clientSeq.set(c, nextSeq);
   260	        }
   261	        const base = getFrameBase();
   262	        const seqFragment = eventSeq === undefined ? "" : `,"seq":${eventSeq}`;
   263	        const frame = `{"type":"event","event":${base.eventJSON}${base.payloadFragment}${seqFragment}${base.stateVersionFragment}}`;
   264	        c.socket.send(frame);
   265	      } catch {
   266	        /* ignore */
   267	      }
   268	    }
   269	  };
   270	
   271	  const broadcast: GatewayBroadcastFn = (event, payload, opts) =>
   272	    broadcastInternal(event, payload, opts);
   273	
   274	  const broadcastToConnIds: GatewayBroadcastToConnIdsFn = (event, payload, connIds, opts) => {
   275	    if (connIds.size === 0) {
   276	      return;
   277	    }
   278	    broadcastInternal(event, payload, opts, connIds);
   279	  };
   280	
   281	  const getBufferedAmount: GatewayBufferedAmountFn = (connId) => {
   282	    for (const client of params.clients) {
   283	      if (client.connId === connId) {
   284	        return client.socket.bufferedAmount;
   285	      }
   286	    }
   287	    return undefined;
   288	  };
   289	
   290	  const broadcastPluginEvent: GatewayPluginEventBroadcastFn = (event, payload, scope) => {
   291	    if (!event.startsWith("plugin.") || event.startsWith("plugin.approval.")) {
   292	      throw new Error(`invalid plugin gateway event: ${event}`);
   293	    }
   294	    if (scope !== READ_SCOPE && scope !== WRITE_SCOPE && scope !== ADMIN_SCOPE) {
   295	      throw new Error("invalid plugin gateway event scope");
   296	    }
   297	    broadcastInternal(event, payload, undefined, undefined, scope);
   298	  };
   299	
   300	  return { broadcast, broadcastToConnIds, broadcastPluginEvent, getBufferedAmount };
   301	}

     2	
     3	## Round Objective
     4	
     5	**SG-10 L1 修复轮**（不是新功能轮）。rounds/0011 收成 `Accepted: no` / `Feedback: negative`——★审查闸 codex T-080 判 REWORK，主会话逐条自验后采纳，RAE-0001 outcome=`fail`。本轮修掉那些缺陷、重取证据，**再次判定 RAE-0001**。

     8	
     9	**blocker 分类**：`contract-insufficient`，`runtime-recoverable`。本轮全部动作限于缺陷修复 + 证据重取，不引入 L2/L3 任何功能。
    10	
    11	## 六项限定范围（逐条来自 rounds/0011 decision.md）
    12	
    13	### ① 修消息分组
    14	
    15	**已核实的事实**（不是推测）：
    16	- `message` 载荷**没有 `id` 字段**——实测 wire 帧的 `message.keys = ['content','role','timestamp']`，无服务端消息标识可直接用作分组键。
    17	- openclaw 的 `event=chat` 有 `state` 生命周期：`status`（多条）→ `delta`（带 `deltaText` **且**带 `message`）→ `final`（带 `message` + `stopReason`）。
    18	- **kernel-client 全仓没有任何一处按 `state` 分支**（`EventMapping.swift` 与 `OpenclawGatewayKernelClient.swift` 均 grep 无命中）——`delta` 与 `final` 走同一条映射路径。
    19	- `EventMapping.swift:197` 的 `index` 来自 `blocks.enumerated()`，是**单条 message 内**的 content-block 下标，每条新消息从 0 重启；`SessionStore.swift:184-194` 按 `(runID,index)` 永久复用气泡。
    20	
    21	**尚未搞清、本轮必须先查明的**：注入失败那次（`screens/l1-injected-failure-midchain.png`）错误文本**重复了两次**，而成功那次（`ROUNDTRIP OK`）**没有重复**。按「delta 与 final 都产出 messageDelta 且 index 同为 0」的推断，两次都该重复。**这个差异说明我对机制的理解还不完整。**
    22	
    23	**本轮要求**：先定位真实机制（读 wire 帧 + 读映射代码 + 必要时加临时打点），**再**动手改。不得跳过定位直接按推断改——那正是 rounds/0011 「把既成缺陷记成待验假设」的反面翻版：这次不能反过来把未查清的机制当成已知根因。
    24

    26	
    27	### ①' 定位已完成 + 修法定案：**走 C（透传消息标识）**（user-confirmed 2026-08-08）
    28	
    29	**定位结论已推翻上面 §21 的推断**（证据：`evidence/item1-mechanism-localization.md`、`evidence/instrumented-run-findings.md`、`evidence/raw/wire-trace.jsonl`）：
    30	
    31	- `session.message` 层**不做增量投递**——一条 assistant 消息 = 一条帧 = 一个 `evt.message.delta`，`delta` 携带**完整全文**（实测 `'1\n2\n…\n12'` 单事件 `index=0`）。增量在 `chat` 旁路流上，kernel-client 不消费。故 `SessionStore` 的 `text += delta` **在这一层永远是错的**。
    32	- 重复的真根因：注入失败时同一 run 产出**两条不同帧**（`messageId` 各为 `1cf68049`/`0aaec118`），同 `runID`、同 `index=0` → 撞 `"runID#index"` 键 → 追加 → 文本重复。上面 §21 那个「delta 与 final 同路径」的推断是**在错误的事件流（`chat`）上得出的**，已作废。
    33	
    34	**hopper 双路异构评审**（T-081 codex / T-082 grok，同一 brief、互不可见）：两家**一致**认定根因是键空间错误、**B 否决成立**、**C 是正确解**；分歧只在要不要先上权宜的 A。
    35	
    36	- codex 反对 A（主会话核实成立，**且是主会话原先漏掉的**）：A 在 schema 层确实零改动，但它**把 `evt.message.delta` 固化解释成「完整消息」**，与 D5.1 §3.1 明文的渲染契约相抵触——「按到达顺序把 `delta` **追加**进当前 assistant 消息气泡，粒度受 `capabilities().streamingGranularity` 门控」。违反的是**行为契约**，不是 schema。
    37	- grok 支持 A 的关键反驳（主会话核实**亦成立**）：多 content-block 场景下**现状本就开多个气泡**（index 不同→键不同），A 与现状等价、不引入新缺陷。
    38	- 主会话补充（两家均未提）：**`capabilities()` 当前是 TODO 桩**，壳根本读不到 `streamingGranularity`——D5.1 那条契约目前无任何实现能真正遵守。
    39	
    40	**用户裁决 2026-08-08：选 C，扩本轮 scope 承载。** 本轮由此从纯修复轮变为**「修复 + 契约面设计」轮**，以下两处禁区**定向解除**，其余禁区一律不变。
    41	
    42	| 原禁区 | 解除后允许 | 仍然禁止 |
    43	|---|---|---|
    44	| `app/generated/` 不得改 | 允许**经 codegen 重新生成**（改 schema 源 → 跑既有 codegen → 产物随之更新） | **手改生成产物**——下次 codegen 会丢失，且破坏 `app/contracts/d2/codegen` 的 verify 契约 |
    45	| D1/D2 契约语义不得动 | 允许为 `MessageDeltaEventMessagePayload` **新增一个可选的消息标识字段** | 改既有字段的语义/类型/必选性；改 `KernelClient` 协议 7 方法签名；改 `EventMapping` 既有映射行为（新增字段的填充除外） |
    46	
    47	**C 的硬要求**：
    48	
    49	1. **改 schema 源，不手改产物**（源在 `app/contracts/d2/`）。
    50	2. **新增字段必须可选**：不得让既有消费方（C#/TS 端、`FrameReplayTests` 既有帧）因缺该字段而失败。
    51	3. **既有校验逐条全绿、缺一不可**：`swift build` 全 5 target、帧回放 **30/30**、`typecheck:swift`、`verify:swift`、`verify:type-fidelity-swift`、CI flat-`swiftc` 平价 runner **12/0/1**。
    52	4. **壳侧改用新字段分组**，删除 `(runID,index)` 键与 `+=` 的错误组合。
    53	5. **破坏性反证**：构造「同 run 两条不同 assistant 消息」，确认**修前真的重现重复**、修后不重复。修前那次没重现出来，就说明反证场景没构造对，不得跳过。
    54	6. **不得声称本轮实现了 D5.1 的渲染契约**：`capabilities()` 仍是桩，`streamingGranularity` 缺口本轮不碰。C 解决的是**消息身份**，不是流式粒度——把这个缺口显式写进 evidence，别让它随 C 一起"看起来解决了"。
    55	
    56	### ② 查证并修订阅竞态
    57	
    58	评审指出：`OpenclawGatewayKernelClient.subscribe`（`:391-422`）先返回 stream、再由**未 await 的 `Task`** 发订阅 RPC；`SessionStore.swift:97-103` 也未等待消费任务建立，UI 随后即可 send。

    62	### ③ 把空的 seq 断言换成真能证伪丢帧的检查
    63	
    64	**已核实的事实**：
    65	- `nextSeq()`（`OpenclawGatewayKernelClient.swift:825-833`）是 kernel-client **自己的本地计数器**（`seqByRunID[runID] ?? 0) + 1`），结构上不可能倒退。现有「seq 单调」断言对丢帧一无所证。
    66	- **openclaw 的 wire 帧自带 `payload.seq`**——而 `payload["seq"]` 在整个 kernel-client 里被读取 **0 次**（五个 `.swift` 文件 grep 全为 0）。服务端序号被完整丢弃。
    67	- rounds/0011 成功那次的 wire seq 实测为 **`1,2,3,4,6,7,10`——缺 5、8、9**。
    68	
    69	**本轮要求**：让检查建立在 **wire `seq`** 上而非本地计数器。**并且必须先查清那些缺口是什么**——可能是真丢帧，也可能是 seq 作用域比本订阅更宽（例如含未投递给本订阅者的事件）。**两种解释导出完全不同的断言**，不许在没查清前二选一。
    70	
    71	**破坏性反证是硬要求**：断言写完后必须人为丢弃一帧，确认它**变红**。做不到就说明这条断言和被它取代的那条一样空。

     1	# rounds/0012 ③ messageSeq —— 缺口成因查明，且推翻了先前的观测结论
     2	
     3	日期：2026-08-09。主会话亲跑。
     4	
     5	## 结论
     6	
     7	**`messageSeq` 根本没有缺口。** 先前记录的「缺 3、5」是**观测偏差**，不是丢帧。
     8	
     9	`messageSeq` 是**会话 transcript 的消息计数**（会话级索引），**不是「投递给本订阅者的第几条」**。因此：
    10	
    11	- **「无缺口」不能作为丢帧断言**——即便真有缺口也可能完全合法。
    12	- **`messageSeq` 单独无法检测丢帧。** 能写的有效断言是**单调非递减**（可捕获乱序），不是无缺口。
    13	
    14	## 1. 源码判定（走的是 ② 教训里那条免费路径）
    15	
    16	`kernels/openclaw/src/gateway/server-session-events.ts:189-215`：
    17	
    18	```ts
    19	let messageSeq = asPositiveSafeInteger(update.messageSeq);
    20	if (messageSeq === undefined) {
    21	  // Updates from raw transcript events may not carry seq; fall back to the
    22	  // current transcript line count for cursor-compatible live history.
    23	  ...
    24	  messageSeq = ... await readSessionMessageCountAsync({ ... })
    25	}
    26	```
    27	
    28	注释与 `readSessionMessageCountAsync` 共同坐实：**它是 transcript 侧的计数，服务于「cursor-compatible live history」**，与「本订阅收到了几条」无关。
    29	
    30	**推论**：transcript 里存在但未以 `session.message` 投递给本订阅者的条目（系统行、工具结果、内部条目等）会占号，**缺口因此是合法的**。写「无缺口」断言必然误报——这正是 scope-lock ③ 写死「两种解释导出完全不同的断言，不许在没查清前二选一」的原因。
    31	
    32	## 2. 实测数据：不但缺口合法，本轮压根没有缺口
    33	
    34	带插桩的完整 `session.message` 序列（`evidence/raw/wire-trace.jsonl`）：
    35	
    36	```
    37	messageSeq=1  role=user       produced=0
    38	messageSeq=1  role=user       produced=0   =持平
    39	messageSeq=2  role=assistant  produced=1   ↑+1
    40	messageSeq=3  role=user       produced=0   ↑+1
    41	messageSeq=3  role=user       produced=0   =持平
    42	messageSeq=4  role=assistant  produced=1   ↑+1
    43	messageSeq=5  role=user       produced=0   ↑+1
    44	messageSeq=6  role=assistant  produced=1   ↑+1
    45	```
    46	
    47	**1,1,2,3,3,4,5,6 —— 连续、无缺口、单调非递减，带合法重复**（每条 user 消息产生两帧，同一 transcript 计数）。
    48	
    49	`evidence/live/repro-wire-trace.jsonl` 独立复现同一形态：`1,1,2`。
    50	
    51	## 3. 纠正先前的错误结论
    52	
    53	`instrumented-run-findings.md` §2 记的是「实测 `messageSeq` 序列 `1,1,3,3,5,5,7`，**缺口真实存在**（缺 3、5）」——**这个结论是错的，此处作废。**
    54	
    55	**成因**：那次观测发生在**插桩存在之前**。当时 `handleSessionMessageEvent` **只在映射失败时打日志**（`events.isEmpty` 分支），于是日志里只有 `role=user` 的帧（映射器对非 assistant 返回空数组），**assistant 帧一条都不留痕**。我把「日志里没看见的号」当成了「缺失的号」。
    56	
    57	补上插桩、看到完整序列后，缺的那些号**正是 assistant 帧**，它们一直都在。
    58	
    59	**这与本轮反复出现的同一类错误同形**：`chat` 是错的事件流、`message.*` 是错的字段层级、「本地丢失已排除」说过头、「无手段隔离日志」是因为只搜了 env——**都是在不完整的观测面上得出确定结论**。
    60	
    61	## 4. 可写的断言与不可写的断言
    62	
    63	| 断言 | 可否 | 理由 |
    64	|---|---|---|
    65	| `messageSeq` **无缺口** | **不可** | transcript 侧计数，未投递条目合法占号 |
    66	| `messageSeq` **单调非递减**（同一 session 内） | **可** | 捕获乱序；重复合法故不能用严格递增 |
    67	| 用 `messageSeq` **检测丢帧** | **不可** | 该字段不承载「投递了几条」的信息，本层无此信号 |
    68	
    69	**丢帧检测在本层做不到**——这是如实结论，不是暂缓。要做需要一个 per-subscription 的投递计数，openclaw 当前不提供。**登记为待办，不在本轮伪造一个做不到的断言。**
    70	
    71	---
    72	
    73	## 5. 实施：只加了那条能写的断言
    74	
    75	`EventAssertionCollector`（`CLIRunner.swift`）新增**第 4 条不变量：wire `messageSeq` 单调非递减**。
    76	
    77	**两域分离是这次实现的重点**（历史教训：`a07dc67` 混用两域导致 `2→21→4→30` 倒退，由对抗审 T-044 抓出）：
    78	
    79	| | 断言 1 | 断言 4（新增） |
    80	|---|---|---|
    81	| 验的对象 | **D2 事件的 `.seq`** —— kernel-client 自己的 per-run 本地计数器 | **wire `payload.messageSeq`** —— openclaw 会话级 transcript 计数 |
    82	| 状态字段 | `lastSeqByRunScope` / `seqViolations` | `lastMessageSeq` / `messageSeqViolationsStorage` |
    83	| 能证伪什么 | 同 run 内 D2 seq 倒退（F3 回归） | wire 侧乱序 |
    84	
    85	代码层面的分离手段：两组状态字段互不共享；`recordMessageSeq` 的文档注释点名引用 `EventMapping.swift:138-145` 与 `a07dc67` 事故；hook 签名是 `(Int) -> Void` 传裸整数、**不传 `EventMessageUnion`**，从类型上杜绝两域互相顶替。
    86	
    87	`messageSeq` 的进入路径：`OpenclawGatewayKernelClient` 上加一个**非协议**的旁路 hook（`setWireMessageSeqObserver`），在 `handleSessionMessageEvent` 里**早于 `role=="assistant"` 过滤**触发——因为 `messageSeq` 在 user/assistant 帧上都有（实测序列本就是两种角色交替）。**未改 D2 schema、未改协议签名。**
    88	
    89	### 验收（主会话独立复跑）

    91	| 检查 | 结果 |
    92	|---|---|
    93	| 洁净重建 + 帧回放 | **38/38 PASS**（36 → +2：倒退检出、合法重复不误报） |
    94	| CI flat-`swiftc` 平价 runner | **12 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 DEGRADED** |
    95	| `typecheck:swift` / `verify:swift` / `verify:type-fidelity-swift` / TS runner | 全绿 |
    96	| 禁区（`app/contracts` / `app/generated` / `kernels` / `app/server` / `app/deploy` / `app/parity`） | **无新增改动** |

    98	### 破坏性反证（主会话亲做，双向）
    99	
   100	把判定改成恒不成立（`if let last = ..., false, messageSeq < last`）→ **37/38**，**恰好「倒退 1,2,1 必须变红」那条转红**；「合法序列 1,1,2,3,3,4,5,6 不误报」那条**仍绿**——证明后者不是靠同一个判定蒙混过关。复原后 38/38。
   101	
   102	> 附一次过程失误：第一次破坏用的正则是 `seq < last`，与实际写法 `messageSeq < last` 不符，**未生效**，却跑出 38/38。若不打印实际代码行核对，就会把「没破坏成功」读成「破坏了也不红」。与本轮 §6.2 那次「空检查」同形，第二次才做对。

    24	//        error（见 EventMapping.swift）。
    25	//   F7 — prettyPrint 统一递归脱敏 auth/token 等凭证字段，不再明文打印。
    26	//   F8 — shutdown/transportClosed/stop 三条 sessionEnd 路径共享一个"已产出 terminal"标记，去重。

    55	    // MARK: F1 — send/stop 的 session 级互斥锁（D1 v3.1 §9.3，v3.6 继承）
    56	    //
    57	    // interrupt() 本轮仍是 TODO 桩，因此完整互斥矩阵里涉及 interrupt_in_progress 的分支（stop 优先
    58	    // 仲裁等）本轮不适用——这里只需要覆盖 send()/stop() 两两互斥：任一方法执行时若锁不是 idle，
    59	    // 一律 reject(session_locked)，不做特殊仲裁。
    60	    private enum SessionLockState: Equatable, CustomStringConvertible {
    61	        case idle
    62	        case sendPending
    63	        case stopInProgress
    64	
    65	        var description: String {
    66	            switch self {
    67	            case .idle: return "idle"

    70	            }
    71	        }
    72	    }

    75	    /// NOTE-1（T-047 grok 复核，真挂起 bug 修复）：`waitForPendingStopTerminal` 里 await 着的
    76	    /// `PendingStop.waiter` 现在有三种可能的唤醒结果，不再是单纯的 `Bool`「是否超时」——旧代码只
    77	    /// 区分 true/false 两态，导致"transport 关闭"这个第三种场景无法被安全表达：要么被误当成"没
    78	    /// 超时"（继续假装 succeeded），要么干脆没有任何值可以 resume（旧 bug：pendingStop 被直接从
    79	    /// `pendingStops` 移除，waiter 从此没人 resume，`stop()` 永久挂起）。
    80	    enum StopWaitOutcome {
    81	        /// 由 `handleAgentEvent` 观察到对应的 aborted lifecycle 帧，正常终态确认。
    82	        case terminalObserved
    83	        /// 等待窗口耗尽（生产默认 5 秒），诚实报超时，继续走 delete 收尾。
    84	        case timedOut
    85	        /// 等待过程中 transport 关闭——`resolvePendingStopForTransportClose` 已经代发
    86	        /// `operation_completed(aborted_effect_unknown)` 镜像、标记 `terminalEmitted`，并清理了
    87	        /// 全部派生状态。`stop()` 见到这个值必须如实抛错，不能假装 succeeded/timed_out。
    88	        case transportClosed
    89	    }

    91	    // MARK: F6/M3 — stop() 的 pending 状态（adapter 铸造的唯一 operationId + 等待终态确认）
    92	    private struct PendingStop {

    95	        // stop() 的文档注释），不能一直沿用发起 abort 前可能陈旧的本地缓存值。

    97	        var terminalEmitted: Bool = false
    98	        var waiter: CheckedContinuation<StopWaitOutcome, Never>?

   100	        // 掉的 reqId 列表——由 `forceDenyPendingApprovalsBeforeStop` 在 sessions.abort 之前填好（见
   101	        // stop() 方法体），供 `handleAgentEvent` 的 lifecycle(aborted) 分支把它们塞进这个 run 的
   102	        // `TurnCompleteEvent.forceResolvedApprovals`。空数组（没有 pending approval 需要强制处理）是
   103	        // 绝大多数 stop() 调用的常态，不是遗漏。
   104	        var forceResolvedApprovalReqIDs: [String] = []
   105	    }
   106	    private var pendingStops: [String: PendingStop] = [:]
   107	
   108	    /// M3：测试专用的 stop() 等待超时覆盖（秒）——生产默认 5 秒（D1 v3 §9.3），测试用一个短得多的
   109	    /// 值验证"超时"这条路径，不用真的等 5 秒。`nil` 时 stop() 使用生产默认值。
   110	    private var testSupportStopTimeoutSecondsOverride: Int?
   111	
   112	    /// NOTE-A（T-049 grok 对抗审复核揪出的中等竞态，本轮修复）：`forceDenyPendingApprovalsBeforeStop`
   113	    /// 现在是一个 drain 循环（见该函数文档注释）——每轮结束后重新检查该 session 是否有新到的 pending
   114	    /// 审批，直到某轮检查为空才允许 stop() 继续发 sessions.abort。为防止（理论上不该出现，但不能假装
   115	    /// 不可能）一个持续产生审批请求的 run 让这个循环无限跑下去，加一个迭代轮次上限——生产默认
   116	    /// `forceDenyDrainDefaultMaxRounds`，测试用这个覆盖值验证"超过上限如实 throw、不静默死循环"这条
   117	    /// 路径，不用真的喂 50 轮。`nil` 时使用生产默认值。
   118	    private var testSupportForceDenyDrainMaxRoundsOverride: Int?
   119	
   120	    // MARK: F8 — 三条 sessionEnd 路径（shutdown/transportClosed/stop）共享的去重标记
   121	    private var sessionTerminalEmitted: Set<String> = []
   122	
   123	    // MARK: - rounds/0012 ② 返工：send 侧屏障（订阅竞态收口，见 subscribe()/send() 文档注释）
   124	    //
   125	    // 上一版把竞态收口放在 subscribe() 自己身上（等订阅 RPC 落地才 return stream）——推翻理由见
   126	    // subscribe() 文档注释（违反 D1、且把 CI flat-swiftc 平价 runner 从 12/0/1 打穿到必然悬挂）。
   127	    // 本版把屏障挪到 send()（以及 stop()，同一屏障复用）开头：等待"该 session 的订阅 RPC 已经
   128	    // dispatch"，不等它的响应——两者的区别、以及为什么只能是前者，完整论证见 send() 文档注释。
   129	
   130	    /// 有条目 = 该 session 的 subscribe() 已经被调用，但它背景 Task 里真正发起
   131	    /// `sessions.messages.subscribe` RPC 这一步尚未发生——`send()`/`stop()` 开头据此判断要不要等。
   132	    /// 没有条目（从未 subscribe 过，或已经 dispatch 完毕）的 session 一律不等，见
   133	    /// `awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending` 文档注释。
   134	    private var subscriptionDispatchPending: Set<String> = []
   135	    /// 正在 `awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending` 里挂起等待的 `send()`/`stop()` 调用——
   136	    /// `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched` 唤醒时一次性清空并 resume 全部（理论上同一 session 同一时刻
   137	    /// 只会有一个 send_pending/stop_in_progress 锁持有者在等，数组只是防御性地允许多个）。
   138	    private var subscriptionDispatchWaiters: [String: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>]] = [:]
   139	    /// Test-only：人为延迟 subscribe() 标记"该 session 订阅 RPC 已 dispatch"的时刻——生产路径恒为
   140	    /// nil，不生效。用于确定性地构造 send 侧屏障的破坏性反证（不加延迟的话，"背景 Task 是否先于
   141	    /// send() 跑到 dispatch 点"取决于 Swift actor 调度巧合，不可靠地复现，见
   142	    /// `testSupportSetSubscribeDispatchDelay` 与 FrameReplayTests.swift 对应测试的文档注释）。
   143	    private var testSupportSubscribeDispatchDelayNanoseconds: UInt64?
   144	
   145	    /// subscribe() 同步前缀里调用——登记"这个 session 有一个尚未 dispatch 的订阅 RPC"。必须在
   146	    /// subscribe() 自己的同步代码里调用（`Task {}` 派生之前），这样"登记"这一步严格先于
   147	    /// subscribe() 返回、也严格先于调用方有机会发起任何后续 `send()`/`stop()`（两者对同一个 actor
   148	    /// 的方法调用不可能重叠执行）——不存在"先调用 send() 才补登记"的竞态窗口。
   149	    private func beginTrackingSubscriptionDispatch(sessionID: String) {
   150	        subscriptionDispatchPending.insert(sessionID)
   151	    }
   152	
   153	    /// subscribe() 背景 Task 里，真正调用 `request(method:"sessions.messages.subscribe",...)`
   154	    /// **之前**的最后一步——标记"已经 dispatch"并唤醒所有在等待的 `send()`/`stop()`。**不等这条 RPC
   155	    /// 的响应**——`request()` 本身、以及它底层传输（生产是 `URLSessionWebSocketTask.send` 的完成
   156	    /// 回调，测试桩是 `testSupportStubRPC` 闭包）都还没有开始跑，这里只标记"即将把这个 RPC 交出去"
   157	    /// 这一刻。kernelKey 查找失败（unknown session，根本不会真的发起这条 RPC）的分支也调用它——
   158	    /// 否则那种极端情况下会有等待者永久卡住（虽然它们自己的 kernelKey 查找也会紧接着独立失败，双重
   159	    /// 保险不嫌多）。
   160	    private func markSubscriptionRpcDispatched(sessionID: String) {
   161	        subscriptionDispatchPending.remove(sessionID)
   162	        let waiters = subscriptionDispatchWaiters.removeValue(forKey: sessionID) ?? []
   163	        for waiter in waiters { waiter.resume() }
   164	    }
   165	
   166	    /// `send()`/`stop()` 开头调用。若该 session 当前有一个尚未 dispatch 的订阅 RPC 在途，挂起直到
   167	    /// `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched` 唤醒；否则（**从未 subscribe 过**，或订阅 RPC 已经 dispatch
   168	    /// 过）立即返回、不挂起——两种"不等"场景共享同一个分支，是有意合并，不是漏判：
   169	    /// "从未 subscribe"根本没有 `subscriptionDispatchPending` 条目可等（要求它去等一个永远不会有人
   170	    /// 调用 `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched` 的信号，就是制造一个永久挂起——D1 §2.2 send() 本身并不
   171	    /// 要求先 subscribe，任务书明确点名的 fixture 场景"只 createSession + send、不 subscribe"必须
   172	    /// 立即可用）。
   173	    private func awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending(sessionID: String) async {
   174	        guard subscriptionDispatchPending.contains(sessionID) else { return }
   175	        await withCheckedContinuation { (continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
   176	            subscriptionDispatchWaiters[sessionID, default: []].append(continuation)
   177	        }
   178	    }
   179	
   180	    /// Test-only 存取器——供 subscribe() 背景 Task 读取人为延迟（跨越 actor 隔离需要这一层 `await
   181	    /// self.` 包装，与文件其余 `testSupport*` 方法同款风格）。
   182	    private func subscribeDispatchDelayNanosecondsForTesting() -> UInt64? {
   183	        testSupportSubscribeDispatchDelayNanoseconds
   184	    }

   186	    // MARK: SG-5 事件映射需要的最小逐 session/run 状态缓存
   187	    //
   188	    // openclaw 的 wire 事件本身不总是自带 D2 判别联合要求的全部字段（最典型的是 turnComplete/
   189	    // operationCompleted/approvalRequest 都要求非空的 runID，但 session.approval 事件本身不带
   190	    // runId；approvalRequest 还要求 toolCallID，但 openclaw 的审批 payload 本身不带 toolCallId）。
   191	    // F1 订正：run/tool/usage 三个缓存改为 **per-run**（用 runId 做键），不再是 per-session——
   192	    // per-session 缓存在并发/连续多个 run 的场景下会把上一个 run 的残留值串给下一个 run（对抗审
   193	    // T-044 F1 复现场景），per-run 键天然避免这个问题：新 run 开始时缓存自然是空的。
   194	    private var lastRunIDBySessionID: [String: String] = [:]
   195	    private var runIDsBySessionID: [String: Set<String>] = [:] // 供 session 结束时批量清理 per-run 缓存
   196	    private var lastToolCallIDByRunID: [String: String] = [:]
   197	    private var lastUsageByRunID: [String: (input: Int, output: Int)] = [:]
   198	
   199	    // MARK: M1 — approval 双向 join（agent(stream:"approval") <-> session.approval(phase:"pending")）
   200	    //
   201	    // F4 上一轮只缓存 approvalId -> toolCallId，遗漏了这次审批**真实归属的 runId**——`session.approval`
   202	    // 落地时只能退回到全 session 的 `lastRunIDBySessionID`，在多个 run 交替产生审批时会把 approval
   203	    // 错误关联到"当前最新活跃的 run"，而不是这次审批实际所在的 run（对抗审 T-045 M1 复现：
   204	    // agent approval-A(run-A) 之后 agent approval-B(run-B) 到达，把 lastRunIDBySessionID 刷新成
   205	    // run-B，随后姗姗来迟的 session.approval(approval-A) 会被错误按成 run-B）。同时上一轮完全没有
   206	    // 处理"session.approval 先于对应 agent(stream:approval) 帧到达"这个方向——直接丢弃，approval
   207	    // _request 永久丢失，即使 agent 帧随后真的到达也不会补发。本轮改为按 approvalId 做真正的双向
   208	    // 缓冲 join：agent 帧先到就缓冲 {runID,toolCallID}，session.approval 先到就缓冲整个 payload，
   209	    // 谁后到就用先到的那份补全信息，立即产出（且只产出一次）。
   210	    private struct AgentApprovalInfo {
   211	        let runID: String
   212	        let toolCallID: String
   213	    }
   214	    private var agentApprovalInfoByApprovalID: [String: AgentApprovalInfo] = [:]

   226	    // MARK: M3（D1 §6.2 stop-path 强制 deny）—— approval_request 已经真正产出给调用方之后的"pending，
   227	    // 等待人工决策"态
   228	    //
   229	    // 上面 `agentApprovalInfoByApprovalID`/`pendingSessionApprovalByApprovalID` 只是 join 之前的临时
   230	    // 缓冲区——一旦 join 成功、`emitApprovalRequestIfPossible` 把 approvalRequest 真正 yield 给调用方，
   231	    // 这两张表的条目就被移除了，不再追踪"这个 reqId 现在处于 pending、还没人给出决策"这件事。
   232	    // `respondApproval()` 本轮仍是 TODO 桩（见 KernelClient.swift 头注释），永远不会有真实决策落地，
   233	    // 因此这个态一旦进入就会一直 pending，直到 stop() 强制介入（D1 §6.2 M3 定序 + §6.3 stop 黑名单批量
   234	    // deny）——这里新增的这张表就是 stop() 用来"知道该 session 名下当前还有哪些审批在 pending"的唯一
   235	    // 权威来源。`openclawKind` 存真实的 openclaw 侧 kind（"exec"/"plugin"/"system-agent"，不是 D2 收窄
   236	    // 后的 KindElement）——见 `forceDenyPendingApprovalsBeforeStop` 的文档注释。
   237	    private struct PendingApprovalAwaitingDecision {
   238	        let runID: String
   239	        let openclawKind: String
   240	    }
   241	    private var pendingApprovalsByReqID: [String: PendingApprovalAwaitingDecision] = [:]
   242	    /// 反向索引：session 结束时批量清理上面这张表——同款模式，仿 `approvalIDsBySessionID`（M5）。
   243	    private var pendingApprovalReqIDsBySessionID: [String: Set<String>] = [:]
   244	
   245	    /// NOTE-A（T-049 grok 对抗审复核）：force-deny drain 循环（见 `forceDenyPendingApprovalsBeforeStop`）
   246	    /// 的迭代轮次上限——防御性兜底，不是 D1 协议要求的具体数值。D1 §9 一 session 一次一个 active run +
   247	    /// stop() 已经把该 session 锁进 `stopInProgress`（阻塞新 `send()`，不会有新 run）的前提下，drain
   248	    /// 循环每一轮只可能因为"仍在这个即将被 abort 的、唯一的 run"持续产生新的审批请求而继续——正常场景
   249	    /// 一两轮内必然收敛为空；这里选 50 只是给"理论上不该出现但不能假装不可能"的极端场景（比如一个
   250	    /// bug 让某个 run 疯狂连续请求审批）一个诚实的上限，超限时如实 throw，不是静默死循环。
   251	    private static let forceDenyDrainDefaultMaxRounds = 50

   253	    // MARK: - Test-only：拦截 RPC（不需要真实 WebSocket 连接）
   254	    //
   255	    // M3/M6 rework：真 actor 级测试需要驱动真实的 send()/stop() 方法体本身（包括它们发起的
   256	    // sessions.send/sessions.abort/sessions.delete RPC），而不是像上一轮那样直接 seed 内部状态、
   257	    // 绕开方法体——但这个项目没有真实网络可用。`testSupportRPCResponders` 按 RPC method 名注册一个
   258	    // "request(method:) 被调用时应该返回什么/抛什么错"的闭包；`request()` 内部命中该表时直接走
   259	    // 这条路径，完全不碰 `task`（未连接的 `freshClient()` 场景下 task 本来就是 nil）。生产路径不受
   260	    // 影响——这张表默认为空，`request()` 只有命中表项时才短路。
   261	    private var testSupportRPCResponders: [String: @Sendable (JSONObject) async throws -> JSONObject] = [:]
   262

   266	    /// 内排序"，这里只是让无 run 归属的事件也至少非递减，不是额外的契约承诺。
   267	    private var seqFallbackBySessionID: [String: Int] = [:]

   278	    // MARK: - 连接 + 握手（recipe §2）
   279	
   280	    /// 建立 WS 连接并完成 challenge -> connect 握手，返回 hello-ok 里协商到的 scopes——供调用方
   281	    /// 核验"确实拿到了 operator.write/operator.admin 等写权限"（recipe §2 里最容易踩的坑：
   282	    /// client.id/mode 不是 "cli"/"cli" 时握手仍会成功，但 scopes 会被服务端清空）。
   283	    public func connect() async throws -> [String] {
   284	        let t = urlSession.webSocketTask(with: endpoint)
   285	        self.task = t
   286	        t.resume()
   287	        receiveLoopTask = Task { await self.receiveLoop() }
   288	
   289	        let challenge = try await waitForNextEvent(named: "connect.challenge")
   290	        prettyPrint("RECV connect.challenge", challenge)
   291	
   292	        // 握手 params 逐字段对照 recipe §2 末尾"一次完整、可复制的最小 connect 请求"。
   293	        let connectParams: JSONObject = [
   294	            "minProtocol": 3,
   295	            "maxProtocol": 4,
   296	            "client": [
   297	                "id": "cli",
   298	                "version": "0.0.1",
   299	                "platform": "darwin",
   300	                "mode": "cli",
   301	            ] as JSONObject,
   302	            "caps": [] as [String],
   303	            "role": "operator",
   304	            "scopes": ["operator.admin"] as [String],
   305	            "auth": ["token": token] as JSONObject,
   306	        ]
   307	        let hello = try await request(method: "connect", params: connectParams)
   308	        prettyPrint("RECV hello-ok (connect response payload)", hello)
   309	
   310	        if let proto = hello["protocol"] as? Int {
   311	            lastHandshakeProtocol = proto
   312	        }
   313	        if let auth = hello["auth"] as? JSONObject, let scopes = auth["scopes"] as? [String] {
   314	            lastHandshakeScopes = scopes
   315	        }
   316	        return lastHandshakeScopes
   317	    }
   318	
   319	    /// NOTE-3（整洁度，两端核对一致）：C# 侧 `Disconnect()` 原来只 `Abort()` 了 `ClientWebSocket`
   320	    /// 却没有 `Dispose()`（未释放底层非托管资源），已在 C# 侧补上。Swift 这里的等价物是
   321	    /// `URLSessionWebSocketTask.cancel(with:reason:)`——它同时中断挂起的 IO 并让 URLSession 释放
   322	    /// 该 task 的底层资源，是 Foundation 侧“Abort+Dispose”合一的正确收尾调用；`task = nil` 之后
   323	    /// ARC 释放最后一个引用。核对结论：两端在这个方法里语义已经一致，Swift 侧不需要额外改动。
   324	    public func disconnect() {
   325	        receiveLoopTask?.cancel()
   326	        task?.cancel(with: .normalClosure, reason: nil)
   327	        task = nil
   328	    }
