  1128	    /// 每个尚未产出过 terminal 的活跃 session 补一条 sessionEnd(reason:.transportClosed)——F8：与
  1129	    /// shutdown/stop 两条路径共享 `sessionTerminalEmitted` 去重标记，不会对同一个 session 重复/
  1130	    /// 矛盾地产出 sessionEnd；然后 `failAllPending` 收尾所有还在等待的 RPC/事件流。抽成独立方法只是
  1131	    /// 为了让测试能直接触发这条路径（M6：真实驱动 shutdown+transport close 两条路径，不是像上一轮
  1132	    /// 那样用两次同样的 shutdown 帧代替）。
  1133	    private func handleTransportClosed(error: Error) {
  1134	        for (ourSessionID, continuation) in eventContinuations {
  1135	            // NOTE-1（T-047 grok 复核，真挂起 bug 修复）：若这个 session 有一个仍在等待
  1136	            // aborted-run 终态确认的 pendingStop，必须先把它的
  1137	            // operation_completed(aborted_effect_unknown) 镜像 yield 进 continuation、唤醒等待中的
  1138	            // stop()，再产出 sessionEnd(transportClosed)——顺序对应 D1 §9.3"先终态、后
  1139	            // session_end"的既有约定（stop() 成功路径同样是先 emitOperationCompletedMirror 再
  1140	            // emitStopSessionEndAndFinish），也必须赶在下面 failAllPending 把 continuation
  1141	            // finish(throwing:) 之前做（之后 yield 静默丢弃）。
  1142	            resolvePendingStopForTransportClose(sessionID: ourSessionID)
  1143	
  1144	            guard !sessionTerminalEmitted.contains(ourSessionID) else { continue }
  1145	            sessionTerminalEmitted.insert(ourSessionID)
  1146	            continuation.yield(makeSessionEndEventForTransportClosed(
  1147	                ourSessionID: ourSessionID,
  1148	                nextSeq: { self.nextSeq(runID: nil, sessionID: ourSessionID) }
  1149	            ))
  1150	        }
  1151	        failAllPending(error: error)
  1152	    }
  1153	
  1154	    private func failAllPending(error: Error) {
  1155	        for (_, continuation) in pending {
  1156	            continuation.resume(throwing: error)
  1157	        }
  1158	        pending.removeAll()
  1159	        for (_, waiter) in oneShotEventWaiters {
  1160	            waiter.resume(throwing: error)
  1161	        }
  1162	        oneShotEventWaiters.removeAll()
  1163	        // M5：transport 异常路径上一轮只 finish 了 continuation，从不清理per-session派生缓存
  1164	        // （seq/toolCallId/usage/approval 双向缓冲/pendingStop/锁/terminal 标记）——这里改为跟
  1165	        // `finishEventContinuation` 共享同一份 `clearSessionDerivedCaches`。
  1166	        for (sessionID, cont) in eventContinuations {
  1167	            cont.finish(throwing: error)
  1168	            clearSessionDerivedCaches(sessionID: sessionID)
  1169	        }
  1170	        eventContinuations.removeAll()
  1171	    }
  1172	
  1173	    // MARK: - SG-10 rounds/0012 ① 临时插桩（取证工具，不是修复；见
  1174	    // rounds/0012/evidence/item1-mechanism-localization.md §3/§4 与 scope-lock.md ①）
  1175	    //
  1176	    // `handleSessionMessageEvent`/`handleAgentEvent`/`handleSessionApprovalEvent`/
  1177	    // `handleShutdownEvent` 四个被消费 case 现在只有映射失败/旁路才打印（`prettyPrint`），成功产出
  1178	    // D2 事件的路径完全静默——rounds/0011 的运行日志因此一条承载 assistant 文本的帧都没留下，无法
  1179	    // 判断 content 形状、`index` 取值、delta 是否重复。本节只做观察，不改变任何映射语义或
  1180	    // `continuation.yield` 的内容/时序，由 `AGENT_KERNEL_WIRE_TRACE` 环境变量整体开关；未设置时
  1181	    // `wireTraceCollector` 全程保持 nil，四个 handler 内部新增的 `wireTraceCollector?.append(event)`
  1182	    // 都是 Optional chaining 的 no-op，输出与插桩之前逐字节一致。
  1183	
  1184	    /// 仅在被 `traceWireDispatch` 追踪的分派期间非 nil；四个 handler（及它们共用的
  1185	    /// `emitApprovalRequestIfPossible`）内部已有的 `continuation.yield(event)` 调用点各自紧跟一行
  1186	    /// `wireTraceCollector?.append(event)`——yield 本身的参数与调用时机一个字都没变，这里只是在同一
  1187	    /// 行旁边多看一眼、记下来。
  1188	    private var wireTraceCollector: [EventMessageUnion]?
  1189	
  1190	    /// 包一层：`handleIncoming` 分派给四个已消费 case 时统一走这里。`AGENT_KERNEL_WIRE_TRACE` 未设置
  1191	    /// 时直接调用 `handler()`，不做任何额外的事——这是"默认关闭"的唯一判断点，函数体第一行就返回。
  1192	    /// 设置时打开收集器、跑 handler（handler 内部的 `continuation.yield` 调用不受影响，只是被就地
  1193	    /// 多记一笔)、把收集到的事件与原始帧一起落盘。`previousCollector` 保存/恢复是防御性的重入保护
  1194	    /// （目前的调用路径下不会真的重入，但成本几乎为零）。
  1195	    private func traceWireDispatch(eventName: String, frame: JSONObject, _ handler: () -> Void) {
  1196	        guard let tracePath = wireTraceEnabledPath() else {
  1197	            handler()
  1198	            return
  1199	        }
  1200	        let previousCollector = wireTraceCollector
  1201	        wireTraceCollector = []
  1202	        handler()
  1203	        let produced = wireTraceCollector ?? []
  1204	        wireTraceCollector = previousCollector
  1205	        appendWireTraceLine(buildWireTraceRecord(eventName: eventName, frame: frame, produced: produced), toPath: tracePath)
  1206	    }
  1207	
  1208	    /// 把一次分派的「wire 帧 + 产出的 D2 事件」拼成一条可写盘的 JSON 对象。`frame` 先过
  1209	    /// `redactedCopy`（`OpenclawWire.swift`，F7/M4 rework 记录的敏感键判定，`isSensitiveKey` 文档
  1210	    /// 注释）再落盘——复用既有脱敏实现，不新写一套。`produced` 为空时附一份从帧本身摘出的
  1211	    /// `emptyHint`（如 `message.role`/`stream`），供人工判断"为什么这条帧没有映射出任何事件"而不用
  1212	    /// 每次都展开整份帧。
  1213	    private func buildWireTraceRecord(eventName: String, frame: JSONObject, produced: [EventMessageUnion]) -> JSONObject {
  1214	        let safeFrame = (redactedCopy(frame) as? JSONObject) ?? frame
  1215	        var record: JSONObject = [
  1216	            "recordedAt": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: Date()),
  1217	            "dispatchCase": eventName,
  1218	            "wireFrame": safeFrame,
  1219	            "producedCount": produced.count,
  1220	            "producedEvents": produced.map { wireTraceEventSummary($0) },
  1221	        ]
  1222	        if produced.isEmpty, let hint = wireTraceEmptyHint(eventName: eventName, payload: frame["payload"] as? JSONObject) {
  1223	            record["emptyHint"] = hint
  1224	        }
  1225	        return record
  1226	    }
  1227	
  1228	    // MARK: - rounds/0012 ③ wire messageSeq 旁路上报（诊断钩子，不是 KernelClient 协议的一部分）
  1229	    //
  1230	    // 背景（`rounds/0012/evidence/item3-messageseq.md`）：openclaw `session.message` wire 帧的
  1231	    // `payload.messageSeq` 是**会话 transcript 的消息计数**（源码判定：
  1232	    // `kernels/openclaw/src/gateway/server-session-events.ts:189-215`，"fall back to the current
  1233	    // transcript line count for cursor-compatible live history"）——它既不是 D1/D2 承诺的 per-run
  1234	    // `seq`（那是 `nextSeq(runID:sessionID:)` 维护的 kernel-client 本地计数器，结构上不可能倒退，见
  1235	    // 上面"MARK: F3"小节），也从未出现在 D2 11 变体判别联合的任何一个字段里（`EventMessageUnion`/
  1236	    // `MessageDeltaEventMessagePayload` 等逐个检查过，没有一个字段是它）。要在 `CLIRunner` 的
  1237	    // `EventAssertionCollector` 上加一条基于它的不变量断言（见 CLIRunner.swift
  1238	    // `EventAssertionCollector.recordMessageSeq` 文档注释），必须先想清楚它怎么从这个 actor 内部走
  1239	    // 出去——**不能**为此改 D2 schema（塞进某个 payload 会引入一个和"消息标识" `messageID`（rounds/
  1240	    // 0012 ①' 新增的那个可选字段）语义完全不同的东西，却挤在同一次 schema 改动窗口里，职责不清），
  1241	    // 也**不能**改 `KernelClient` 协议签名（7 个方法本身与这个诊断信号无关）。
  1242	    //
  1243	    // 选择的路径：**闭包旁路**，不是新开一条 `AsyncStream`。理由与代价：
  1244	    //   - 新开一条 `AsyncStream<Int>`（类似 `subscribe()` 自己那一套 continuation 存取/session
  1245	    //     键控/finish 生命周期管理）能在类型层面把两个域分得更彻底，但要求这条新流跟主事件流一样
  1246	    //     正确处理 session 结束/stop/shutdown/transport-closed 四条收尾路径的 `finish()`，否则
  1247	    //     `CLIRunner` 里消费它的那个 Task 会在会话结束后继续挂起——这份复杂度对"只是把一个已经在读
  1248	    //     的整数旁路传出去"这件事而言不成比例。
  1249	    //   - 复用现成的 `wireTraceCollector` 那条路（env var 开关 + 落盘 JSONL，见上面"SG-10 rounds/
  1250	    //     0012 ① 临时插桩"小节）更省事，但那条路径服务的是**离线事后取证**（`CLIRunner` 一次真实
  1251	    //     e2e 跑完之后人工翻 JSONL），且默认关闭（依赖 `AGENT_KERNEL_WIRE_TRACE` 环境变量）——
  1252	    //     `EventAssertionCollector.printFinalAssertions()` 在 `observeTask` join 之后立即读取收集
  1253	    //     器状态，如果 messageSeq 只落在磁盘上，`CLIRunner` 还得反过来在跑完之后单独解析这份 trace
  1254	    //     文件才能喂给断言收集器，把一个本该"边收边核对"的实时断言拆成两阶段，还额外要求一个不相关
  1255	    //     的环境变量必须被设置——这和被取代的"空 seq 断言"一样脆弱（断言能不能生效取决于一个本不该
  1256	    //     相关的开关）。
  1257	    //   - 闭包旁路：`CLIRunner` 在 `subscribe()` 之前调用一次 `setWireMessageSeqObserver` 注册，
  1258	    //     `handleSessionMessageEvent` 每次读到 `payload.messageSeq` 就同步调一次——不需要开关、不
  1259	    //     需要落盘、不需要额外的 stream 生命周期管理，默认（未注册）是纯粹的 no-op。
  1260	    //
  1261	    // 代价（如实登记，不是没有）：
  1262	    //   1. 这是给 `OpenclawGatewayKernelClient` 这个**具体类**新增的公开方法，不在 `KernelClient`
  1263	    //      协议 7 方法之列——只持有 `any KernelClient` 抽象类型的调用方看不到这个钩子，这是有意的
  1264	    //      （D1 §2 的窄腰协议本就不该为一个诊断信号扩面）。
  1265	    //   2. 闭包是从这个 actor **自己的隔离执行上下文**同步调用的，而 `EventAssertionCollector` 的
  1266	    //      其余三条不变量都只在 `observeTask` 消费主事件流的那个 Task 里被写——两者是不同的并发上
  1267	    //      下文。这个新钩子因此不能沿用"只在 observeTask 里写、join 之后读"那条 happens-before 论
  1268	    //      证，`EventAssertionCollector` 那一侧为此新增了一把独立的锁，见该类 `recordMessageSeq`/
  1269	    //      `messageSeqLock` 的文档注释。
  1270	    //   3. 只在 `handleSessionMessageEvent` 这一条 dispatch 路径调用——如果 openclaw 未来在其它事
  1271	    //      件类型上也开始携带 messageSeq，这里不会自动覆盖。现状（`item3-messageseq.md` §1 源码判
  1272	    //      定）messageSeq 只出现在 `session.message`，与当前覆盖范围一致，如实标注为当前范围而非
  1273	    //      将来的承诺。
  1274	
  1275	    /// 未注册（`nil`，默认值）时 `handleSessionMessageEvent` 里的调用点是纯粹的 no-op，行为与新增
  1276	    /// 之前逐字节一致——与 `wireTraceCollector` 同一条"默认关闭、不改变主路径行为"的纪律。
  1277	    private var onWireMessageSeqObserved: (@Sendable (Int) -> Void)?
  1278	
  1279	    /// 供 `CLIRunner`（生产路径）与 `FrameReplayTests`（`@testable import`，测试路径）调用——跨
  1280	    /// actor 隔离设置上面的钩子，命名与调用约定对齐同文件 `testSupportStubRPC` 那一个已有的
  1281	    /// "`@escaping @Sendable` 闭包，通过显式方法赋给 actor-isolated 存储属性"先例，不是本文件第一
  1282	    /// 次这么做。
  1283	    func setWireMessageSeqObserver(_ observer: @escaping @Sendable (Int) -> Void) {
  1284	        onWireMessageSeqObserved = observer
  1285	    }
  1286	
  1287	    private func handleIncoming(_ data: Data) {
  1288	        guard let frame = try? decodeFrame(data) else { return }
  1289	        guard let type = frame["type"] as? String else { return }
  1290	
  1291	        switch type {
  1292	        case "res":
  1293	            guard let id = frame["id"] as? String else { return }
  1294	            guard let continuation = pending.removeValue(forKey: id) else { return }
  1295	            let ok = (frame["ok"] as? Bool) ?? false
  1296	            if ok {
  1297	                let payload = (frame["payload"] as? JSONObject) ?? [:]
  1298	                continuation.resume(returning: payload)
  1299	            } else {
  1300	                let err = (frame["error"] as? JSONObject) ?? [:]
  1301	                let code = (err["code"] as? String) ?? "unknown"
  1302	                let message = err["message"] as? String
  1303	                continuation.resume(throwing: KernelClientError.rpcRejected(code: code, message: message))
  1304	            }
  1305	
  1306	        case "event":
  1307	            guard let eventName = frame["event"] as? String else { return }
  1308	            if let waiter = oneShotEventWaiters.removeValue(forKey: eventName) {
  1309	                let payload = (frame["payload"] as? JSONObject) ?? [:]
  1310	                waiter.resume(returning: payload)
  1311	                return
  1312	            }
  1313	            // session.message 之外还要分发 agent(command_output/lifecycle/thinking/error/item/
  1314	            // approval)、session.approval、全局 shutdown 三类 wire 事件——D2 11 变体里除
  1315	            // message_delta/tool_call 之外的大多数都不是从 session.message 来的。
  1316	            switch eventName {
  1317	            case "session.message":
  1318	                traceWireDispatch(eventName: eventName, frame: frame) { handleSessionMessageEvent(frame) }
  1319	            case "agent":
  1320	                traceWireDispatch(eventName: eventName, frame: frame) { handleAgentEvent(frame) }
  1321	            case "session.approval":
  1322	                traceWireDispatch(eventName: eventName, frame: frame) { handleSessionApprovalEvent(frame) }
  1323	            case "shutdown":
  1324	                traceWireDispatch(eventName: eventName, frame: frame) { handleShutdownEvent(frame) }
  1325	            default:
  1326	                prettyPrint("RECV event \(eventName) (未处理的旁路事件，原样打印)", frame)
  1327	            }
  1328	
  1329	        default:
  1330	            break
  1331	        }
  1332	    }
  1333	
  1334	    /// 按 openclaw 原生 key 反查我们自己铸造的 sessionID——四个事件 handler（session.message/
  1335	    /// agent/session.approval）共享同一套"payload.sessionKey -> ourSessionID -> continuation"
  1336	    /// 查找逻辑，抽成一个小helper 避免重复。
  1337	    private func ourSessionID(forKernelKey kernelKey: String) -> String? {
  1338	        kernelKeyBySessionID.first(where: { $0.value == kernelKey })?.key
  1339	    }
  1340	
  1341	    private func handleSessionMessageEvent(_ frame: JSONObject) {
  1342	        guard let payload = frame["payload"] as? JSONObject,
  1343	              let kernelKey = payload["sessionKey"] as? String,
  1344	              let ourSessionID = ourSessionID(forKernelKey: kernelKey) else {
  1345	            return
  1346	        }
  1347	        guard let continuation = eventContinuations[ourSessionID] else { return }
  1348	
  1349	        // rounds/0012 ③：wire messageSeq 旁路上报——必须在这里（早于下面 `events.isEmpty` 的 early
  1350	        // return），因为 messageSeq 对**每一条** session.message 帧都存在，包括 role=="user" 的回显
  1351	        // 帧（`item3-messageseq.md` §2 实测的 `1,1,2,3,3,4,5,6` 序列本身就交替着 user/assistant 两
  1352	        // 种角色的帧——两个 1 分别是同一条 user 消息的 status+delta 两帧）。下面
  1353	        // `mapOpenclawSessionMessageToKernelEvents` 只关心 role=="assistant"（见 EventMapping.swift
  1354	        // 头注释①），那条"只看 assistant"的规则是 D2 事件映射自己的语义，不能延伸到这里——messageSeq
  1355	        // 是 transcript 层面的计数，与"这一帧有没有映射出 D2 事件"是两件独立的事。**这是本函数里唯一
  1356	        // 一处不产出/不影响任何 D2 事件的旁路代码**——`onWireMessageSeqObserved` 只读，不改变
  1357	        // `payload`、不影响下面的映射结果，见该属性上方"MARK: - rounds/0012 ③"的完整文档注释（路径
  1358	        // 选择理由 + 代价）。
  1359	        if let messageSeq = jsonInt(payload["messageSeq"]) {
  1360	            onWireMessageSeqObserved?(messageSeq)
  1361	        }
  1362	
  1363	        // 顺带刷新 runId/usage 缓存——session.message 的 session 快照里带 activeRunIds，assistant
  1364	        // 消息自己带 usage。F1：usage 缓存改为 **per-run**（用刚刷新出来的 runId 做键），不再是
  1365	        // per-session，避免上一个 run 的残留 usage 串给下一个 run 的 turn_complete。
  1366	        var currentRunID = lastRunIDBySessionID[ourSessionID]
  1367	        if let sessionSnapshot = payload["session"] as? JSONObject,
  1368	           let activeRunIDs = sessionSnapshot["activeRunIds"] as? [Any],
  1369	           let firstRunID = activeRunIDs.first as? String {
  1370	            lastRunIDBySessionID[ourSessionID] = firstRunID
  1371	            runIDsBySessionID[ourSessionID, default: []].insert(firstRunID)
  1372	            currentRunID = firstRunID
  1373	        }
  1374	        if let message = payload["message"] as? JSONObject, let usage = message["usage"] as? JSONObject,
  1375	           let input = jsonInt(usage["input"]), let output = jsonInt(usage["output"]),
  1376	           let runID = currentRunID {
  1377	            lastUsageByRunID[runID] = (input: input, output: output)
  1378	        }
  1379	
  1380	        let runIDHint = currentRunID
  1381	        let sid = ourSessionID
  1382	        let events = mapOpenclawSessionMessageToKernelEvents(
  1383	            payload, ourSessionID: ourSessionID, runIDHint: runIDHint,
  1384	            nextSeq: { self.nextSeq(runID: runIDHint, sessionID: sid) }
  1385	        )
   520	    /// `dispatch` 无序化保证。这次改为**换个位置**收口——在 `send()`/`stop()` 开头设一道屏障，而不是
   521	    /// 卡在 `subscribe()` 自己身上。`subscribe()` 这边只新增两行配合：进入本方法同步前缀时调用
   522	    /// `beginTrackingSubscriptionDispatch`（登记"这个 session 有一个尚未 dispatch 的订阅 RPC"），
   523	    /// 背景 `Task` 里真正调用 `request(method:"sessions.messages.subscribe",...)` **之前**调用
   524	    /// `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched`（登记完成、唤醒等待中的 `send()`/`stop()`）。完整设计取舍
   525	    /// （尤其是"为什么只等『RPC 已 dispatch』、不等『RPC 已 ack』"，以及这个折衷放弃了什么）记在
   526	    /// `send()` 的文档注释里，不在这里重复。
   527	    ///
   528	    /// **协议签名不带 `throws`**（见 `KernelClient.swift`：`func subscribe(session:) async ->
   529	    /// AsyncThrowingStream<...>`，scope-lock 明文禁止改这 7 个方法签名）——因此订阅 RPC 失败（RPC
   530	    /// 本身抛错，或响应体里 `subscribed:false`）**不能**让本方法向调用方抛错，只能塞进已经交给调用
   531	    /// 方的这个 `AsyncThrowingStream`：`continuation.finish(throwing:)` 让它在第一次
   532	    /// `for try await` 迭代时就抛出同一个错误。调用方现有的错误路径
   533	    /// （`SessionStore.consumeEvents` 的 `session.streamError = describeError(error)` ->
   534	    /// `SessionDetailView` 的红色横幅）原样覆盖这种情况，不需要新的错误通道。这一段行为原样保留自
   535	    /// SG-4/SG-5，未受本轮任何一版改动影响。
   536	    ///
   537	    /// 本地事件续体（`eventContinuations[ourSessionID]`）**仍然在 RPC 之前、同步完成**——这一点没
   538	    /// 变（`evidence/item2-subscribe-race.md` §1b 已实测坐实 `AsyncThrowingStream` 默认
   539	    /// `.unbounded` 缓冲，先注册好续体，之后到达的帧不会因为消费者还没开始 `for try await` 而丢）。
   540	    public func subscribe(session: SessionHandle) async -> AsyncThrowingStream<EventMessageUnion, Error> {
   541	        let ourSessionID = session.sessionID
   542	        let (stream, continuation) = AsyncThrowingStream<EventMessageUnion, Error>.makeStream()
   543	        eventContinuations[ourSessionID] = continuation
   544	        beginTrackingSubscriptionDispatch(sessionID: ourSessionID)
   545	
   546	        Task {
   547	            guard let kernelKey = await self.kernelKey(for: ourSessionID) else {
   548	                // 这条 RPC 根本不会被发起——照样标记 dispatch，否则等待中的 send()/stop() 会永久
   549	                // 卡住（它们自己紧随其后的 kernelKey 查找也会独立失败，这里只是不让它们死在屏障上）。
   550	                await self.markSubscriptionRpcDispatched(sessionID: ourSessionID)
   551	                continuation.finish(throwing: KernelClientError.protocolMismatch("unknown session \(ourSessionID)"))
   552	                return
   553	            }
   554	            if let delayNanoseconds = await self.subscribeDispatchDelayNanosecondsForTesting() {
   555	                // Test-only（见 `testSupportSetSubscribeDispatchDelay` 文档注释）——生产路径这里
   556	                // 恒为 nil，下面这行不会被执行到。
   557	                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: delayNanoseconds)
   558	            }
   559	            await self.markSubscriptionRpcDispatched(sessionID: ourSessionID)
   560	            do {
   561	                // includeApprovals:true——不带这个 flag 收不到 session.approval 事件
   562	                // （`SessionsMessagesSubscribeParamsSchema` 的 `includeApprovals` 是 opt-in，默认不
   563	                // 推送），approvalRequest 映射的现场 grounding 全部建立在这个 flag 打开的前提上。
   564	                let result = try await self.request(
   565	                    method: "sessions.messages.subscribe",
   566	                    params: ["key": kernelKey, "includeApprovals": true]
   567	                )
   568	                prettyPrint("RECV sessions.messages.subscribe result", result)
   569	                if let subscribed = result["subscribed"] as? Bool, !subscribed {
   570	                    continuation.finish(throwing: KernelClientError.protocolMismatch("subscribe returned subscribed:false"))
   571	                } else {
   572	                    // M1：消费 subscribe 响应里的 `approvalReplay`（authoritative 的当前 pending
   573	                    // 审批快照，见下方 consumeApprovalReplay 文档注释）。
   574	                    await self.consumeApprovalReplay(result, kernelKey: kernelKey)
   575	                }
   576	            } catch {
   577	                continuation.finish(throwing: error)
   578	            }
   579	        }
   580	
   581	        return stream
   582	    }
   583	
   584	    public func interrupt(session: SessionHandle, options: InterruptRequestMessagePayload) async throws -> InterruptResultPayload {
   585	        throw KernelClientError.notImplemented("interrupt() 本轮 TODO 桩——L1 闭环没有 active run 需要 interrupt")
   586	    }
   587	
   588	    /// D1 §2.5 stop()。**M3 rework（收 T-045 codex 确认性再审 MUST-FIX，在 F6 基础上第二次收残）**：
   589	    /// F6 只解决了"operationId 不共享"和"delete 前不等终态"两个问题，但重写本身引入/遗留了三类新
   590	    /// 缺陷（codex 独立复现）：
   591	    ///   ① `abortedRunId==nil`（无 active run）与"等待超时"两条路径只让 Promise 知道结果，从不给
   592	    ///      `subscribe()` 事件流补一条 `operation_completed` 镜像——只订阅事件流、不等 Promise 的
   593	    ///      观察者完全看不到这次 stop 操作本身的终态。
   594	    ///   ② active-run 路径把"这次 stop 操作成功与否"和"sessions.delete 这一步资源回收是否成功"
   595	    ///      两件事混为一谈：`handleAgentEvent` 在 delete **之前**就已经用 `succeeded` 发出了
   596	    ///      operation_completed（这个时机是对的，D1 §9.3 要求先有终态再有 session_end），但 Promise
   597	    ///      的 outcome 却在 delete **之后**重新按 `deleted` 布尔值计算——如果 delete 恰好返回
   598	    ///      `deleted:false`，Promise 报 `.rejected`，与已经发出的 Event `.succeeded` 直接矛盾。
   599	    ///      修法：outcome 只由"等没等到终态确认"（timedOut）决定，不再看 `deleted`——delete 是这次
   600	    ///      stop 操作的收尾资源回收步骤，和"abort 本身有没有成功"是两件事，不应该互相污染判定，这样
   601	    ///      Promise 和已经发出的 Event 天然保持一致（因为它们不再有两个独立的信息来源）。
   602	    ///   ③ `sessions.abort`/`sessions.delete` 抛错时整个函数直接向上抛出，`stopInProgress` 锁、
   603	    ///      `pendingStops` 条目都不会被释放——真实复现：第一次 stop() 因传输错误抛出后，锁永久卡在
   604	    ///      `stop_in_progress`，第二次 stop() 会被误判成"另一个 stop 正在进行"而拒绝
   605	    ///      （`session_locked`），即使第一次调用早就已经失败结束。修法：`do/catch` 包裹两次 RPC，
   606	    ///      catch 里统一释放锁 + 清理 pendingStop + 发一条 `operation_completed(outcome:.rejected)`
   607	    ///      镜像，然后把原始错误重新抛给调用方（stop() 这次调用确实失败了，调用方需要知道）。
   608	    ///
   609	    /// `PendingStop.affectedRunID` 在 abort 之后立刻用 `abortResult.abortedRunId`（权威值）覆盖——
   610	    /// 不能一直沿用发起 abort 前的本地缓存 `lastRunIDBySessionID`，那个值可能陈旧，会让
   611	    /// `handleAgentEvent` 里 `pendingForRun.affectedRunID == runID` 的相等判断永远不成立、白等到
   612	    /// 超时（codex 复现的具体机制）。
   613	    ///
   614	    /// **rounds/0012 ② 复用 send() 的订阅 dispatch 屏障**：函数体第一行同样
   615	    /// `await awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending(...)`——完整设计取舍见 `send()` 文档注释，这里
   616	    /// 只记为什么 `stop()` 也要等：`stop()` 会在有 active run 时产出 `turn_complete(cancelled)` 等
   617	    /// 事件（见下方 `waitForPendingStopTerminal`），这些事件同样要经过已建立的订阅才能被调用方观察
   618	    /// 到，与 `send()` 面对的是同一类"订阅是否已经登记"的风险，理应共享同一道屏障。`interrupt()`/
   619	    /// `respondApproval()` 仍是 TODO 桩、函数体第一行就 `throw .notImplemented`，从不触达任何 RPC，
   620	    /// 没有屏障可加、也不需要加。
   621	    public func stop(session: SessionHandle) async throws -> StopResultPayload {
   622	        await awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending(sessionID: session.sessionID)
   623	        guard let kernelKey = kernelKeyBySessionID[session.sessionID] else {
   624	            throw KernelClientError.protocolMismatch("unknown session \(session.sessionID)")
   625	        }
   626	
   627	        let currentLock = lockStateBySessionID[session.sessionID] ?? .idle
   628	        guard currentLock == .idle else {
   629	            throw KernelClientError.rpcRejected(
   630	                code: "session_locked",
   631	                message: "stop() rejected: session \(session.sessionID) lock state is \(currentLock), expected idle (D1 v3.1 §9.3)"
   632	            )
   633	        }
   634	        lockStateBySessionID[session.sessionID] = .stopInProgress
   635	
   636	        let operationID = "op-stop-\(UUID().uuidString)"
   637	        let affectedRunIDBeforeAbort = lastRunIDBySessionID[session.sessionID]
   638	        pendingStops[session.sessionID] = PendingStop(operationID: operationID, affectedRunID: affectedRunIDBeforeAbort)
   639	
   640	        do {
   641	            // D1 §6.2 M3（强制定序，rework）：取消当前 run 之前，若该 session 名下存在 pending
   642	            // 审批，必须先把它们强制 deny 掉、确认内核已接受，才能发起 sessions.abort——见
   643	            // `forceDenyPendingApprovalsBeforeStop` 文档注释。这一步必须在 `sessions.abort` 之前
   644	            // 完成，且失败时（RPC 抛错/内核未确认 denied）不能继续往下发 abort——直接落进下面的
   645	            // catch 统一收尾（锁释放+pendingStop 清理+operation_completed(rejected) 镜像），不能
   646	            // 假装"反正等会儿再看"。
   647	            let forceResolvedApprovalReqIDs = try await forceDenyPendingApprovalsBeforeStop(sessionID: session.sessionID)
   648	            pendingStops[session.sessionID]?.forceResolvedApprovalReqIDs = forceResolvedApprovalReqIDs
   649	
   650	            let abortResult = try await request(method: "sessions.abort", params: ["key": kernelKey])
   651	            prettyPrint("RECV sessions.abort result", abortResult)
   652	
   653	            // D1 v3 §9.3："stop() 调用时存在 active run，适配器必须先完成该 run 的强制取消并产出
   654	            // TurnCompleteEvent(cancelled)...确认该事件已经进入 subscribe() 流之后，才能产出
   655	            // SessionEndEvent(reason:'stopped')"。有界等待（不是无限悬挂），交由 handleAgentEvent 在
   656	            // 观察到对应 aborted lifecycle 帧时唤醒；超时则诚实继续（不让调用方永久悬挂），并把
   657	            // outcome 记成 .timedOut。
   658	            //
   659	            // **是否需要等待，由 `sessions.abort` 自己的返回值判断，不是本地缓存的 `affectedRunID`**
   660	            // ——现场实测（scratchpad/openclaw-iso3 隔离环境）坐实：`lastRunIDBySessionID` 只在收到
   661	            // 新 run 时刷新，一个 run 正常 turnComplete 之后这个缓存不会被清空；如果 stop() 在该 run
   662	            // 早已自然结束之后才被调用，`sessions.abort` 会诚实回报 `{"abortedRunId":null,
   663	            // "status":"no-active-run"}`——这种情况下压根不会有任何 aborted lifecycle 帧到达。改为
   664	            // 直接读 `abortResult.abortedRunId`——非空才说明这次 abort 真的中止了一个活跃 run，才需要
   665	            // 等待其终态；为 nil 就没有等待的意义。
   666	            let actuallyAbortedRunID = abortResult["abortedRunId"] as? String
   667	            var timedOut = false
   668	            if let actuallyAbortedRunID = actuallyAbortedRunID {
   669	                // M3：用权威值覆盖，不再信任 abort 前的本地缓存（见函数文档注释）。
   670	                pendingStops[session.sessionID]?.affectedRunID = actuallyAbortedRunID
   671	                let timeoutSeconds = testSupportStopTimeoutSecondsOverride ?? 5
   672	                let waitOutcome = await waitForPendingStopTerminal(sessionID: session.sessionID, timeoutSeconds: timeoutSeconds)
   673	                switch waitOutcome {
   674	                case .transportClosed:
   675	                    // NOTE-1（T-047 grok 复核，真挂起 bug 修复）：等待过程中 transport 已经关闭——
   676	                    // `resolvePendingStopForTransportClose`（见 `handleTransportClosed`）已经代发
   677	                    // `operation_completed(aborted_effect_unknown)` 镜像、标记 `terminalEmitted`，
   678	                    // 且 `clearSessionDerivedCaches` 已经清理了包括本函数 `stopInProgress` 锁在内的
   679	                    // 全部派生状态。这里绝不能假装 succeeded/timed_out 继续往下走——`sessions.delete`
   680	                    // 在 transport 已断的情况下多半也会失败，即使侥幸命中测试桩"成功"了，也会跟已经
   681	                    // 发出的镜像终态矛盾（M3 修的正是 Promise/Event 矛盾这类问题）。如实抛错，交给
   682	                    // 下面的 catch 统一收尾——此时 pendingStop/lock 已经是空的，catch 里的清理调用
   683	                    // 都是安全的 no-op。
   684	                    throw KernelClientError.transport("stop() aborted: transport closed while waiting for aborted-run terminal confirmation")
   685	                case .timedOut:
   686	                    // M3：等待超时也必须给事件流补一条 operation_completed 镜像——上一轮只有 Promise
   687	                    // 知道超时了，只订阅事件流的观察者永远看不到这个 run 的终态。
   688	                    emitOperationCompletedMirror(
   689	                        sessionID: session.sessionID, operationID: operationID,
   690	                        affectedRunID: actuallyAbortedRunID, outcome: .timedOut
   691	                    )
   692	                    // NOTE-2：超时路径也要标记 terminalEmitted——否则迟到的 aborted lifecycle 帧仍
   693	                    // 可能在 clearSessionDerivedCaches 清缓存前，被 handleAgentEvent 的
   694	                    // `!pendingForRun.terminalEmitted` 判断当成"还没发过 terminal"又发一组。
   695	                    pendingStops[session.sessionID]?.terminalEmitted = true
   696	                    timedOut = true
   697	                case .terminalObserved:
   698	                    timedOut = false
   699	                }
   700	            } else {
   250	    case .error(let e):
   251	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   252	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   253	    case .turnComplete(let e):
   254	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   255	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   256	    case .sessionEnd(let e):
   257	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   258	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   259	    case .capabilityChanged(let e):
   260	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   261	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   262	    case .operationCompleted(let e):
   263	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   264	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   265	    case .approvalBufferResolved(let e):
   266	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   267	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   268	    }
   269	    return out
   270	}
   271	
   272	/// `produced` 为空时的便利摘要——只是把已经在 `payload` 里的相关字段单独摘出来，方便脚本/人眼不用
   273	/// 逐层展开整份帧；不是我们自己推断出的解释，帧本身才是权威来源（找不到就诚实返回 nil，不编造）。
   274	/// 逐 dispatch case 关注点不同：`session.message` 看 `message.role`（`EventMapping.swift:172-178`
   275	/// 的过滤条件——非 assistant 角色不产出事件）；`agent` 看 `stream`/`data.phase`（`handleAgentEvent`
   276	/// 的 `default: break` 与 `lifecycle` phase 过滤都在这两个字段上判断）；`session.approval` 看
   277	/// `phase`（只有 `pending` 会继续处理，`terminal` 分支已有 `prettyPrint` 记录跳过原因）；`shutdown`
   278	/// 没有已知的"0 事件但需要解释"场景，如实返回 nil。
   279	func wireTraceEmptyHint(eventName: String, payload: JSONObject?) -> JSONObject? {
   280	    switch eventName {
   281	    case "session.message":
   282	        guard let role = (payload?["message"] as? JSONObject)?["role"] else { return nil }
   283	        return ["message.role": role]
   284	    case "agent":
   285	        var hint: JSONObject = [:]
   286	        if let stream = payload?["stream"] { hint["stream"] = stream }
   287	        if let phase = (payload?["data"] as? JSONObject)?["phase"] { hint["data.phase"] = phase }
   288	        return hint.isEmpty ? nil : hint
   289	    case "session.approval":
   290	        guard let phase = payload?["phase"] else { return nil }
   291	        return ["phase": phase]
   292	    default:
   293	        return nil
   294	    }
   295	}

kernels/openclaw/CONTRIBUTING.md:72:- Do not submit test or CI-config fixes for failures already red on `main` CI. If a failure is already visible in the [main branch CI runs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions), it's a known issue the Maintainer team is tracking, and a PR that only addresses those failures will be closed automatically. If you spot a _new_ regression not yet shown in main CI, report it as an issue first.

    64	  if (!message || typeof message !== "object" || Array.isArray(message)) {

    66	  }

    71	/** Computes an oversized raw transcript tail window for projected chat history. */
    72	export function resolveSessionHistoryTailReadOptions(limit: number): {
    73	  maxMessages: number;
    74	  maxLines: number;
    75	} {
    76	  const requested = Math.max(1, Math.floor(limit));
    77	  const rawWindow = requested * 20 + 20;
    78	  return {
    79	    maxMessages: rawWindow,
    80	    maxLines: rawWindow,
    81	  };
    82	}

    84	function resolveCursorSeq(cursor: string | undefined): number | undefined {
    85	  if (!cursor) {
    86	    return undefined;
    87	  }
    88	  const normalized = cursor.startsWith("seq:") ? cursor.slice(4) : cursor;
    89	  if (!/^\d+$/.test(normalized)) {
    90	    return undefined;
    91	  }
    92	  const value = Number(normalized);
    93	  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value > 0 ? value : undefined;
    94	}

   124	function paginateSessionMessages(
   125	  messages: SessionHistoryMessage[],
   126	  limit: number | undefined,
   127	  cursor: string | undefined,
   128	): PaginatedSessionHistory {
   129	  // Cursors point at transcript sequence watermarks. The returned page is the
   130	  // window before that cursor, matching "older messages" pagination.
   131	  const cursorSeq = resolveCursorSeq(cursor);
   132	  let endExclusive = messages.length;
   133	  if (typeof cursorSeq === "number") {
   134	    endExclusive = messages.findIndex((message, index) => {
   135	      const seq = resolveMessageSeq(message);
   136	      if (typeof seq === "number") {
   137	        return seq >= cursorSeq;
   138	      }
   139	      return index + 1 >= cursorSeq;
   140	    });
   141	    if (endExclusive < 0) {
   142	      endExclusive = messages.length;
   143	    }
   144	  }
   145	  const start = typeof limit === "number" && limit > 0 ? Math.max(0, endExclusive - limit) : 0;
   146	  const paginatedMessages = messages.slice(start, endExclusive);
   147	  const firstSeq = resolveMessageSeq(paginatedMessages[0]);
   148	  return buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   149	    messages: paginatedMessages,
   150	    hasMore: start > 0,
   151	    ...(start > 0 && typeof firstSeq === "number" ? { nextCursor: String(firstSeq) } : {}),
   152	  });
   153	}
   154	
   155	/** Builds the display history snapshot and raw transcript sequence watermark. */
   156	export function buildSessionHistorySnapshot(params: {
   157	  rawMessages: unknown[];
   158	  maxChars?: number;
   159	  limit?: number;
   160	  cursor?: string;
   161	  rawTranscriptSeq?: number;
   162	  totalRawMessages?: number;
   163	}): SessionHistorySnapshot {
   164	  const projected = projectChatDisplayMessagesWithState(params.rawMessages, {
   165	    maxChars: params.maxChars ?? DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS,
   166	  });
   167	  const visibleMessages = toSessionHistoryMessages(projected.messages);
   168	  const history = paginateSessionMessages(visibleMessages, params.limit, params.cursor);
   169	  if (
   170	    !params.cursor &&
   171	    typeof params.totalRawMessages === "number" &&
   172	    params.totalRawMessages > params.rawMessages.length &&
   173	    history.messages.length > 0
   174	  ) {
   175	    const firstSeq = resolveMessageSeq(history.messages[0]);
   176	    history.hasMore = true;
   177	    if (typeof firstSeq === "number") {
   178	      history.nextCursor = String(firstSeq);
   179	    }
   180	  }
   181	  const rawHistoryMessages = toSessionHistoryMessages(params.rawMessages);
   182	  return {
   183	    history,
   184	    rawTranscriptSeq:
   185	      params.rawTranscriptSeq ??
   186	      resolveMessageSeq(rawHistoryMessages.at(-1)) ??
   187	      rawHistoryMessages.length,
   188	    turnBoundaryPending: projected.turnBoundaryPending,
   189	  };
   190	}

   207	/** Reads one bounded active-path page that resumes appends and resets after discontinuities. */
   208	export async function readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta(
   209	  params: SessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDeltaParams,
   210	): Promise<SessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDeltaResult> {
   211	  const { cursor, maxBytes, maxMessages, ...target } = params;
   212	  let result: ReturnType<typeof readVisibleMessageDelta>;
   213	  try {
   214	    result = readVisibleMessageDelta(target, {
   215	      ...(cursor !== undefined ? { cursor } : {}),
   216	      ...(maxBytes !== undefined ? { maxBytes } : {}),
   217	      ...(maxMessages !== undefined ? { maxMessages } : {}),
   218	    });
   219	  } catch (error) {
   220	    if (isSessionTranscriptProjectionUnavailableError(error)) {
   221	      return { kind: "unavailable", reason: "projection_rebuilding" };
   222	    }
   223	    throw error;
   224	  }
   225	  if (result.kind !== "page") {
   226	    return result;
   227	  }
   228	  const { events, ...page } = result;
   229	  return {
   230	    ...page,
   231	    entries: events.flatMap((entry) =>
   232	      projectVisibleMessageEntry({
   233	        event: entry.event,
   234	        parentId: entry.parentId,
   235	        seq: entry.seq,
   236	      }),
   237	    ),
   238	  };
   239	}

    11	  SessionTranscriptReadScope,

    13	} from "./session-accessor.sqlite-contract.js";

    17	  resolveSqliteTranscriptReadScope,
    18	  toDatabaseOptions,

    21	const RAW_TRANSCRIPT_CURSOR_VERSION = 1;
    22	const DEFAULT_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_MAX_EVENTS = 1_000;
    23	const DEFAULT_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000;
    24	const MAX_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_EVENTS = 10_000;
    25	const MAX_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
    26	
    27	type RawTranscriptCursor = {
    28	  agentId: string;
    29	  generation: string;
    30	  lastSeq: number;
    31	  sessionId: string;
    32	  version: typeof RAW_TRANSCRIPT_CURSOR_VERSION;
    33	};
    34	
    35	type ResolvedTranscriptReadScope = ReturnType<typeof resolveSqliteTranscriptReadScope>;
    36	
    37	function normalizeRawDeltaLimit(
    38	  value: number | undefined,
    39	  fallback: number,
    40	  maximum: number,
    41	  name: string,
    42	): number {
    43	  const resolved = value ?? fallback;
    44	  if (!Number.isInteger(resolved) || resolved < 1 || resolved > maximum) {
    45	    throw new RangeError(`${name} must be an integer between 1 and ${String(maximum)}`);
    46	  }
    47	  return resolved;
    48	}
    49	
    50	function encodeRawTranscriptCursor(cursor: RawTranscriptCursor): string {
    51	  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(cursor), "utf8").toString("base64url");
    52	}
    53	
    54	function parseRawTranscriptCursor(value: string): RawTranscriptCursor | undefined {
    55	  if (value.length > 4_096) {
    56	    return undefined;
    57	  }
    58	  try {
    59	    const parsed = JSON.parse(
    60	      Buffer.from(value, "base64url").toString("utf8"),
    61	    ) as Partial<RawTranscriptCursor>;
    62	    if (
    63	      parsed.version !== RAW_TRANSCRIPT_CURSOR_VERSION ||
    64	      typeof parsed.agentId !== "string" ||
    65	      typeof parsed.sessionId !== "string" ||
    66	      typeof parsed.generation !== "string" ||
    67	      !Number.isSafeInteger(parsed.lastSeq) ||
    68	      (parsed.lastSeq ?? -2) < -1
    69	    ) {
    70	      return undefined;
    71	    }
    72	    return parsed as RawTranscriptCursor;
    73	  } catch {
    74	    return undefined;
    75	  }
    76	}
    77	
    78	function bootstrapCursor(
    79	  scope: ResolvedTranscriptReadScope,
    80	  generation: string,
    81	): RawTranscriptCursor {
    82	  return {
    83	    agentId: scope.agentId,
    84	    generation,
    85	    lastSeq: -1,
    86	    sessionId: scope.sessionId,
    87	    version: RAW_TRANSCRIPT_CURSOR_VERSION,
    88	  };
    89	}
    90	
    91	/** Read one generation-consistent raw transcript page without parsing excluded payload rows. */
    92	export function readSqliteTranscriptRawDelta(
    93	  scope: SessionTranscriptReadScope,
    94	  limits: SessionTranscriptRawDeltaLimits = {},
    95	): SessionTranscriptRawDeltaResult {
    96	  const resolved = resolveSqliteTranscriptReadScope(scope);
    97	  const maxEvents = normalizeRawDeltaLimit(
    98	    limits.maxEvents,
    99	    DEFAULT_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_MAX_EVENTS,
   100	    MAX_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_EVENTS,
   101	    "maxEvents",
   102	  );
   103	  const maxBytes = normalizeRawDeltaLimit(
   104	    limits.maxBytes,
   105	    DEFAULT_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_MAX_BYTES,
   106	    MAX_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_BYTES,
   107	    "maxBytes",
   108	  );
   109	  const database = openOpenClawAgentDatabase(toDatabaseOptions(resolved));
   110	  return runSqliteDeferredTransactionSync(
   111	    database.db,
   112	    () => readRawDeltaInTransaction(database.db, resolved, limits.cursor, maxEvents, maxBytes),
   113	    {
   114	      databaseLabel: database.path,
   115	      operationLabel: "session transcript raw delta",
   116	    },
   117	  );
   118	}
   119	
   120	function readRawDeltaInTransaction(
   121	  database: import("node:sqlite").DatabaseSync,
   122	  scope: ResolvedTranscriptReadScope,
   123	  encodedCursor: string | undefined,
   124	  maxEvents: number,
   125	  maxBytes: number,
   126	): SessionTranscriptRawDeltaResult {
   127	  const db = getSessionKysely(database);
   128	  const state = executeSqliteQueryTakeFirstSync(
   129	    database,
   130	    db
   131	      .selectFrom("session_transcript_generations")
   132	      .select("generation")
   133	      .where("session_id", "=", scope.sessionId),
   134	  );
   135	  if (!state) {
   136	    return { kind: "missing" };
   137	  }
   138	
   139	  const initialCursor = bootstrapCursor(scope, state.generation);
   140	  const reset = (
   141	    reason: Extract<SessionTranscriptRawDeltaResult, { kind: "reset" }>["reason"],
   142	  ) => ({
   143	    kind: "reset" as const,
   144	    cursor: encodeRawTranscriptCursor(initialCursor),
   145	    reason,
   146	  });
   147	  const cursor =
   148	    encodedCursor !== undefined ? parseRawTranscriptCursor(encodedCursor) : initialCursor;
   149	  if (!cursor) {
   150	    return reset("invalid_cursor");
   151	  }
   152	  if (cursor.agentId !== scope.agentId || cursor.sessionId !== scope.sessionId) {
   153	    return reset("scope_mismatch");
   154	  }
   155	  if (cursor.generation !== state.generation) {
   156	    return reset("generation_mismatch");
   157	  }
   158	  const frontier = executeSqliteQueryTakeFirstSync(
   159	    database,
   160	    db
   161	      .selectFrom("transcript_events")
   162	      .select("seq")
   163	      .where("session_id", "=", scope.sessionId)
   164	      .orderBy("seq", "desc")
   165	      .limit(1),
   166	  );
   167	  const maxSeq = frontier ? normalizeSqliteNumber(frontier.seq) : -1;
   168	  if (cursor.lastSeq > maxSeq) {
   169	    return reset("invalid_cursor");
   170	  }
   171	
   172	  const metadata = executeSqliteQuerySync(
   173	    database,
   174	    db
   175	      .selectFrom("transcript_events")
   176	      .select([
   177	        "seq",
   178	        /* kysely-allow-raw: SQLite byte length avoids fetching or parsing excluded JSON. */
   179	        sql<number>`LENGTH(CAST(event_json AS BLOB)) + 1`.as("serialized_bytes"),
   180	      ])
   181	      .where("session_id", "=", scope.sessionId)
   182	      .where("seq", ">", cursor.lastSeq)
   183	      .orderBy("seq", "asc")
   184	      .limit(maxEvents + 1),
   185	  ).rows.map((row) => ({
   186	    seq: normalizeSqliteNumber(row.seq),
   187	    serializedBytes: normalizeSqliteNumber(row.serialized_bytes),
   188	  }));
   189	
   190	  let serializedBytes = 0;
   191	  let selectedCount = 0;
   192	  for (const row of metadata) {
   193	    if (selectedCount >= maxEvents || serializedBytes + row.serializedBytes > maxBytes) {
   194	      break;
   195	    }
   196	    serializedBytes += row.serializedBytes;
   197	    selectedCount += 1;
   198	  }
   199	  const selectedMetadata = metadata.slice(0, selectedCount);
   200	  const lastSeq = selectedMetadata.at(-1)?.seq ?? cursor.lastSeq;
   201	  const rows =
   202	    selectedCount === 0
   203	      ? []
   204	      : executeSqliteQuerySync(
   205	          database,
   206	          db
   207	            .selectFrom("transcript_events")
   208	            .select(["event_json", "seq"])
   209	            .where("session_id", "=", scope.sessionId)
   210	            .where("seq", ">", cursor.lastSeq)
   211	            .where("seq", "<=", lastSeq)
   212	            .orderBy("seq", "asc"),
   213	        ).rows.map((row) => ({
   214	          event: JSON.parse(row.event_json) as TranscriptEvent,
   215	          seq: normalizeSqliteNumber(row.seq),
   216	        }));
   217	  const nextCursor = encodeRawTranscriptCursor({ ...cursor, lastSeq });
   218	  const requiredBytes =
   219	    selectedCount === 0 && metadata[0] ? metadata[0].serializedBytes : undefined;
   220	  return {
   221	    kind: "page",
   222	    cursor: nextCursor,
   223	    events: rows,
   224	    hasMore: selectedCount < metadata.length,
   225	    ...(requiredBytes !== undefined ? { requiredBytes } : {}),
   226	    serializedBytes,
   227	  };
   228	}

     3	title: "Plugin runtime helpers"
     4	sidebarTitle: "Runtime helpers"
     5	read_when:
     6	  - You need to call core helpers from a plugin (TTS, STT, image gen, web search, Gateway, subagent, nodes)
     7	  - You want to understand what api.runtime exposes
     8	  - You are accessing config, agent, or media helpers from plugin code
     9	---
    10	
    11	Reference for the `api.runtime` object injected into every plugin during registration. Use these helpers instead of importing host internals directly.
    12	
    13	<CardGroup cols={2}>
    14	  <Card title="Channel plugins" href="/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins">
    15	    Step-by-step guide that uses these helpers in context for channel plugins.
    16	  </Card>
    17	  <Card title="Provider plugins" href="/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins">
    18	    Step-by-step guide that uses these helpers in context for provider plugins.
    19	  </Card>
    20	</CardGroup>
    21	
    22	```typescript
    23	register(api) {
    24	  const runtime = api.runtime;
    25	}
    26	```
    27	
    28	`api.runtime.version` is the current OpenClaw product version, sourced from the shared version resolver so plugins see the same value the CLI reports.
    29	
    30	## Config loading and writes
    31	
    32	Prefer config that was already passed into the active call path, for example `api.config` during registration or a `cfg` argument on channel/provider callbacks. This keeps one process snapshot flowing through the work instead of reparsing config on hot paths.
    33	
    34	Use `api.runtime.config.current()` only when a long-lived handler needs the current process snapshot and no config was passed to that function. The returned value is readonly; clone or use a mutation helper before editing.
    35	
    36	Tool factories receive `ctx.runtimeConfig` plus `ctx.getRuntimeConfig()`. Use the getter inside a long-lived tool's `execute` callback when config can change after the tool definition was created.
    37	
    38	Persist changes with `api.runtime.config.mutateConfigFile(...)` or `api.runtime.config.replaceConfigFile(...)`. Each write must choose an explicit `afterWrite` policy:
    39	
    40	- `afterWrite: { mode: "auto" }` lets the gateway reload planner decide.
    41	- `afterWrite: { mode: "restart", reason: "..." }` forces a clean restart when the writer knows hot reload is unsafe.
    42	- `afterWrite: { mode: "none", reason: "..." }` suppresses automatic reload/restart only when the caller owns the follow-up.
    43	
    44	The mutation helpers return `afterWrite` plus a typed `followUp` summary so callers can log or test whether they requested a restart. The gateway still owns when that restart actually happens.
    45	
    46	Use `current()`, a passed-in `cfg`, `mutateConfigFile(...)`, or
    47	`replaceConfigFile(...)` for runtime config access and writes.
    48	
    49	For direct SDK imports, prefer the focused config subpaths over the broad `openclaw/plugin-sdk/config-runtime` compatibility barrel: `config-contracts` for types, `runtime-config-snapshot` for current process snapshots, and `config-mutation` for writes. Read entry-scoped values from `api.pluginConfig`; use a supplied tool context only for its runtime-wide config snapshot, and keep plugin-specific merging at that boundary. Bundled plugin tests should mock these focused subpaths directly instead of mocking the broad compatibility barrel.
    50	
    51	Internal OpenClaw runtime code follows the same direction: load config once at the CLI, gateway, or process boundary, then pass that value through. Successful mutation writes refresh the process runtime snapshot and advance its internal revision; long-lived caches should key off the runtime-owned cache key instead of serializing config locally. Long-lived runtime modules have a zero-tolerance scanner for ambient `loadConfig()` calls; use a passed `cfg`, a request `context.getRuntimeConfig()`, or `getRuntimeConfig()` at an explicit process boundary.
    52	
    53	Provider and channel execution paths must use the active runtime config snapshot, not a file snapshot returned for config readback or editing. File snapshots preserve source values such as SecretRef markers for UI and writes; provider callbacks need the resolved runtime view. When a helper may be called with either the active source snapshot or the active runtime snapshot, route through `selectApplicableRuntimeConfig()` before reading credentials.
    54	
    55	## Reusable runtime utilities
    56	
    57	Use inbound `botLoopProtection` facts for bot-authored inbound messages. Core applies the shared in-memory sliding-window guard before session record and dispatch, without tying the policy to one channel. The guard tracks `(scopeId, conversationId, participant pair)` keys, counts both directions of a pair together, applies a cooldown once the window budget is exceeded, and prunes inactive entries opportunistically.
    58	
    59	Channel plugins that expose this behavior to operators should prefer the shared `channels.defaults.botLoopProtection` shape for baseline budgets, then layer channel/provider-specific overrides on top. The shared config uses seconds because it is user-facing:
    60	
    61	```typescript
    62	type ChannelBotLoopProtectionConfig = {
    63	  enabled?: boolean;
    64	  maxEventsPerWindow?: number;
    65	  windowSeconds?: number;
    66	  cooldownSeconds?: number;
    67	};
    68	```
    69	
    70	Pass normalized bot-pair facts with the resolved turn. Core resolves defaults, unit conversion, and `enabled` semantics:
    71	
    72	```typescript
    73	return {
    74	  channel: "example",
    75	  routeSessionKey,
    76	  storePath,
    77	  ctxPayload,
    78	  recordInboundSession,
    79	  runDispatch,
    80	  botLoopProtection: {
    81	    scopeId: "account-1",
    82	    conversationId: "channel-1",
    83	    senderId: "bot-a",
    84	    receiverId: "bot-b",
    85	    config: channelConfig.botLoopProtection,
    86	    defaultsConfig: runtimeConfig.channels?.defaults?.botLoopProtection,
    87	    defaultEnabled: allowBotsMode !== "off",
    88	  },
    89	};
    90	```
    91	
    92	Use `openclaw/plugin-sdk/pair-loop-guard-runtime` directly only for custom
    93	two-party event loops that do not go through the shared inbound reply runner.
    94	
    95	## Runtime namespaces
    96	
    97	<AccordionGroup>
    98	  <Accordion title="api.runtime.agent">
    99	    Agent identity, directories, and session management.
   100	
   101	    ```typescript
   102	    // Resolve the agent's working directory (agentId is required)
   103	    const agentDir = api.runtime.agent.resolveAgentDir(cfg, agentId);
   104	
   105	    // Resolve agent workspace
   106	    const workspaceDir = api.runtime.agent.resolveAgentWorkspaceDir(cfg, agentId);
   107	
   108	    // Get agent identity
   109	    const identity = api.runtime.agent.resolveAgentIdentity(cfg);
   110	
   111	    // Get default thinking level
   112	    const thinking = api.runtime.agent.resolveThinkingDefault({
   113	      cfg,
   114	      provider,
   115	      model,
   116	    });
   117	
   118	    // Validate a user-provided thinking level against the active provider profile
   119	    const policy = api.runtime.agent.resolveThinkingPolicy({ provider, model });
   120	    const level = api.runtime.agent.normalizeThinkingLevel("extra high");
   121	    if (level && policy.levels.some((entry) => entry.id === level)) {
   122	      // pass level to an embedded run
   123	    }
   124	
   125	    // Get agent timeout
   126	    const timeoutMs = api.runtime.agent.resolveAgentTimeoutMs(cfg);
   127	
   128	    // Ensure workspace exists
   129	    await api.runtime.agent.ensureAgentWorkspace(cfg);
   130	
   131	    // Run an embedded agent turn
   132	    const result = await api.runtime.agent.runEmbeddedAgent({
   133	      sessionId: "my-plugin:task-1",
   134	      runId: crypto.randomUUID(),
   135	      workspaceDir: api.runtime.agent.resolveAgentWorkspaceDir(cfg, agentId),
   136	      prompt: "Summarize the latest changes",
   137	      timeoutMs: api.runtime.agent.resolveAgentTimeoutMs(cfg),
   138	    });
   139	    ```
   140	
   141	    `runEmbeddedAgent(...)` is the neutral helper for starting a normal OpenClaw agent turn from plugin code. It uses the same provider/model resolution and agent-harness selection as channel-triggered replies.
   142	
   143	    `runEmbeddedPiAgent(...)` remains as a deprecated compatibility alias for existing plugins. New code should use `runEmbeddedAgent(...)`.
   144	
   145	    `resolveCliBackendDispatchEligibility({ provider, model, agentId, authProfileId, config, agentDir, workspaceDir })` shares the embedded runner's CLI-backend dispatch decision (route, the backend's declared `subscriptionAuthDispatch` capability, stored credential mode — honoring an explicitly pinned `authProfileId`) with callers that opt embedded runs into `cliBackendDispatch: "subscription-auth"`. It returns `{ provider }` when the run would execute through the CLI backend and `undefined` when it stays on the direct passthrough, so callers can budget timeouts for the run that will actually execute.
   146	
   147	    `resolveThinkingPolicy(...)` returns the provider/model's supported thinking levels and optional default. Provider plugins own the model-specific profile through their thinking hooks, so tool plugins should call this runtime helper instead of importing or duplicating provider lists.
   148	
   149	    `normalizeThinkingLevel(...)` converts user text such as `on`, `x-high`, or `extra high` to the canonical stored level before checking it against the resolved policy.
   150	
   151	    **Session store helpers** are under `api.runtime.agent.session`:
   152	
   153	    ```typescript
   154	    const entry = api.runtime.agent.session.getSessionEntry({ agentId, sessionKey });
   155	    for (const { sessionKey, entry } of api.runtime.agent.session.listSessionEntries({ agentId })) {
   156	      // Iterate session rows without depending on the legacy sessions.json shape.
   157	    }
   158	    await api.runtime.agent.session.patchSessionEntry({
   159	      agentId,
   160	      sessionKey,
   161	      update: (entry) => ({ thinkingLevel: "high" }),
   162	    });
   163	
   164	    const created = await api.runtime.agent.session.createSessionEntry({
   165	      cfg,
   166	      key: "agent:main:my-plugin:task-1",
   167	      initialEntry: {
   168	        agentHarnessId: "my-harness",
   169	        modelSelectionLocked: true,
   170	        pluginExtensions: { "my-plugin": { phase: "initializing" } },
   171	      },
   172	      afterCreate: async () => ({
   173	        pluginExtensions: { "my-plugin": { phase: "ready" } },
   174	      }),
   175	    });
   176	
   177	    const storePath = api.runtime.agent.session.resolveStorePath(cfg.session?.store, { agentId });
   178	    await api.runtime.agent.session.runWithWorkAdmission(
   179	      { storePath, sessionKey },
   180	      async (signal) => {
   181	        // Create or update the session, then pass signal to the admitted agent run.
   182	      },
   183	    );
   184	    ```
   185	
   186	    Prefer `getSessionEntry(...)`, `listSessionEntries(...)`, `patchSessionEntry(...)`, or `upsertSessionEntry(...)` for session workflows. These helpers address sessions by agent/session identity so plugins do not depend on the legacy `sessions.json` storage shape. Use `preserveActivity: true` for metadata-only patches that should not refresh session activity, and `replaceEntry: true` only when the callback returns a complete entry and deleted fields must stay deleted. Doctor and migration paths can combine `fallbackEntry`, `skipMaintenance`, and `requireWriteSuccess` for one atomic canonical-store repair.
   187	
   188	    `createSessionEntry(...)` creates a new canonical session row and transcript. Its trusted `initialEntry` surface is deliberately narrow: a non-empty `agentHarnessId`, optional `modelSelectionLocked: true`, and optional `pluginExtensions`. The injected runtime accepts only harness ids owned by the calling plugin through `registerAgentHarness(...)`; this is an ownership invariant, not a sandbox between in-process plugins. It rejects an existing row; `label` and `spawnedCwd` are separate creation fields rather than trusted-entry patches.
   189	
   190	    Creation holds the session lifecycle mutation fence through `afterCreate`, so new work waits for plugin-owned initialization to finish and pre-existing admitted work makes creation fail. The callback receives a clone of the created state. If it returns a patch, that patch may contain only `pluginExtensions`, and its value is the complete final `pluginExtensions` field. A callback or final-persistence failure rolls back the unchanged new row and transcript; guarded rollback preserves a row changed or claimed concurrently. `recoverMatchingInitialEntry: true` is only for retrying interrupted initialization when the persisted trusted fields match exactly, and recovery requires `afterCreate` to return a final patch.
   191	
   192	    Use `runWithWorkAdmission(...)` when a plugin starts work on a persisted session. The callback rejects archived or concurrently replaced sessions, keeps archive/reset/delete mutations coordinated through completion, and receives an `AbortSignal` that must be forwarded to the agent run. A harness may explicitly name trusted execution delegates through its experimental `delegatedExecutionPluginIds` registration field. Delegates can admit and run only an exact existing model-locked session; all session mutations remain restricted to the harness owner. See [Agent harness plugins](/plugins/sdk-agent-harness#delegated-execution).
   193	
   194	    Maintenance and repair plugins may use `deleteSessionEntry(...)` for one scoped session entry, `cleanupSessionLifecycleArtifacts(...)` for lifecycle-owned scratch sessions, and `resolveSessionStoreBackupPaths(...)` before mutating a store. Pass `expectedSessionId` and `expectedUpdatedAt` when deletion must not race a concurrent session update; use `expectedSessionId: null` when the earlier snapshot had no session id. These helpers are narrow repair/lifecycle surfaces, not a general store deletion API.
   195	
   196	    `resolveStorePath(...)` and `updateSessionStoreEntry(...)` round out the session helpers: `resolveStorePath` resolves the session store path for a given scope, and `updateSessionStoreEntry({ storePath, sessionKey, update })` patches one entry directly by store path when the caller already knows it.
   197	
   198	    `loadTranscriptEventsSync(...)` is available for synchronous doctor and repair paths that cannot use the async transcript runtime. It returns raw `SessionStoreTranscriptEvent` records. Normal plugin runtime code should prefer `openclaw/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime`.
   199	
   200	    `formatSqliteSessionFileMarker(...)`, `parseSqliteSessionFileMarker(...)`, and `sqliteSessionFileMarkerMatchesSession(...)` are transitional helpers for code that still receives a legacy field named `sessionFile`. A parsed SQLite marker identifies a live SQLite transcript target; it is not a filesystem path. New APIs should carry typed session identity instead of marker strings.
   201	
   202	    For transcript reads and writes, import `openclaw/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime` and use `resolveSessionTranscriptIdentity(...)`, `resolveSessionTranscriptTarget(...)`, `readSessionTranscriptEvents(...)`, `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta(...)`, `readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta(...)`, `readVisibleSessionTranscriptMessageEntries(...)`, `appendSessionTranscriptMessageByIdentity(...)`, `publishSessionTranscriptUpdateByIdentity(...)`, or `withSessionTranscriptWriteLock(...)` with `{ agentId, sessionKey, sessionId }`. These APIs let plugins identify a transcript, read raw events or visible branch-safe message entries, append messages, publish updates, and run related operations under the same transcript write lock without depending on active transcript file paths. `readVisibleSessionTranscriptMessageEntries(...)` returns ordered read metadata; its `seq` field is not a resumable cursor.
   203	
   204	    `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta(...)` returns a bounded `page`, `reset`, or `missing` result. Pass the opaque `page.cursor` into the next call. Pure appends preserve the cursor, while transcript replacement returns `reset` with a new bootstrap cursor. Pages default to 1,000 events and 1,000,000 serialized bytes; callers may request up to 10,000 events and 64 MiB. When the next event alone exceeds `maxBytes`, the page is empty and reports `requiredBytes`; retry with at least that byte limit when it is no greater than 64 MiB. Larger individual events require the complete-read API. A cursor identifies position only and never grants access to another session.
   205	
   206	    `readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta(...)` provides the same bounded bootstrap-and-resume shape over the host-owned active message projection. It returns messages from oldest to newest, so context engines can drain initial history and persist the opaque cursor as their watermark. Store and return the cursor unchanged; it is a continuation hint, not an authorization credential. Linear appends resume after the last returned message. Transcript replacement, a cursor whose anchor left or moved within the active branch, malformed cursors, and cross-session cursors return `reset` with a fresh bootstrap cursor. The count and byte defaults and caps match the raw delta API. While the active projection is rebuilding after a branch change, the result is `unavailable` with reason `projection_rebuilding`; retry later rather than falling back to an active transcript file.
   207	
   208	    The legacy whole-store and active transcript file helpers are no longer exported from the plugin SDK. Use the scoped entry helpers for session metadata and the transcript identity helpers for active transcript operations. Archive/support workflows that need file artifacts should use their dedicated archive surfaces instead of active session runtime APIs.
   209

    25	const instances: OpenClawTestInstance[] = [];
    26	const modelServers: MockModelServer[] = [];

    28	afterEach(async () => {
    29	  await Promise.allSettled(instances.splice(0).map((instance) => instance.cleanup()));

    33	describe("embedded transcript cursor settlement", () => {
    34	  it(
    35	    "resumes a public raw cursor after a real append-only Gateway turn",
    36	    { timeout: TEST_TIMEOUT_MS },
    37	    async () => {
    38	      const modelServer = await startMockModelServer();
    39	      modelServers.push(modelServer);
    40	      const instance = await createOpenClawTestInstance({
    41	        name: "embedded-transcript-cursor",
    42	        config: createTestConfig(modelServer.baseUrl),
    43	        env: { OPENCLAW_SKIP_PROVIDERS: undefined },
    44	      });
    45	      instances.push(instance);
    46	      await instance.startGateway();
    47	
    48	      const client = await connectGatewayClient({
    49	        url: instance.url,
    50	        [GATEWAY_TOKEN_OPTION]: instance.gatewayToken,
    51	        role: "operator",
    52	        scopes: ["operator.admin", "operator.read", "operator.write"],
    53	      });
    54	      try {
    55	        await runAgentTurn(client, instance, "first cursor turn");
    56	        const storePath = path.join(instance.state.sessionsDir("main"), "sessions.json");
    57	        const sessionId = await waitForSessionId(storePath);
    58	        const target = { agentId: "main", sessionId, sessionKey: SESSION_KEY, storePath };
    59	        const bootstrap = await readSessionTranscriptRawDelta({
    60	          ...target,
    61	          maxBytes: 1_000_000,
    62	          maxEvents: 100,
    63	        });
    64	        expect(bootstrap.kind, instance.logs()).toBe("page");
    65	        if (bootstrap.kind !== "page") {
    66	          throw new Error(`expected bootstrap page, got ${bootstrap.kind}`);
    67	        }
    68	        expect(bootstrap.hasMore).toBe(false);
    69	
    70	        await runAgentTurn(client, instance, "second cursor turn");
    71	        const resumed = await readSessionTranscriptRawDelta({
    72	          ...target,
    73	          cursor: bootstrap.cursor,
    74	          maxBytes: 1_000_000,
    75	          maxEvents: 100,
    76	        });
    77	
    78	        expect(resumed.kind, `${JSON.stringify(resumed)}\n${instance.logs()}`).toBe("page");
    79	        if (resumed.kind !== "page") {
    80	          throw new Error(`expected resumed page, got ${resumed.kind}`);
    81	        }
    82	        expect(resumed.hasMore).toBe(false);
    83	        const messageTexts = resumed.events.flatMap((row) => readMessageText(row.event));
    84	        expect(messageTexts).toContain("second cursor turn");
    85	        expect(messageTexts).toContain("cursor settlement response 2");
    86	        expect(messageTexts).not.toContain("first cursor turn");
    87	        expect(messageTexts).not.toContain("cursor settlement response 1");
    88	      } finally {
    89	        await disconnectGatewayClient(client);
    90	      }
    91	    },
    92	  );
    93	});
