    57	  try {
    58	    return normalizeOptionalString(decodeURIComponent(match[1] ?? "")) ?? null;
    59	  } catch {
    60	    return "";
    61	  }
    62	}
    63	
    64	function shouldStreamSse(req: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    65	  const accept = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(getHeader(req, "accept"));
    66	  return accept.includes("text/event-stream");
    67	}
    68	
    69	function getRequestUrl(req: IncomingMessage): URL {
    70	  return new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
    71	}
    72	
    73	function resolveLimit(req: IncomingMessage): Result<number | undefined, string> {
    74	  const raw = getRequestUrl(req).searchParams.get("limit");
    75	  if (raw == null) {
    76	    return ok(undefined);
    77	  }
    78	  const trimmed = raw.trim();
    79	  const value = parseStrictPositiveInteger(trimmed);
    80	  if (value !== undefined) {
    81	    return ok(Math.min(MAX_SESSION_HISTORY_LIMIT, value));
    82	  }
    83	  if (/^\d+$/.test(trimmed) && /[1-9]/.test(trimmed)) {
    84	    return ok(MAX_SESSION_HISTORY_LIMIT);
    85	  }
    86	  return err("limit must be a positive integer");
    87	}
    88	
    89	function sseWrite(res: ServerResponse, event: string, payload: unknown): void {
    90	  res.write(`event: ${event}\n`);
    91	  res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`);
    92	}
    93	
    94	/** Handle `/sessions/:sessionKey/history` JSON/SSE requests. */
    95	export async function handleSessionHistoryHttpRequest(
    96	  req: IncomingMessage,
    97	  res: ServerResponse,
    98	  opts: {
    99	    auth: ResolvedGatewayAuth;
   100	    getResolvedAuth?: () => ResolvedGatewayAuth;
   101	    trustedProxies?: string[];
   102	    allowRealIpFallback?: boolean;
   103	    rateLimiter?: AuthRateLimiter;
   104	  },
   105	): Promise<boolean> {
   106	  const sessionKey = resolveSessionHistoryPath(req);
   107	  if (sessionKey === null) {
   108	    return false;
   109	  }
   110	  if (!sessionKey) {
   111	    sendInvalidRequest(res, "invalid session key");
   112	    return true;
   113	  }
   114	  if (req.method !== "GET") {
   115	    sendMethodNotAllowed(res, "GET");
   116	    return true;
   117	  }
   118	
   119	  // Session history intentionally uses the shared-secret HTTP trust model:
   120	  // token/password bearer auth grants default operator scopes so simple API key
   121	  // callers can read their own history without a scope header.
   122	  const authResult = await authorizeScopedGatewayHttpRequestOrReply({
   123	    req,
   124	    res,
   125	    auth: opts.auth,
   126	    trustedProxies: opts.trustedProxies,
   127	    allowRealIpFallback: opts.allowRealIpFallback,
   128	    rateLimiter: opts.rateLimiter,
   129	    operatorMethod: "chat.history",
   130	    resolveOperatorScopes: resolveSharedSecretHttpOperatorScopes,
   131	  });
   132	  if (!authResult) {
   133	    return true;
   134	  }
   135	  const { cfg } = authResult;
   136	
   137	  const target = resolveGatewaySessionStoreTargetWithStore({ cfg, key: sessionKey });
   138	  const entry = resolveFreshestSessionEntryFromStoreKeys(target.store, target.storeKeys);
   139	  if (!entry?.sessionId) {
   140	    sendJson(res, 404, {
   141	      ok: false,
   142	      error: {
   143	        type: "not_found",
   144	        message: `Session not found: ${sessionKey}`,
   145	      },
   146	    });
   147	    return true;
   148	  }
   149	  const limitResult = resolveLimit(req);
   150	  if (!limitResult.ok) {
   151	    sendInvalidRequest(res, limitResult.error);
   152	    return true;
   153	  }
   154	  const limit = limitResult.value;
   155	  const cursor = normalizeOptionalString(getRequestUrl(req).searchParams.get("cursor"));
   156	  const effectiveMaxChars = DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS;
   157	  let boundedSnapshot:
   158	    | Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readRecentSessionMessagesWithStatsAsync>>
   159	    | undefined;
   160	  let fullSnapshot: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof readSessionMessagesWithSourceAsync>> | undefined;
   161	  try {
   162	    boundedSnapshot =
   163	      cursor === undefined && typeof limit === "number"
   164	        ? await readRecentSessionMessagesWithStatsAsync(
   165	            {
   166	              agentId: target.agentId,
   167	              sessionEntry: entry,
   168	              sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   169	              sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   170	              storePath: target.storePath,
   171	            },
   172	            {
   173	              ...resolveSessionHistoryTailReadOptions(limit),
   174	              allowResetArchiveFallback: true,
   175	            },
   176	          )
   177	        : undefined;
   178	    // Cursor reads still need an arbitrary historical window. The common first
   179	    // page path is bounded above so `limit=1` cannot materialize huge transcripts.
   180	    fullSnapshot =
   181	      boundedSnapshot === undefined && entry?.sessionId
   182	        ? await readSessionMessagesWithSourceAsync(
   183	            {
   184	              agentId: target.agentId,
   185	              sessionEntry: entry,
   186	              sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   187	              sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   188	              storePath: target.storePath,
   189	            },
   190	            {
   191	              mode: "full",
   192	              reason: "session history cursor pagination",
   193	              allowResetArchiveFallback: true,
   194	            },
   195	          )
   196	        : undefined;
   197	  } catch (error) {
   198	    if (!isSessionTranscriptProjectionUnavailableError(error)) {
   199	      throw error;
   200	    }
   201	    res.setHeader("Retry-After", "1");
   202	    sendJson(res, 503, {
   203	      ok: false,
   204	      error: {
   205	        type: "unavailable",
   206	        message: "session history is rebuilding; retry shortly",
   207	        retryable: true,
   208	      },
   209	    });
   210	    return true;
   211	  }
   212	  const rawSnapshot = boundedSnapshot?.messages ?? fullSnapshot?.messages ?? [];
   213	  const historySnapshot = buildSessionHistorySnapshot({
   214	    rawMessages: rawSnapshot,
   215	    maxChars: effectiveMaxChars,
   216	    limit,
   217	    cursor,
   218	    rawTranscriptSeq: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   219	    totalRawMessages: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   220	  });
   221	  const history = historySnapshot.history;
   222	
   223	  if (!shouldStreamSse(req)) {
   224	    sendJson(res, 200, {
   225	      sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   226	      ...history,
   227	    });
   228	    return true;
   229	  }
   230	
   231	  const transcriptCandidates = entry?.sessionId
   232	    ? new Set(
   233	        resolveSessionTranscriptCandidates(
   234	          entry.sessionId,
   235	          target.storePath,
   236	          entry.sessionFile,
   237	          target.agentId,
   238	        )
   239	          .map((candidate) => resolveTranscriptPathForComparison(candidate))
   240	          .filter((candidate): candidate is string => typeof candidate === "string"),
   241	      )
   242	    : new Set<string>();
   243	
   244	  let sentHistory = history;
   245	  const sseState = SessionHistorySseState.fromRawSnapshot({
   246	    target: {
   247	      agentId: target.agentId,
   248	      sessionEntry: entry,
   249	      sessionId: entry.sessionId,
   250	      sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   251	      storePath: target.storePath,
   252	    },
   253	    rawMessages: rawSnapshot,
   254	    rawTranscriptSeq: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   255	    totalRawMessages: boundedSnapshot?.totalMessages,
   256	    transcriptPath: boundedSnapshot?.transcriptPath ?? fullSnapshot?.transcriptPath,
   257	    maxChars: effectiveMaxChars,
   258	    limit,
   259	    cursor,
   260	  });
   261	  sentHistory = sseState.snapshot();
   262	  let streamStopped = false;
   263	  let streamQueue = Promise.resolve();
   264	  const streamResources: {
   265	    heartbeat?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
   266	    unsubscribe?: () => void;
   267	  } = {};
   268	
   269	  function releaseStreamResources() {
   270	    if (streamStopped) {
   271	      return;
   272	    }
   273	    streamStopped = true;
   274	    if (streamResources.heartbeat) {
   275	      clearInterval(streamResources.heartbeat);
   276	    }
   277	    if (streamResources.unsubscribe) {
   278	      streamResources.unsubscribe();
   279	    }
   280	  }
   281	
   282	  function detachStreamListeners() {
   283	    req.off("close", handleRequestStreamClose);
   284	    req.off("error", handleRequestStreamError);
   285	    res.off("close", handleResponseStreamClose);
   286	    res.off("finish", handleResponseStreamFinish);
   287	    res.off("error", handleResponseStreamError);
   288	  }
   289	
   290	  function closeStream() {
   291	    releaseStreamResources();
   292	    if (!res.writableEnded && !res.destroyed) {
   293	      res.end();
   294	    }
   295	  }
   296	
   297	  function handleRequestStreamClose() {
   298	    releaseStreamResources();
   299	    req.off("close", handleRequestStreamClose);
   300	    req.off("error", handleRequestStreamError);
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  function handleRequestStreamError(error: Error) {
   304	    // Node HTTP streams emit process-fatal `error` events without listeners.
   305	    // Request-side failures mean the SSE owner should release and end locally.
   306	    log.warn("session history SSE request stream errored; closing stream", { error });
   307	    closeStream();
   308	  }
   309	
   310	  function handleResponseStreamFinish() {
   311	    releaseStreamResources();
   312	    // `finish` only means Node handed the response bytes to the OS. Keep the
   313	    // error listener until `close` so a late flush failure stays stream-local.
   314	    res.off("finish", handleResponseStreamFinish);
   315	  }
   316	
   317	  function handleResponseStreamClose() {
   318	    releaseStreamResources();
   319	    detachStreamListeners();
   320	  }
   321	
   322	  function handleResponseStreamError(error: Error) {
   323	    // The response stream is already failing, so only release local resources;
   324	    // writing an end frame here can re-enter the errored ServerResponse.
   325	    log.warn("session history SSE response stream errored; cleaning up stream", { error });
   326	    releaseStreamResources();
   327	  }
   328	  const isStreamClosed = () => streamStopped || res.writableEnded || res.destroyed;
   329	
   330	  req.on("close", handleRequestStreamClose);
   331	  req.on("error", handleRequestStreamError);
   332	  res.on("close", handleResponseStreamClose);
   333	  res.on("finish", handleResponseStreamFinish);
   334	  res.on("error", handleResponseStreamError);
   335	
   336	  setSseHeaders(res);
   337	  res.write("retry: 1000\n\n");
   338	  if (isStreamClosed()) {
   339	    return true;
   340	  }
   341	  sseWrite(res, "history", {
   342	    sessionKey: target.canonicalKey,
   343	    ...sentHistory,
   344	  });
   345	  if (isStreamClosed()) {
   346	    return true;
   347	  }
   348	
   349	  const queueStreamWork = (work: () => Promise<void>) => {
   350	    streamQueue = streamQueue
   351	      .then(async () => {
   352	        if (streamStopped || res.writableEnded) {
   353	          return;
   354	        }
   355	        await work();
   356	      })
   357	      .catch((error: unknown) => {
   358	        // Surface the underlying error so operators can distinguish transient
   359	        // infrastructure failures (for example a `getRuntimeConfig()` read error
   360	        // inside the reauth path) from deliberate revocation, then fail closed.
   361	        log.warn("session history SSE stream work failed; closing stream", { error });
   362	        closeStream();
   363	      });
   364	  };
   365	
   366	  const isStreamStillAuthorized = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   367	    const cfgLocal = getRuntimeConfig();
   368	    const currentRequestAuth = await checkGatewayHttpRequestAuth({
   369	      req,
   370	      auth: opts.getResolvedAuth?.() ?? opts.auth,
   371	      trustedProxies: cfgLocal.gateway?.trustedProxies,
   372	      allowRealIpFallback: cfgLocal.gateway?.allowRealIpFallback,
   373	      rateLimiter: opts.rateLimiter,
   374	      cfg: cfgLocal,
   375	    });
   376	    if (!currentRequestAuth.ok) {
   377	      return false;
   378	    }
   379	    const requestedScopes = resolveSharedSecretHttpOperatorScopes(
   380	      req,
   190	}
   191	
   192	/** Tracks session-history SSE state and decides when inline appends are still valid. */
   193	export class SessionHistorySseState {
   194	  private readonly target: SessionHistoryTranscriptTarget;
   195	  private readonly maxChars: number;
   196	  private readonly limit: number | undefined;
   197	  private readonly cursor: string | undefined;
   198	  private sentHistory: PaginatedSessionHistory;
   199	  private rawTranscriptSeq: number;
   200	  private turnBoundaryPending: boolean;
   201	  private transcriptPath: string | undefined;
   202	
   203	  static fromRawSnapshot(params: {
   204	    target: SessionHistoryTranscriptTarget;
   205	    rawMessages: unknown[];
   206	    rawTranscriptSeq?: number;
   207	    totalRawMessages?: number;
   208	    transcriptPath?: string;
   209	    maxChars?: number;
   210	    limit?: number;
   211	    cursor?: string;
   212	  }): SessionHistorySseState {
   213	    return new SessionHistorySseState({
   214	      target: params.target,
   215	      maxChars: params.maxChars,
   216	      limit: params.limit,
   217	      cursor: params.cursor,
   218	      initialRawMessages: params.rawMessages,
   219	      rawTranscriptSeq: params.rawTranscriptSeq,
   220	      totalRawMessages: params.totalRawMessages,
   221	      transcriptPath: params.transcriptPath,
   222	    });
   223	  }
   224	
   225	  private constructor(params: {
   226	    target: SessionHistoryTranscriptTarget;
   227	    maxChars?: number;
   228	    limit?: number;
   229	    cursor?: string;
   230	    initialRawMessages: unknown[];
   231	    rawTranscriptSeq?: number;
   232	    totalRawMessages?: number;
   233	    transcriptPath?: string;
   234	  }) {
   235	    this.target = params.target;
   236	    this.maxChars = params.maxChars ?? DEFAULT_CHAT_HISTORY_TEXT_MAX_CHARS;
   237	    this.limit = params.limit;
   238	    this.cursor = params.cursor;
   239	    const snapshot = this.buildSnapshot({
   240	      rawMessages: params.initialRawMessages,
   241	      ...(typeof params.rawTranscriptSeq === "number"
   242	        ? { rawTranscriptSeq: params.rawTranscriptSeq }
   243	        : {}),
   244	      ...(typeof params.totalRawMessages === "number"
   245	        ? { totalRawMessages: params.totalRawMessages }
   246	        : {}),
   247	    });
   248	    this.sentHistory = snapshot.history;
   249	    this.rawTranscriptSeq = snapshot.rawTranscriptSeq;
   250	    this.turnBoundaryPending = snapshot.turnBoundaryPending;
   251	    this.transcriptPath = normalizeTranscriptPathForComparison(params.transcriptPath);
   252	  }
   253	
   254	  snapshot(): PaginatedSessionHistory {
   255	    return this.sentHistory;
   256	  }
   257	
   258	  appendInlineMessage(update: {
   259	    message: unknown;
   260	    messageId?: string;
   261	    messageSeq?: number;
   262	  }): InlineSessionHistoryAppend | null {
   263	    if (this.limit !== undefined || this.cursor !== undefined) {
   264	      return null;
   265	    }
   266	    const carriedSeq = asPositiveSafeInteger(update.messageSeq);
   267	    if (carriedSeq !== undefined) {
   268	      if (carriedSeq <= this.rawTranscriptSeq) {
   269	        return { shouldRefresh: true };
   270	      }
   271	      this.rawTranscriptSeq = carriedSeq;
   272	    } else {
   273	      this.rawTranscriptSeq += 1;
   274	    }
   275	    const idempotencyKey = readMessageIdempotencyKey(update.message);
   276	    const nextMessage = attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(update.message, {
   277	      ...(typeof update.messageId === "string" ? { id: update.messageId } : {}),
   278	      ...(idempotencyKey ? { idempotencyKey } : {}),
   279	      seq: this.rawTranscriptSeq,
   280	    });
   281	    const hadPendingTurnBoundary = this.turnBoundaryPending;
   282	    const nextProjection = projectChatDisplayMessagesWithState([nextMessage], {
   283	      maxChars: this.maxChars,
   284	      turnBoundaryPending: hadPendingTurnBoundary,
   285	    });
   286	    this.turnBoundaryPending = nextProjection.turnBoundaryPending;
   287	    // Projection can split, drop, or rewrite raw transcript messages. When one
   288	    // raw append changes multiple visible rows, callers must refresh instead of
   289	    // emitting a misleading single SSE item.
   290	    const projectedMessages = toSessionHistoryMessages(
   291	      projectChatDisplayMessages([...this.sentHistory.messages, nextMessage], {
   292	        maxChars: this.maxChars,
   293	      }),
   294	    );
   295	    if (projectedMessages.length > this.sentHistory.messages.length) {
   296	      const addedMessages = projectedMessages.slice(this.sentHistory.messages.length);
   297	      if (hadPendingTurnBoundary && !this.turnBoundaryPending && addedMessages[0]) {
   298	        const firstAdded = attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(addedMessages[0], {
   299	          turnBoundary: true,
   300	        }) as SessionHistoryMessage;
   301	        addedMessages[0] = firstAdded;
   302	        projectedMessages[this.sentHistory.messages.length] = firstAdded;
   303	      }
   304	      if (addedMessages.length > 1) {
   305	        this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   306	          messages: projectedMessages,
   307	          hasMore: false,
   308	        });
   309	        return { shouldRefresh: true };
   310	      }
   311	      const projectedMessage = addedMessages[0];
   312	      if (projectedMessage !== undefined) {
   313	        const emittedMessage: SessionHistoryMessage =
   314	          isMessageToolMirrorMessage(projectedMessage) ||
   315	          resolveMessageSeq(projectedMessage) === undefined
   316	            ? (attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta(projectedMessage, {
   317	                seq: this.rawTranscriptSeq,
   318	              }) as SessionHistoryMessage)
   319	            : projectedMessage;
   320	        const nextMessages = [...this.sentHistory.messages, emittedMessage];
   321	        this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   322	          messages: nextMessages,
   323	          hasMore: false,
   324	        });
   325	        return {
   326	          message: emittedMessage,
   327	          messageSeq: resolveMessageSeq(emittedMessage),
   328	        };
   329	      }
   330	    }
   331	    const [sanitizedMessage] = toSessionHistoryMessages(nextProjection.messages);
   332	    if (!sanitizedMessage) {
   333	      if (projectedMessages.length < this.sentHistory.messages.length) {
   334	        this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   335	          messages: projectedMessages,
   336	          hasMore: false,
   337	        });
   338	        return { shouldRefresh: true };
   339	      }
   340	      return null;
   341	    }
   342	    if (projectedMessages.length <= this.sentHistory.messages.length) {
   343	      this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   344	        messages: projectedMessages,
   345	        hasMore: false,
   346	      });
   347	      return { shouldRefresh: true };
   348	    }
   349	    const projectedMessage = projectedMessages.at(-1) ?? sanitizedMessage;
   350	    const nextMessages = [...this.sentHistory.messages, projectedMessage];
   351	    this.sentHistory = buildPaginatedSessionHistory({
   352	      messages: nextMessages,
   353	      hasMore: false,
   354	    });
   355	    return {
   356	      message: projectedMessage,
   357	      messageSeq: resolveMessageSeq(projectedMessage),
   358	    };
   359	  }
   360	
   361	  shouldRefreshForTranscriptPath(updatePath: string | undefined): boolean {
   362	    const nextPath = normalizeTranscriptPathForComparison(updatePath);
   363	    return Boolean(this.transcriptPath && nextPath && this.transcriptPath !== nextPath);
   364	  }
   365	
   366	  async refreshAsync(): Promise<PaginatedSessionHistory> {
   367	    const rawSnapshot = await this.readRawSnapshotAsync();
   368	    const snapshot = this.buildSnapshot(rawSnapshot);
   369	    this.rawTranscriptSeq = snapshot.rawTranscriptSeq;
   370	    this.turnBoundaryPending = snapshot.turnBoundaryPending;
   371	    this.transcriptPath = normalizeTranscriptPathForComparison(rawSnapshot.transcriptPath);
   372	    this.sentHistory = snapshot.history;
   373	    return snapshot.history;
   374	  }
   375	
   376	  private buildSnapshot(rawSnapshot: SessionHistoryRawSnapshot): SessionHistorySnapshot {
   377	    return buildSessionHistorySnapshot({
   378	      rawMessages: rawSnapshot.rawMessages,
   379	      maxChars: this.maxChars,
   380	      limit: this.limit,
   381	      cursor: this.cursor,
   382	      ...(typeof rawSnapshot.rawTranscriptSeq === "number"
   383	        ? { rawTranscriptSeq: rawSnapshot.rawTranscriptSeq }
   384	        : {}),
   385	      ...(typeof rawSnapshot.totalRawMessages === "number"
   386	        ? { totalRawMessages: rawSnapshot.totalRawMessages }
   387	        : {}),
   388	    });
   389	  }
   390	
   391	  private async readRawSnapshotAsync(): Promise<SessionHistoryRawSnapshot> {
   392	    if (this.cursor === undefined && typeof this.limit === "number") {
   393	      const snapshot = await readRecentSessionMessagesWithStatsAsync(
   394	        {
   395	          agentId: this.target.agentId,
   396	          sessionEntry: this.target.sessionEntry,
   397	          sessionId: this.target.sessionId,
   398	          sessionKey: this.target.sessionKey,
   399	          storePath: this.target.storePath,
   400	        },
   401	        {
   402	          ...resolveSessionHistoryTailReadOptions(this.limit),
   403	          allowResetArchiveFallback: true,
   404	        },
   405	      );
   406	      return {
   407	        rawMessages: snapshot.messages,
   408	        rawTranscriptSeq: snapshot.totalMessages,
   409	        totalRawMessages: snapshot.totalMessages,
   410	        transcriptPath: snapshot.transcriptPath,
   411	      };
   412	    }
   413	    const snapshot = await readSessionMessagesWithSourceAsync(
   414	      {
   415	        agentId: this.target.agentId,
   416	        sessionEntry: this.target.sessionEntry,
   417	        sessionId: this.target.sessionId,
   418	        sessionKey: this.target.sessionKey,
   419	        storePath: this.target.storePath,
   420	      },
   421	      {
   422	        mode: "full",
   423	        reason: "session history cursor pagination",
   424	        allowResetArchiveFallback: true,
   425	      },
   426	    );
   427	    return {
   428	      rawMessages: snapshot.messages,
   429	      transcriptPath: snapshot.transcriptPath,
   430	    };
   431	  }
   432	}
   433	
   434	function normalizeTranscriptPathForComparison(filePath: string | undefined): string | undefined {
   435	  return typeof filePath === "string" ? resolveTranscriptPathForComparison(filePath) : undefined;
   436	}
   650	        });
   651	      }
   652	      if (isToolsInvokePath(scopedRequestPath)) {
   653	        requestStages.push({
   654	          name: "tools-invoke",
   655	          run: async () =>
   656	            await runWithGatewayHttpWorkAdmission(res, async () =>
   657	              (await getToolsInvokeHttpModule()).handleToolsInvokeHttpRequest(req, res, {
   658	                auth: resolvedAuthValue,
   659	                trustedProxies,
   660	                allowRealIpFallback,
   661	                rateLimiter,
   662	              }),
   663	            ),
   664	        });
   665	      }
   666	      if (isSessionKillPath(scopedRequestPath)) {
   667	        requestStages.push({
   668	          name: "sessions-kill",
   669	          run: async () =>
   670	            await runWithGatewayHttpWorkAdmission(res, async () =>
   671	              (await getSessionKillHttpModule()).handleSessionKillHttpRequest(req, res, {
   672	                auth: resolvedAuthValue,
   673	                trustedProxies,
   674	                allowRealIpFallback,
   675	                rateLimiter,
   676	              }),
   677	            ),
   678	        });
   679	      }
   680	      if (isSessionHistoryPath(scopedRequestPath)) {
   681	        requestStages.push({
   682	          name: "sessions-history",
   683	          run: async () =>
   684	            await runWithGatewayHttpWorkAdmission(res, async () =>
   685	              (await getSessionHistoryHttpModule()).handleSessionHistoryHttpRequest(req, res, {
   686	                auth: resolvedAuthValue,

   688	                trustedProxies,

   692	            ),
   693	        });
   694	      }
   695	      if (isBoardWidgetPath(scopedRequestPath)) {
   696	        requestStages.push({
   697	          name: "board-widget",

   366	function archiveFileOnDisk(filePath: string, reason: ArchiveFileReason): string {
   367	  const ts = formatSessionArchiveTimestamp();
   368	  const archived = `${filePath}.${reason}.${ts}`;
   369	  fs.renameSync(filePath, archived);
   370	  clearSessionTranscriptResetArchiveDiscoveryCache();
   371	  // Notify the session transcript subscribers (memory index, sessions-history
   372	  // HTTP, etc.) that a mutation landed on a session-owned path. Without this
   373	  // emit the memory sync's incremental path never learns the new archive
   374	  // exists: chokidar does not watch the sessions directory, and the event bus
   375	  // is the only channel gateway code uses to signal session-file mutations.
   376	  // All other in-process mutations (append, compaction, tool-result rewrite,
   377	  // chat inject, command execution) already emit here; archive was the sole
   378	  // remaining gap, which is why `.jsonl.reset.<iso>` / `.jsonl.deleted.<iso>`
   379	  // files only surfaced in the index after a full reindex.
   380	  emitSessionTranscriptUpdate({ sessionFile: archived });
   381	  return archived;
   382	}

   123	    // MARK: - rounds/0012 ② 返工：send 侧屏障（订阅竞态收口，见 subscribe()/send() 文档注释）
   124	    //
   125	    // 上一版把竞态收口放在 subscribe() 自己身上（等订阅 RPC 落地才 return stream）——推翻理由见
   126	    // subscribe() 文档注释（违反 D1、且把 CI flat-swiftc 平价 runner 从 12/0/1 打穿到必然悬挂）。
   127	    // 本版把屏障挪到 send()（以及 stop()，同一屏障复用）开头：等待"该 session 的订阅 RPC 已经
   128	    // dispatch"，不等它的响应——两者的区别、以及为什么只能是前者，完整论证见 send() 文档注释。
   129	
   130	    /// 有条目 = 该 session 的 subscribe() 已经被调用，但它背景 Task 里真正发起
   131	    /// `sessions.messages.subscribe` RPC 这一步尚未发生——`send()`/`stop()` 开头据此判断要不要等。
   132	    /// 没有条目（从未 subscribe 过，或已经 dispatch 完毕）的 session 一律不等，见
   133	    /// `awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending` 文档注释。
   134	    private var subscriptionDispatchPending: Set<String> = []
   135	    /// 正在 `awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending` 里挂起等待的 `send()`/`stop()` 调用——
   136	    /// `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched` 唤醒时一次性清空并 resume 全部（理论上同一 session 同一时刻
   137	    /// 只会有一个 send_pending/stop_in_progress 锁持有者在等，数组只是防御性地允许多个）。
   138	    private var subscriptionDispatchWaiters: [String: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>]] = [:]
   139	    /// Test-only：人为延迟 subscribe() 标记"该 session 订阅 RPC 已 dispatch"的时刻——生产路径恒为
   140	    /// nil，不生效。用于确定性地构造 send 侧屏障的破坏性反证（不加延迟的话，"背景 Task 是否先于
   141	    /// send() 跑到 dispatch 点"取决于 Swift actor 调度巧合，不可靠地复现，见
   142	    /// `testSupportSetSubscribeDispatchDelay` 与 FrameReplayTests.swift 对应测试的文档注释）。
   143	    private var testSupportSubscribeDispatchDelayNanoseconds: UInt64?
   144	
   145	    /// subscribe() 同步前缀里调用——登记"这个 session 有一个尚未 dispatch 的订阅 RPC"。必须在
   146	    /// subscribe() 自己的同步代码里调用（`Task {}` 派生之前），这样"登记"这一步严格先于
   147	    /// subscribe() 返回、也严格先于调用方有机会发起任何后续 `send()`/`stop()`（两者对同一个 actor
   148	    /// 的方法调用不可能重叠执行）——不存在"先调用 send() 才补登记"的竞态窗口。
   149	    private func beginTrackingSubscriptionDispatch(sessionID: String) {
   150	        subscriptionDispatchPending.insert(sessionID)
   151	    }
   152	
   153	    /// subscribe() 背景 Task 里，真正调用 `request(method:"sessions.messages.subscribe",...)`
   154	    /// **之前**的最后一步——标记"已经 dispatch"并唤醒所有在等待的 `send()`/`stop()`。**不等这条 RPC
   155	    /// 的响应**——`request()` 本身、以及它底层传输（生产是 `URLSessionWebSocketTask.send` 的完成
   156	    /// 回调，测试桩是 `testSupportStubRPC` 闭包）都还没有开始跑，这里只标记"即将把这个 RPC 交出去"
   157	    /// 这一刻。kernelKey 查找失败（unknown session，根本不会真的发起这条 RPC）的分支也调用它——
   158	    /// 否则那种极端情况下会有等待者永久卡住（虽然它们自己的 kernelKey 查找也会紧接着独立失败，双重
   159	    /// 保险不嫌多）。
   160	    private func markSubscriptionRpcDispatched(sessionID: String) {
   161	        subscriptionDispatchPending.remove(sessionID)
   162	        let waiters = subscriptionDispatchWaiters.removeValue(forKey: sessionID) ?? []
   163	        for waiter in waiters { waiter.resume() }
   164	    }
   165	
   166	    /// `send()`/`stop()` 开头调用。若该 session 当前有一个尚未 dispatch 的订阅 RPC 在途，挂起直到
   167	    /// `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched` 唤醒；否则（**从未 subscribe 过**，或订阅 RPC 已经 dispatch
   168	    /// 过）立即返回、不挂起——两种"不等"场景共享同一个分支，是有意合并，不是漏判：
   169	    /// "从未 subscribe"根本没有 `subscriptionDispatchPending` 条目可等（要求它去等一个永远不会有人
   170	    /// 调用 `markSubscriptionRpcDispatched` 的信号，就是制造一个永久挂起——D1 §2.2 send() 本身并不
   171	    /// 要求先 subscribe，任务书明确点名的 fixture 场景"只 createSession + send、不 subscribe"必须
   172	    /// 立即可用）。
   173	    private func awaitSubscriptionRpcDispatchIfPending(sessionID: String) async {
   174	        guard subscriptionDispatchPending.contains(sessionID) else { return }
   175	        await withCheckedContinuation { (continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
   176	            subscriptionDispatchWaiters[sessionID, default: []].append(continuation)
   177	        }
   178	    }

   182	    private func subscribeDispatchDelayNanosecondsForTesting() -> UInt64? {
   183	        testSupportSubscribeDispatchDelayNanoseconds
   184	    }

   199	    // MARK: M1 — approval 双向 join（agent(stream:"approval") <-> session.approval(phase:"pending")）
   200	    //
   201	    // F4 上一轮只缓存 approvalId -> toolCallId，遗漏了这次审批**真实归属的 runId**——`session.approval`
   202	    // 落地时只能退回到全 session 的 `lastRunIDBySessionID`，在多个 run 交替产生审批时会把 approval
   203	    // 错误关联到"当前最新活跃的 run"，而不是这次审批实际所在的 run（对抗审 T-045 M1 复现：
   204	    // agent approval-A(run-A) 之后 agent approval-B(run-B) 到达，把 lastRunIDBySessionID 刷新成
   205	    // run-B，随后姗姗来迟的 session.approval(approval-A) 会被错误按成 run-B）。同时上一轮完全没有
   206	    // 处理"session.approval 先于对应 agent(stream:approval) 帧到达"这个方向——直接丢弃，approval
   207	    // _request 永久丢失，即使 agent 帧随后真的到达也不会补发。本轮改为按 approvalId 做真正的双向
   208	    // 缓冲 join：agent 帧先到就缓冲 {runID,toolCallID}，session.approval 先到就缓冲整个 payload，
   209	    // 谁后到就用先到的那份补全信息，立即产出（且只产出一次）。

   269	    public private(set) var lastHandshakeScopes: [String] = []
   270	    public private(set) var lastHandshakeProtocol: Int?
   271	
   272	    public init(endpoint: URL, token: String) {
   273	        self.endpoint = endpoint
   274	        self.token = token
   275	        self.urlSession = URLSession(configuration: .default)
   276	    }

   278	    // MARK: - 连接 + 握手（recipe §2）
   279	
   280	    /// 建立 WS 连接并完成 challenge -> connect 握手，返回 hello-ok 里协商到的 scopes——供调用方
   281	    /// 核验"确实拿到了 operator.write/operator.admin 等写权限"（recipe §2 里最容易踩的坑：
   282	    /// client.id/mode 不是 "cli"/"cli" 时握手仍会成功，但 scopes 会被服务端清空）。
   283	    public func connect() async throws -> [String] {
   284	        let t = urlSession.webSocketTask(with: endpoint)
   285	        self.task = t
   286	        t.resume()
   287	        receiveLoopTask = Task { await self.receiveLoop() }
   288	
   289	        let challenge = try await waitForNextEvent(named: "connect.challenge")
   290	        prettyPrint("RECV connect.challenge", challenge)
   291	
   292	        // 握手 params 逐字段对照 recipe §2 末尾"一次完整、可复制的最小 connect 请求"。
   293	        let connectParams: JSONObject = [
   294	            "minProtocol": 3,
   295	            "maxProtocol": 4,
   296	            "client": [
   297	                "id": "cli",
   298	                "version": "0.0.1",
   299	                "platform": "darwin",
   300	                "mode": "cli",
   301	            ] as JSONObject,
   302	            "caps": [] as [String],
   303	            "role": "operator",
   304	            "scopes": ["operator.admin"] as [String],
   305	            "auth": ["token": token] as JSONObject,
   306	        ]
   307	        let hello = try await request(method: "connect", params: connectParams)
   308	        prettyPrint("RECV hello-ok (connect response payload)", hello)
   309	
   310	        if let proto = hello["protocol"] as? Int {
   311	            lastHandshakeProtocol = proto
   312	        }
   313	        if let auth = hello["auth"] as? JSONObject, let scopes = auth["scopes"] as? [String] {
   314	            lastHandshakeScopes = scopes
   315	        }
   316	        return lastHandshakeScopes
   317	    }
   318	
   319	    /// NOTE-3（整洁度，两端核对一致）：C# 侧 `Disconnect()` 原来只 `Abort()` 了 `ClientWebSocket`
   320	    /// 却没有 `Dispose()`（未释放底层非托管资源），已在 C# 侧补上。Swift 这里的等价物是
   321	    /// `URLSessionWebSocketTask.cancel(with:reason:)`——它同时中断挂起的 IO 并让 URLSession 释放
   322	    /// 该 task 的底层资源，是 Foundation 侧“Abort+Dispose”合一的正确收尾调用；`task = nil` 之后
   323	    /// ARC 释放最后一个引用。核对结论：两端在这个方法里语义已经一致，Swift 侧不需要额外改动。
   324	    public func disconnect() {
   325	        receiveLoopTask?.cancel()
   326	        task?.cancel(with: .normalClosure, reason: nil)
   327	        task = nil
   328	    }

   351	        // 存在；后者是内核自己认得的原生 id），本实现如实保留这个区分，写入
   352	        // SessionHandle.kernelSessionId 的是 openclaw 的 `key`（后续 subscribe/abort/delete 真正
   353	        // 需要用它寻址,不是 `sessionId` 字段）。

   357	        // billing.tokenRef 本轮是占位符——SG-4 没有实现 D1 §7 的 newapi token 铸造（那是 createSession

   359	        // "真实"的值掩盖这个缺口。
   360	        return SessionHandle(
     1	// openclaw Gateway 原生 wire 协议的最小编解码帮助函数。
     2	//
     3	// 这不是 D2 契约的一部分——是 OpenclawGatewayKernelClient 内部用来跟"已经在运行的 openclaw
     4	// 内核"直接对话的传输层。帧形状与握手/RPC 细节严格对照
     5	// scratchpad/sg4-openclaw-run-recipe.md §2/§3（recipe 里每一帧都逐字段实测过）：
     6	//   请求 {type:"req", id, method, params}
     7	//   响应 {type:"res", id, ok, payload, error}
     8	//   事件 {type:"event", event, payload, seq?, stateVersion?}
     9	//
    10	// 用 [String: Any] + JSONSerialization，而不是为 openclaw 每个方法单独手写一遍 Codable 结构——
    11	// 本轮只需要 connect/sessions.create/sessions.messages.subscribe/sessions.abort/sessions.delete
    12	// 五个 RPC，openclaw 侧完整 wire schema（它自己的 RequestMessage/ResponseMessage/EventMessage
    13	// 判别联合）在这个项目里已经被我们自己设计的 D2/D1 契约取代，没有必要在这里对 openclaw 原生协议
    14	// 再做一遍 quicktype 级别的建模——这是本文件与 D2.swift/DiscriminatedUnions.swift 分工的边界。
    15	
    16	import Foundation
    17	// `canImport` 门卫理由见 KernelClient.swift 同名注释——这个文件也被 ci.yml 的 flat swiftc
    18	// parity-runner 步骤直接编译，那条路径下没有独立的 D2Generated module。
    19	#if canImport(D2Generated)
    20	import D2Generated
    21	#endif
    22	
    23	typealias JSONObject = [String: Any]
    24	
    25	enum OpenclawWireError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
    26	    case invalidFrame(String)
    27	
    28	    var description: String {
    29	        switch self {
    30	        case .invalidFrame(let s): return "invalid wire frame: \(s)"
    31	        }
    32	    }
    33	}
    34	
    35	func encodeFrame(_ object: JSONObject) throws -> Data {
    36	    guard JSONSerialization.isValidJSONObject(object) else {
    37	        throw OpenclawWireError.invalidFrame("not a valid JSON object: \(object)")
    38	    }
    39	    return try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: object, options: [])
    40	}
    41	
    42	func decodeFrame(_ data: Data) throws -> JSONObject {
    43	    guard let obj = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data, options: []) as? JSONObject else {
    44	        throw OpenclawWireError.invalidFrame("top-level JSON is not an object")
    45	    }
    46	    return obj
    47	}
    48	
    49	/// F2（SG-5 rework）：把一个非文本 `Part`（`kind == .fileRef`，携带本地 `path`）编码成 openclaw
    50	/// `normalizeRpcAttachmentsToChatAttachments`（`gateway/server-methods/attachment-normalize.ts:
    51	/// 29-56`）期望的 wire 形状 `{content, mimeType?, fileName?}`。上一轮只发 `{mimeType,path}`——
    52	/// openclaw 那边 `.filter((a) => a.content)` 会把它直接丢弃（`server-methods.test.ts:2693-2699`
    53	/// 明确验证过这一点），发送方完全不知道附件已经静默消失。`content` 是文件内容的 base64 编码
    54	/// （`normalizeAttachmentContent` 接受字符串或 ArrayBuffer/typed-array 的 base64，这里直接给
    55	/// 字符串形态）。D1 `Part.path` 的文件系统坐标空间本身未裁决（D2 v3 §9.2 第 7 条/F-15 开放项）——
    56	/// 这里"读取本地路径、编码成 content"是 kernel-client 自己的合理转换，不是对某个已验证 openclaw
    57	/// schema 的字面翻译。抽成独立的 free function（不是 actor 方法）方便 frame-replay 单测直接调用，
    58	/// 不需要搭一个真实 WS 连接。
    59	func encodeAttachmentForWire(_ part: Part) -> JSONObject? {
    60	    guard let path = part.path else { return nil }
    61	    guard let data = FileManager.default.contents(atPath: path) else {
    62	        // 读不到文件——诚实跳过这一个 attachment，不编造 content，也不让整个 send() 失败。
    63	        return nil
    64	    }
    65	    var obj: JSONObject = ["content": data.base64EncodedString()]
    66	    if let mime = part.mimeType { obj["mimeType"] = mime }
    67	    obj["fileName"] = (path as NSString).lastPathComponent
    68	    return obj
    69	}
    70	
    71	/// F7（CRITICAL，SG-5 rework）：递归脱敏的敏感字段名判定——按 camelCase/snake_case 拆出的**整词**
    72	/// 匹配，不是裸子串匹配。上一轮 `prettyPrint` 把每一帧原样打印，`connect` 请求的
    73	/// `params.auth.token`（共享密钥凭证）会跟着一起进 stdout（可被 CI artifact、终端录屏、支持工单等
    74	/// 渠道泄漏），这是对抗审 T-044 判定的 CRITICAL 缺陷。命中即把整个字段值替换成 `"***REDACTED***"`
    75	/// ——不管原值是字符串/数字/嵌套对象，都不放过（嵌套对象整体替换是有意为之：与其精确挑出对象内部
    76	/// 哪个字段敏感，不如把整个已知敏感的容器打码，避免遗漏同一容器里未来新增的其它凭证字段）。
    77	///
    78	/// **M4 rework（收 T-045 codex 确认性再审复现）**：上一轮"整词匹配"本身只覆盖了单数敏感词，
    79	/// `credentials`/`apiKeys`/`secrets` 这些真实 openclaw payload 里常见的**复数**写法——整个 key
    80	/// 就是这一个词（没有 camelCase 边界可分词），永远不等于单数形式，因此完全漏报（凭证泄漏，
    81	/// REPRO `credentials`/`apiKeys` 见 FrameReplayTests.swift）。同时 `token` 是本轮唯一有歧义的
    82	/// 词：它既出现在真凭证字段（`authToken`/`apiToken`/裸 `auth.token`），也出现在纯粹的"用量计数"
    83	/// 字段（`contextTokens`/`tokenBudget`/`inputTokens`/`outputTokens`）——继续用"token 是不是整词
    84	/// 命中"这一个维度已经不够精确，需要看它的**相邻词**才能判断，这正是"更精确的键语义,不是裸子串"
    85	/// 的具体落地：
    86	///  1. 无歧义凭证词（`auth`/`authorization`/`secret`/`password`/`credential`，含常见复数，去掉
    87	///     末尾单个 `s` 再比较）——整词命中即敏感，不需要看上下文。
    88	///  2. `apiKey`/`apiKeys` 复合词——`api` 后紧跟 `key`/`keys` 才算敏感（不能把裸 `key` 单独列为
    89	///     敏感词，openclaw session key 等大量字段就叫 `key`，不是凭证）。
    90	///  3. `token`/`tokens`——裸字段（key 本身就是这一个词）或与 `auth`/`api` 复合（`authToken(s)`/
    91	///     `apiToken(s)`）视为敏感；与已知的计数类限定词（`context`/`input`/`output`/`total`/`max`/
    92	///     `budget`/`count`/`limit`/`usage`/`remaining`）相邻则明确排除，不脱敏——这些正是真实样本里
    93	///     观察到的 token 用量诊断字段，不是凭证。未知限定词默认落回敏感（安全的一侧：宁可多脱敏一个
    94	///     没见过的字段，也不能漏报真凭证）。
    95	private let unambiguousSensitiveSingulars: Set<String> = [
    96	    "auth", "authorization", "secret", "password", "credential",
    97	]
    98	private let tokenCountingQualifiers: Set<String> = [
    99	    "context", "input", "output", "total", "max", "budget", "count", "limit", "usage", "remaining",
   100	]
   101	
   102	/// 把一个 camelCase/snake_case/kebab-case 的 key 拆成小写单词列表——`"contextTokens"` ->
   103	/// `["context","tokens"]`，`"authToken"` -> `["auth","token"]`，`"api_key"` -> `["api","key"]`。
   104	private func lowercasedWords(_ key: String) -> [String] {
   105	    var words: [String] = []
   106	    var current = ""
   107	    for char in key {
   108	        if char == "_" || char == "-" {
   109	            if !current.isEmpty { words.append(current); current = "" }
   110	            continue
   111	        }
   112	        if char.isUppercase, !current.isEmpty {
   113	            words.append(current)
   114	            current = String(char).lowercased()
   115	        } else {
   116	            current.append(Character(char.lowercased()))
   117	        }
   118	    }
   119	    if !current.isEmpty { words.append(current) }
   120	    return words
   121	}
   122	
   123	/// 简单的英语复数去除——只处理"末尾加 s"这一种最常见形态（`credentials` -> `credential`，
   124	/// `secrets` -> `secret`）。这个项目的敏感词表本身都是规则复数，不需要处理不规则变形。
   125	private func singularized(_ word: String) -> String {
   126	    word.hasSuffix("s") && word.count > 1 ? String(word.dropLast()) : word
   127	}
   128	
   129	private func isSensitiveKey(_ key: String) -> Bool {
   130	    let words = lowercasedWords(key)
   131	
   132	    // ① 无歧义凭证词（含复数）——整词命中（去掉可能的末尾 "s" 再比较）。
   133	    if words.contains(where: { unambiguousSensitiveSingulars.contains(singularized($0)) }) {
   134	        return true
   135	    }
   136	
   137	    // ② apiKey/apiKeys 复合词——"api" 后紧跟 "key"/"keys" 才算敏感。
   138	    for i in 0..<words.count where words[i] == "api" && i + 1 < words.count {
   139	        if singularized(words[i + 1]) == "key" { return true }
   140	    }
   141	
   142	    // ③ token/tokens——裸字段或与 auth/api 复合视为敏感；与计数类限定词相邻则明确排除（诚实保留
   143	    // 这些真实的用量诊断字段，不误伤）。
   144	    for (i, word) in words.enumerated() where singularized(word) == "token" {
   145	        let hasCountingNeighbor =
   146	            (i > 0 && tokenCountingQualifiers.contains(words[i - 1])) ||
   147	            (i + 1 < words.count && tokenCountingQualifiers.contains(words[i + 1]))
   148	        if hasCountingNeighbor { continue } // 明确排除：token 计数字段，不脱敏
   149	        return true // 裸 token(s) 或与其它未知限定词复合——默认敏感（安全的一侧）
   150	    }
   151	
   152	    return false
   153	}
   154	
   155	/// 递归构造一份脱敏副本，供日志/打印使用——原始 `object`/嵌套字典/数组本身不被修改（这是"打印前的
   156	/// 只读转换"，不影响实际发给 openclaw 的请求内容）。
   157	func redactedCopy(_ value: Any) -> Any {
   158	    if let dict = value as? JSONObject {
   159	        var out: JSONObject = [:]
   160	        for (key, nested) in dict {
   161	            out[key] = isSensitiveKey(key) ? "***REDACTED***" : redactedCopy(nested)
   162	        }
   163	        return out
   164	    }
   165	    if let array = value as? [Any] {
   166	        return array.map { redactedCopy($0) }
   167	    }
   168	    return value
   169	}
   170	
   171	/// 把收发的每一帧打印出来——这是本轮 SG-4 的验收铁证要求（"把每步的响应/事件打印出来"），不是调试
   172	/// 脚手架，是交付物本身的一部分。**F7 rework**：打印前统一走 `redactedCopy`，递归脱敏
   173	/// auth/token/secret 等凭证字段——这是唯一的调用路径（`OpenclawGatewayKernelClient` 里所有
   174	/// `prettyPrint(...)` 调用点都不需要各自记得脱敏），content 类字段（消息正文/工具输出/审批
   175	/// payload）默认随这条统一路径打印，不再单独提供一个"不脱敏"的旁路。
   176	func prettyPrint(_ label: String, _ object: JSONObject) {
   177	    let safeObject = (redactedCopy(object) as? JSONObject) ?? object
   178	    let data = (try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: safeObject, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys])) ?? Data()
   179	    let text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) ?? "<unprintable>"
   180	    print("\n--- \(label) ---\n\(text)")
   181	}

   185	//
   186	// `OpenclawGatewayKernelClient.handleSessionMessageEvent`/`handleAgentEvent`/
   187	// `handleSessionApprovalEvent`/`handleShutdownEvent` 四个被消费 case 现在只有映射失败/旁路才调用
   188	// `prettyPrint`，成功产出 D2 事件的路径完全静默——rounds/0011 的运行日志因此一条承载 assistant 文本
   189	// 的帧都没留下，无法判断 content 形状、`index` 取值、delta 是否重复。下面这组函数是纯粹的取证工具：
   190	// 只读取/摘要已经发生的映射结果，不参与、不影响任何映射决策。调用方（`OpenclawGatewayKernelClient`
   191	// 里的 `traceWireDispatch`）由 `AGENT_KERNEL_WIRE_TRACE` 环境变量整体开关，未设置时这组函数不会被
   192	// 调用，行为与插桩之前逐字节一致。
   193	
   194	/// 插桩总开关——未设置该环境变量时返回 nil，调用方必须整体跳过写入路径（这是"默认关闭"的唯一判断
   195	/// 点）。取值是 trace 文件的完整路径。
   196	func wireTraceEnabledPath() -> String? {
   197	    ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["AGENT_KERNEL_WIRE_TRACE"]
   198	}
   199	
   200	/// 把一条 JSON 对象以 JSON Lines 形式追加写入 `path`——每次调用新开文件句柄、写完即关（这是低频的
   201	/// 诊断路径，跟着真实事件到达节奏走，不值得为此长期持有一个跨 actor 方法调用的文件句柄，也避免进程
   202	/// 异常退出时数据留在未 flush 的句柄里）。`path` 不存在时先创建空文件。写入失败（无效 JSON/无权限等）
   203	/// 一律诚实跳过，不抛错、不影响调用方——这是取证工具，不能反过来影响被观察的主路径。
   204	func appendWireTraceLine(_ record: JSONObject, toPath path: String) {
   205	    guard JSONSerialization.isValidJSONObject(record),
   206	          let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: record, options: [.sortedKeys]) else {
   207	        return
   208	    }
   209	    var line = data
   210	    line.append(0x0A)
   211	    let fm = FileManager.default
   212	    if !fm.fileExists(atPath: path) {
   213	        fm.createFile(atPath: path, contents: nil)
   214	    }
   215	    guard let handle = FileHandle(forWritingAtPath: path) else { return }
   216	    defer { try? handle.close() }
   217	    handle.seekToEndOfFile()
   218	    handle.write(line)
   219	}
   220	
   221	/// 把一个已经产出的 D2 `EventMessageUnion` 摘成可写盘的 JSON 安全字典：11 变体共有的
   222	/// `wireType`/`seq`/`runID`，`messageDelta` 额外带上**完整、不截断**的 `payload.index`/
   223	/// `payload.delta`——这正是本轮 scope-lock ① 要查的两个字段（index 取值 + delta 文本是否重复）。
   224	/// 这些字段来自我们自己的 D2 映射输出（不是 wire 上的原始任意字段），契约里没有给它们留下承载凭证的
   225	/// 通道，因此不需要再走一次 `redactedCopy`——本文件里只有 `wireFrame`（原始 wire JSON）那一份需要
   226	/// 脱敏，见 `OpenclawGatewayKernelClient.buildWireTraceRecord`。
   227	func wireTraceEventSummary(_ event: EventMessageUnion) -> JSONObject {
   228	    func runIDField(_ value: String?) -> Any { value ?? NSNull() }
   229	    var out: JSONObject = ["wireType": event.wireType]
   230	    switch event {
   231	    case .messageDelta(let e):
   232	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   233	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   234	        out["payload"] = ["index": e.payload.index, "delta": e.payload.delta,
   235	                       // rounds/0012 ①' 新增：分组键改用 messageID 后，trace 必须能看见它，
   236	                       // 否则 live 验证读不到该字段会被误判成「映射没传过来」（本轮真踩过一次）。
   237	                       "messageID": e.payload.messageID ?? NSNull()]
   238	    case .thinking(let e):
   239	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   240	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   241	    case .toolCall(let e):
   242	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   243	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   244	    case .toolResult(let e):
   245	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   246	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   247	    case .approvalRequest(let e):
   248	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   249	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   250	    case .error(let e):
   251	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   252	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   253	    case .turnComplete(let e):
   254	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   255	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   256	    case .sessionEnd(let e):
   257	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   258	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   259	    case .capabilityChanged(let e):
   260	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   261	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   262	    case .operationCompleted(let e):
   263	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   264	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   265	    case .approvalBufferResolved(let e):
   266	        out["seq"] = e.seq
   267	        out["runID"] = runIDField(e.runID)
   268	    }
   269	    return out
   270	}
   271	
   272	/// `produced` 为空时的便利摘要——只是把已经在 `payload` 里的相关字段单独摘出来，方便脚本/人眼不用
   273	/// 逐层展开整份帧；不是我们自己推断出的解释，帧本身才是权威来源（找不到就诚实返回 nil，不编造）。
   274	/// 逐 dispatch case 关注点不同：`session.message` 看 `message.role`（`EventMapping.swift:172-178`
   275	/// 的过滤条件——非 assistant 角色不产出事件）；`agent` 看 `stream`/`data.phase`（`handleAgentEvent`
   276	/// 的 `default: break` 与 `lifecycle` phase 过滤都在这两个字段上判断）；`session.approval` 看
   277	/// `phase`（只有 `pending` 会继续处理，`terminal` 分支已有 `prettyPrint` 记录跳过原因）；`shutdown`
   278	/// 没有已知的"0 事件但需要解释"场景，如实返回 nil。
   279	func wireTraceEmptyHint(eventName: String, payload: JSONObject?) -> JSONObject? {
   280	    switch eventName {
   281	    case "session.message":
   282	        guard let role = (payload?["message"] as? JSONObject)?["role"] else { return nil }
   283	        return ["message.role": role]
   284	    case "agent":
   285	        var hint: JSONObject = [:]
   286	        if let stream = payload?["stream"] { hint["stream"] = stream }
   287	        if let phase = (payload?["data"] as? JSONObject)?["phase"] { hint["data.phase"] = phase }
   288	        return hint.isEmpty ? nil : hint
   289	    case "session.approval":
   290	        guard let phase = payload?["phase"] else { return nil }
   291	        return ["phase": phase]
   292	    default:
   293	        return nil
   294	    }
   295	}

    18	function resolveSessionMessageSubscriptionKey(params: {
    19	  canonicalKey: string;
    20	  agentId?: string;
    21	  defaultAgentId?: string;
    22	}): string {
    23	  const agentId = params.agentId
    24	    ? normalizeAgentId(params.agentId)
    25	    : params.canonicalKey === "global" && params.defaultAgentId
    26	      ? normalizeAgentId(params.defaultAgentId)
    27	      : undefined;
    28	  // Global session message subscriptions need per-agent channels to avoid cross-agent fanout.
    29	  return params.canonicalKey === "global" && agentId
    30	    ? `agent:${agentId}:global`
    31	    : params.canonicalKey;
    32	}

    49	/** Return the wall-clock timestamp used by maintenance TTL pruning for both legacy and structured markers. */

    51	  return typeof marker === "number" ? marker : marker.abortedAtMs;

    53	
    54	/**
    55	 * Return whether an abort marker should suppress events for the given chat run registration.
    56	 * Structured markers compare the monotonic sequence first so same-millisecond aborts stay ordered;
    57	 * legacy numeric markers fall back to timestamp comparison, and a missing entry preserves old suppress-on-presence behavior.
    58	 */
    59	export function isChatAbortMarkerCurrent(
    60	  marker: ChatAbortMarker | undefined,
    61	  entry?: Pick<ChatRunEntry, "registeredAtMs" | "registeredSequence">,
    62	): boolean {
    63	  if (marker === undefined) {
    64	    return false;
    65	  }
    66	  if (!entry) {
    67	    return true;
    68	  }
    69	  if (typeof marker !== "number" && typeof entry.registeredSequence === "number") {
    70	    return marker.sequence >= entry.registeredSequence;
    71	  }
    72	  if (typeof entry.registeredAtMs !== "number") {
    73	    return true;
    74	  }
    75	  const abortedAtMs = typeof marker === "number" ? marker : marker.abortedAtMs;
    76	  return abortedAtMs >= entry.registeredAtMs;
    77	}

    90	export type ChatRunRegistry = {
    91	  add: (sessionId: string, entry: ChatRunRegistration) => void;
    92	  peek: (sessionId: string) => ChatRunEntry | undefined;
    93	  shift: (sessionId: string) => ChatRunEntry | undefined;
    94	  remove: (sessionId: string, clientRunId: string, sessionKey?: string) => ChatRunEntry | undefined;
    95	  clear: () => void;
    96	};

    98	/** Create the FIFO registry that maps session IDs to active chat runs. */
    99	export function createChatRunRegistry(): ChatRunRegistry {
   100	  const chatRunSessions = new Map<string, ChatRunEntry[]>();
   101	
   102	  const add = (sessionId: string, entry: ChatRunRegistration) => {
   103	    const registeredEntry = createChatRunEntry(entry);
   104	    const queue = chatRunSessions.get(sessionId);
   105	    if (queue) {
   106	      queue.push(registeredEntry);
   107	    } else {
   108	      chatRunSessions.set(sessionId, [registeredEntry]);
   109	    }
   110	  };
   111	
   112	  const peek = (sessionId: string) => chatRunSessions.get(sessionId)?.[0];
   113	
   114	  const shift = (sessionId: string) => {
   115	    const queue = chatRunSessions.get(sessionId);
   116	    if (!queue || queue.length === 0) {
   117	      return undefined;
   118	    }
   119	    const entry = queue.shift();
   120	    if (!queue.length) {
   121	      chatRunSessions.delete(sessionId);
   122	    }
   123	    return entry;
   124	  };
   125	
   126	  const remove = (sessionId: string, clientRunId: string, sessionKey?: string) => {
   127	    const queue = chatRunSessions.get(sessionId);
   128	    if (!queue || queue.length === 0) {
   129	      return undefined;
   130	    }
   131	    const idx = queue.findIndex(
   132	      (entry) =>
   133	        entry.clientRunId === clientRunId && (sessionKey ? entry.sessionKey === sessionKey : true),
   134	    );
   135	    if (idx < 0) {
   136	      return undefined;
   137	    }
   138	    const [entry] = queue.splice(idx, 1);
   139	    if (!queue.length) {
   140	      chatRunSessions.delete(sessionId);
   141	    }
   142	    return entry;
   143	  };
   144	
   145	  const clear = () => {
   146	    chatRunSessions.clear();
   147	  };
   148	
   149	  return { add, peek, shift, remove, clear };
   150	}

  1286	    const previous = presenceWatchedSessions(connId);
  1287	    const rollback = sessionMessageSubscribers.subscribe(connId, sessionKey, options);
  1288	    updateWatchedSessionsPresence(connId, previous);
  1289	    if (!rollback) {
  1290	      return undefined;
  1291	    }
  1292	    const rollbackPresence = (() => {
  1293	      const rollbackPrevious = presenceWatchedSessions(connId);
  1294	      rollback();
  1295	      updateWatchedSessionsPresence(connId, rollbackPrevious);
  1296	    }) as NonNullable<ReturnType<GatewayRequestContext["subscribeSessionMessageEvents"]>>;
  1297	    rollbackPresence.commit = () => rollback.commit();
  1298	    return rollbackPresence;
  1299	  };
  1300	  const unsubscribeSessionMessageEvents: GatewayRequestContext["unsubscribeSessionMessageEvents"] =
  1301	    (connId, sessionKey) => {
  1302	      const previous = presenceWatchedSessions(connId);
  1303	      sessionMessageSubscribers.unsubscribe(connId, sessionKey);
  1304	      updateWatchedSessionsPresence(connId, previous);
  1305	    };
  1306	  const restartRecoveryCandidates = new Map<string, RestartRecoveryCandidate>();
  1307	  const { createGatewayNodeSessionRuntime } = await import("./server-node-session-runtime.js");
  1308	  const {
  1309	    nodeRegistry,
  1310	    nodePresenceTimers,

  1319	  } = createGatewayNodeSessionRuntime({
  1320	    broadcast,
   430	      method: "connect",
   431	      phase,
   432	    });
   433	    await sendFrame({
   434	      type: "res",
   435	      id: parsed.id,
   436	      ok: false,
   437	      error: errorShape(ErrorCodes.UNAVAILABLE, `connect unavailable during gateway ${operation}`, {
   438	        retryable: true,
   439	        retryAfterMs: GATEWAY_WORK_ADMISSION_RETRY_AFTER_MS,
   440	        details: {
   441	          method: "connect",
   442	          reason,
   443	          phase,
   444	        },
   445	      }),
   446	    }).catch(() => {});
   447	    queueMicrotask(() =>
   448	      close(GATEWAY_WORK_ADMISSION_CLOSE_CODE, `gateway ${operation} in progress`),
   449	    );
   450	    return true;
   451	  };
   452	
   453	  const handleIncomingMessage = async (data: RawData) => {
   454	    if (getClient()) {
   455	      await handleMessage(data);
   456	      return;
   457	    }
   458	    const admission = tryBeginGatewayRootWorkAdmission();
   459	    if (!admission) {
   460	      if (await rejectConnectForClosedAdmission(data)) {
   461	        return;
   462	      }
   463	      // Malformed pre-auth frames still use the established validation and
   464	      // close path; only a validated connect can cross into mutable work.
   465	      await handleMessage(data);
   466	      return;
   467	    }
   468	    try {
   469	      await admission.run(() => handleMessage(data));
   470	    } finally {
   471	      admission.release();
   472	    }
   473	  };
   474	
   475	  socket.on("message", (data) => {
   476	    void runWithDiagnosticTraceContext(createDiagnosticTraceContext(), () =>
   477	      handleIncomingMessage(data),
   478	    );
   479	  });
   480	}

    79	export function resolveTranscriptReadTarget(
    80	  scope: SessionTranscriptReadScope,
    81	): ResolvedTranscriptReadTarget {
    82	  const target = resolveSessionTranscriptReadTarget(scope);
    83	  const marker = parseSqliteSessionFileMarker(target.sessionFile);
    84	  const storePath = resolveConcreteReadStorePath(scope.storePath);
    85	  return {
    86	    agentId: target.agentId ?? marker?.agentId,
    87	    sessionFile: target.sessionFile,
    88	    sessionId: marker?.sessionId ?? target.sessionId,
    89	    ...(target.sessionKey ? { sessionKey: target.sessionKey } : {}),
    90	    ...((storePath ?? marker?.storePath) ? { storePath: storePath ?? marker?.storePath } : {}),
    91	  };
    92	}

    94	function resolveConcreteReadStorePath(storePath: string | undefined): string | undefined {
    95	  const trimmed = storePath?.trim();
    96	  if (!trimmed || trimmed === "(multiple)" || trimmed.includes("{agentId}")) {
    97	    return undefined;
    98	  }
    99	  return trimmed;
   100	}

   117	function readTranscriptRecordTimestampMs(event: Record<string, unknown>): number | undefined {
   118	  const raw = event.timestamp;
   119	  const timestampMs =
   120	    typeof raw === "string" ? Date.parse(raw) : typeof raw === "number" ? raw : Number.NaN;
   121	  return Number.isFinite(timestampMs) ? timestampMs : undefined;
   122	}

   124	function extractMessageRecord(
   125	  event: unknown,
   126	): { id?: string; message: unknown; recordTimestampMs?: number } | undefined {
   127	  if (!event || typeof event !== "object" || Array.isArray(event)) {
   128	    return undefined;
   129	  }
   130	  const record = event as { id?: unknown; message?: unknown };
   131	  if (record.message === undefined) {
   132	    return undefined;
   133	  }
   134	  const recordTimestampMs = readTranscriptRecordTimestampMs(event as Record<string, unknown>);
   135	  return {
   136	    ...(typeof record.id === "string" ? { id: record.id } : {}),
   137	    message: record.message,
   138	    ...(recordTimestampMs !== undefined ? { recordTimestampMs } : {}),
   139	  };
   140	}

   176	function normalizeRecentSqliteReadOptions(opts?: Partial<ReadRecentSessionMessagesOptions>) {
   177	  const maxMessages = Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts?.maxMessages ?? 0));
   178	  const maxBytes =
   179	    typeof opts?.maxBytes === "number" && Number.isFinite(opts.maxBytes)
   180	      ? Math.max(1024, Math.floor(opts.maxBytes))
   181	      : 8 * 1024 * 1024;
   182	  const defaultMaxLines = maxMessages * 20 + 20;
   183	  const maxLines =
   184	    typeof opts?.maxLines === "number" && Number.isFinite(opts.maxLines)
   185	      ? Math.max(maxMessages, Math.floor(opts.maxLines))
   186	      : defaultMaxLines;
   187	  return { maxMessages, maxBytes, maxLines };
   188	}

   234	function extractMessageRole(message: unknown): string | undefined {
   235	  return message && typeof message === "object" && !Array.isArray(message)
   236	    ? ((message as { role?: unknown }).role as string | undefined)
   237	    : undefined;

   239	
   240	function extractMessageText(message: unknown): string | null {
   241	  if (!message || typeof message !== "object" || Array.isArray(message)) {
   242	    return null;
   243	  }
   244	  const record = message as { content?: unknown; text?: unknown };
   245	  if (typeof record.content === "string") {
   246	    return record.content.trim() || null;
   247	  }
   248	  if (Array.isArray(record.content)) {
   249	    const text = record.content
   250	      .map((entry) =>
   251	        entry && typeof entry === "object" && typeof (entry as { text?: unknown }).text === "string"
   252	          ? (entry as { text: string }).text
   253	          : "",
   254	      )
   255	      .filter((part) => part.trim())
   256	      .join("\n")
   257	      .trim();
   258	    return text || null;
   259	  }
   260	  if (typeof record.text === "string") {
   261	    return record.text.trim() || null;
   262	  }
   263	  return null;
   264	}

   266	function readSqliteTitleFields(
   267	  target: ResolvedTranscriptReadTarget,
   268	  opts?: { includeInterSession?: boolean },
   269	): SessionTitleFields {
   270	  const messages = readSqliteMessagesSync(target);
   271	  const firstUser = messages.find((message) => {
   272	    if (extractMessageRole(message) !== "user") {

   277	      !hasInterSessionUserProvenance(message as { role?: unknown; provenance?: unknown })
   278	    );
   279	  });
   280	  const lastText = messages.toReversed().map(extractMessageText).find(Boolean) ?? null;
   281	  return {
   282	    firstUserMessage: firstUser ? extractMessageText(firstUser) : null,
   283	    lastMessagePreview: lastText,
   284	  };
   285	}

.harnessloop/goals/20260718-002-agent-app/goal.md-170-- **②C-3 已解（path①）**：session 级归因对两内核**均成立**——**hermes 原生支持**，`gateway/platforms/api_server.py` 的 `model_routes` 特性原生支持 per-alias 独立 upstream `api_key`/`base_url`，是已生产可用的代码，**零改动**；若坚持走 `hermes acp` stdio 传输则需一个 <50 行的小 patch（接线已有的 `set_config_option`→`resolve_runtime_provider(explicit_api_key=,explicit_base_url=)` 通道，不改协议 schema）。**openclaw 不原生**，需一次**中等量级 patch**——`resolveMergedModelProviderConfig(config, provider)`（`src/config/model-provider-config.ts:132-137`）函数签名本身排除按 session 差异化解析凭证，`sessions.create`/`sessions.patch` 公开 RPC 请求 schema 均无凭证字段，即便通过官方 Plugin SDK（`ProviderPrepareRuntimeAuthContext`）扩展也拿不到 session 上下文——这是**架构性缺口**，但底层原语（具名 auth profile 存储 + 单值 `SessionEntry.authProfileOverride` 会话指针）已经存在，缺的是"把这条内部通道接到公开 gateway RPC 并放开写权限"这一段。design/architecture wiki 已同步收口：`kernel/kernel-ecosystem-facts.md` 新增「PRE-① 源码级核验」节、`architecture/d6-newapi-integration.md` §2.2/§7 v3 收口（默认目标由 path②改为 path①）、`product/d5-4-cost-usage.md` §2.3/§6 更新、`app/contracts/d3/openapi.yaml`+README 三组"待 PRE-① C-3 裁定"端点裁定为 session 级。
.harnessloop/goals/20260718-002-agent-app/goal.md-171-- **③openclaw/hermes steer 事实核验完成**：T-009 对 openclaw `sessions.steer`=abort+resend（hard interrupt-and-restart，非同 run 无损注入）的判定，经本轮真源码逐行核对（`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-messaging.ts`、`ui/src/pages/chat/chat-command-executor.ts` 等），**7 条断言 6 条属实、0 条推翻**，D1 v3.x 起对 T-009 的采纳无需回退。同时**发现 hermes 有原生 soft steer `AIAgent.steer()`**（`run_agent.py:2899-2933`，横跨 CLI/`gateway/run.py` Gateway/`acp_adapter/server.py` ACP 三个入口的一等公民能力，非 ACP 专属 hack）——**推翻 [[d1-kernelport-spec-v3-5]] INV-5"hermes ACP 只有 cancel、无 soft 对应，interrupt(mode:'steer') 在 hermes 上不受支持必须 reject"这一假设**。D1 v3.5 §11 C-5 本就为此预留了条件放宽规则（"若确认存在：`capabilities().interruptModes` 对 hermes 放宽为包含 `'steer'`，不视为对本 spec 的推翻"）——本轮源码核验的结果正是"确认存在"，按 D1 自身规则应触发这条放宽，且**不需要改 hermes 一行代码**，只需 KernelPort 适配器把 `interrupt(session,{mode:'steer',text})` 映射为"向 ACP 发一条 `/steer <text>` 的 `prompt()` 调用"。**D1 flag（待修正，本轮不动 D1 spec 正文）**：见下方⑥。
.harnessloop/goals/20260718-002-agent-app/goal.md:172:- **④剩纯 runtime 项，改列"待构建运行内核后探针"**：C-1（openclaw soft `chat.send`+`queueMode:"steer"` 精确 ack/结果信号语义——源码只证实路径存在，未逐行核对内部 `queued` 三态枚举细节，PRE-1 仍需真实运行时观测）、hermes ACP `session/load` 历史 replay 可靠性（本轮新发现的 runtime 待验项，源码只证明"存在显式降级路径"，高延迟/大历史场景的真实退化边界只能靠真实大会话做一次 live probe，见 `research/pre1-hermes-source-conformance.md` §1.7 项 17）——均**不是源码核验能回答的问题**，改列"待 SG-4（Mac 最小壳打通 `createSession`/`subscribe`）交付、本项目自建运行内核就绪后现场探针"，而非此前笼统的"待用户安排环境"；C-4（openclaw hard abort error 信号，PRE-3）同样是纯 runtime 项，维持既有 blocked 状态不变，未受本轮核验影响。详见 `goal-breakdown.md`「实现阶段（RA-L5 / IMPL）议程」PRE-1/PRE-3/新增 PRE-7 三行状态更新。
.harnessloop/goals/20260718-002-agent-app/goal.md-173-- **⑤新增实现任务（SG-6/SG-7）**：`goal-breakdown.md` 新增两个开发子目标承接 C-3 patch 落地——**SG-6：openclaw per-session 凭证 patch**（中等量级：扩展 gateway RPC schema 新增可写凭证字段 + 新增受控的运行时 profile 铸造入口（安全评审焦点：谁可调用、apiKey 是否回显/落盘、profile 上限、过期回收）+ Plugin SDK `ProviderPrepareRuntimeAuthContext` 加 `sessionId` 字段（新增字段+兼容期，不破坏既有契约）；submodule `kernels/openclaw` 作为 fork 追踪上游变更）；**SG-7：hermes per-session key 接线**（<50 行小 patch，或直接采用 `api_server`/`model_routes` 零改动路径，二选一）。
.harnessloop/goals/20260718-002-agent-app/goal.md-174-- **⑥Flag（D1 待修正，非本轮范围）**：hermes 原生支持 soft steer 一事，被源码证伪了 [[d1-kernelport-spec-v3-5]] INV-5"hermes 无 steer"的假设——**D1 需要一次新的局部修订**（capability-expanding，扩大能力声明而非收窄，按 D1 既有"能力协商模型天然支持的正常扩展"规则走，不需要重新走完整双轨对抗评审），把 `capabilities().interruptModes` 对 hermes 放宽为包含 `'steer'`、`interrupt(mode:'steer')` 不再对 hermes 恒 reject，映射为"向 ACP 发一条 `/steer <text>` 的 `prompt()` 调用（仅 `state.is_running` 时才是真软注入，空闲时按降级而非拒绝分类）"。**本轮明确不改 D1 spec 正文**——由主会话另行处理，作为独立设计任务；本条 flag 落点：`research/pre1-hermes-source-conformance.md` §1.3、`kernel-ecosystem-facts.md`「PRE-① 源码级核验」节、`architecture/d6-newapi-integration.md` §8 D1 依赖行。
