     1	# Contributing to OpenClaw
     2	
     3	Welcome to the lobster tank! 🦞
     4	
     5	## Quick Links
     6	
     7	- **GitHub:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw
     8	- **Vision:** [`VISION.md`](VISION.md)
     9	- **Discord:** https://discord.gg/clawd
    10	- **X/Twitter:** [@openclaw](https://x.com/openclaw)
    11	
    12	## Maintainers
    13	
    14	The current OpenClaw Foundation team and Core Maintainers are listed on the
    15	OpenClaw people page: https://www.openclaw.org/people
    16	
    17	## How to Contribute
    18	
    19	1. **Bugs & small fixes** → Open a PR!
    20	2. **New features / architecture** → Start a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/new/choose) or ask in Discord first. Most features are not accepted and should be third party plugins instead using our plugin SDK.
    21	3. **Refactor-only PRs** → Don't open a PR. We are not accepting refactor-only changes unless a maintainer explicitly asks for them as part of a concrete fix.
    22	4. **Test/CI-only PRs for known `main` failures** → Don't open a PR. The Maintainer team is already tracking those failures, and PRs that only tweak tests or CI to chase them will be closed unless they are required to validate a new fix.
    23	5. **Questions** → Discord [#help](https://discord.com/channels/1456350064065904867/1459642797895319552) / [#users-helping-users](https://discord.com/channels/1456350064065904867/1459007081603403828)
    24	
    25	## Issue, PR, and Contact Routing
    26	
    27	Start from this routing map before creating GitHub items:
    28	
    29	| Situation                                                | Use                                                                                                                                                                                  | Required evidence                                                                                                   |
    30	| -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
    31	| Product bug, regression, crash, or behavior defect       | [Bug report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)                                                                                                | Repro steps, expected vs actual behavior, version, OS, model/provider route when relevant, logs/screenshots, impact |
    32	| Documentation bug or missing/contradictory docs          | [Docs bug report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/new?template=docs_bug_report.yml)                                                                                      | Affected docs path or URL, verification steps, expected docs content, actual docs content, impact, evidence         |
    33	| New feature, architecture change, or product improvement | [Feature request](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) or Discord first                                                                     | Problem, proposed solution, alternatives, impact, examples or prior art                                             |
    34	| Onboarding, setup help, or general support question      | Discord [#help](https://discord.com/channels/1456350064065904867/1459642797895319552) / [#users-helping-users](https://discord.com/channels/1456350064065904867/1459007081603403828) | Do not open a GitHub issue unless there is a concrete product defect or docs gap                                    |
    35	| Security vulnerability                                   | See [Report a Vulnerability](#report-a-vulnerability) below                                                                                                                          | Do not file public issues for private security reports                                                              |
    36	| PR for an existing or newly filed issue                  | Use the [PR template](.github/pull_request_template.md)                                                                                                                              | Visible `Closes #<issue>` or `Related: #<issue>`, problem, shipped solution, user impact, validation evidence       |
    37	
    38	For agent-authored or otherwise non-trivial work, create or reuse the issue first, then open the PR against it. Bugs and very small fixes may go straight to PR, but still link existing context when it exists and fill out the PR template.
    39	
    40	Do not guess who to tag. Let issue forms, labels/automation, and `.github/CODEOWNERS` route the work. Mention a maintainer only when an owned path or documented responsibility is directly relevant and you need a decision; otherwise rely on normal review. For coordinated change sets, ask in **#clawtributors** before opening more than the PR limit.
    41	
    42	## PR Limits
    43	
    44	We cap at **20 open PRs per author**. If you exceed this, the `r: too-many-prs` label is added and your PR is auto-closed. This is a hard limit.
    45	
    46	For coordinated change sets that genuinely need more than 20 PRs, join the **#clawtributors** channel in Discord and talk to maintainers first.
    47	
    48	## Before You PR
    49	
    50	- Use **Node 24.15+** for source checkouts when possible. OpenClaw also supports Node 22.22.3+ and Node 25.9+, but Node 23, Node 22 before 22.22.3, and Node 24 before 24.15 are below the repository engine floor and can fail before `pnpm` commands run. See [Node install guidance](docs/install/node.md) if your local version is too old.
    51	- Test locally with your OpenClaw instance
    52	- External PRs must describe the user, product, or operational problem in **What Problem This Solves** and include useful validation in **Evidence**. Focused tests, CI results, screenshots, recordings, terminal output, live observations, redacted logs, and artifact links all count. Reviewers will inspect the code, tests, and CI; use the PR body to explain intent and make validation easy to understand.
    53	- When ClawSweeper, Barnacle, or a maintainer asks for more context or evidence, edit the PR description instead of only replying in a new comment. Keep **What Problem This Solves**, **Why This Change Was Made**, **User Impact**, and **Evidence** current; a short comment can point reviewers to the update, but the PR body should remain the durable explanation for maintainers and bots.
    54	- Keep PRs takeover-ready: open them from a branch maintainers can push to. For fork PRs, leave GitHub's **Allow edits by maintainers** option enabled so maintainers can finish urgent fixes, changelog entries, or merge prep when needed. If GitHub shows **Allow edits and access to secrets by maintainers**, enable it only when that workflow/secrets access is acceptable and say so in the PR.
    55	- Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md` in contributor PRs. Maintainers or ClawSweeper add the changelog entry when landing user-facing changes.
    56	- Run tests: `pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test`
    57	- For iterative local commits, `scripts/committer --fast "message" <files...>` skips commit hooks. Only use it when you've already run equivalent targeted validation for the touched surface.
    58	- For extension/plugin changes, run the fast local lane first:
    59	  - `pnpm test:extension <extension-name>`
    60	  - `pnpm test:extension --list` to see valid extension ids
    61	  - If you changed shared plugin or channel surfaces, run `pnpm test:contracts`
    62	  - For targeted shared-surface work, use `pnpm test:contracts:channels` or `pnpm test:contracts:plugins`
    63	  - These commands also cover the shared seam/smoke files that the default unit lane skips
    64	  - If you changed broader runtime behavior, still run the relevant wider lanes (`pnpm test:extensions`, `pnpm test:channels`, or `pnpm test`) before asking for review
    65	- If you touched bundled-plugin boundaries in shared code, run the matching inventories:
    66	  - `node scripts/check-src-extension-import-boundary.mjs --json` for `src/**`
    67	  - `node scripts/check-sdk-package-extension-import-boundary.mjs --json` for `src/plugin-sdk/**` and `packages/**`
    68	  - `node scripts/check-test-helper-extension-import-boundary.mjs --json` for `test/helpers/**`
    69	- Shared test helpers must use `src/test-utils/bundled-plugin-public-surface.ts` instead of repo-relative `extensions/**` imports. Keep plugin-local deep mocks inside the owning bundled plugin package.
    70	- If you are using an AI coding agent with OpenClaw skills available, run the `autoreview` skill before opening or updating your PR. Address accepted/actionable findings before asking for review.
    71	- Do not submit refactor-only PRs unless a maintainer explicitly requested that refactor for an active fix or deliverable.
    72	- Do not submit test or CI-config fixes for failures already red on `main` CI. If a failure is already visible in the [main branch CI runs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions), it's a known issue the Maintainer team is tracking, and a PR that only addresses those failures will be closed automatically. If you spot a _new_ regression not yet shown in main CI, report it as an issue first.
    73	- Do not submit test-only PRs that just try to make known `main` CI failures pass. Test changes are acceptable when they are required to validate a new fix or cover new behavior in the same PR.
    74	- Ensure CI checks pass
    75	- Keep PRs focused (one thing per PR; do not mix unrelated concerns)
    76	- Describe what & why
    77	- **Include screenshots** — one showing the problem/before, one showing the fix/after (for UI or visual changes)
    78	- Use American English spelling and grammar in code, comments, docs, and UI strings
    79	- Do not edit files covered by `CODEOWNERS` security ownership unless a listed owner explicitly asked for the change or is already reviewing it with you. Treat those paths as restricted review surfaces, not opportunistic cleanup targets.
    80	
    81	## Review Conversations Are Author-Owned
    82	
    83	After your PR receives Barnacle, ClawSweeper, or maintainer feedback, read the [pull request review flow](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/pull-request-review-flow) for how to interpret rank-up moves, proof guidance, re-review requests, and review conversation follow-up.
    84	
    85	## Control UI Decorators
    86	
    87	The Control UI uses Lit with **legacy** decorators (current Rollup parsing does not support
    88	`accessor` fields required for standard decorators). When adding reactive fields, keep the
    89	legacy style:
    90	
    91	```ts
    92	@state() foo = "bar";
    93	@property({ type: Number }) count = 0;
    94	```
    95	
    96	The root `tsconfig.json` is configured for legacy decorators (`experimentalDecorators: true`)
    97	with `useDefineForClassFields: false`. Avoid flipping these unless you are also updating the UI
    98	build tooling to support standard decorators.
    99	
   100	## AI/Vibe-Coded PRs Welcome! 🤖
   101	
   102	Built with Codex, Claude, or other AI tools? **Awesome - just mark it!**
   103	
   104	Please include in your PR:
   105	
   106	- [ ] Mark as AI-assisted in the PR title or description
   107	- [ ] Include a concise **Evidence** section with the most useful validation. Reviewers will inspect the code, tests, and CI rather than relying on the PR body alone.
   108	- [ ] Include prompts or session logs if possible (super helpful!)
   109	- [ ] Confirm you understand what the code does
   110	- [ ] Run the `autoreview` skill when available and address accepted/actionable findings
   111	- [ ] Follow the [pull request review flow](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/pull-request-review-flow) after Barnacle, ClawSweeper, or maintainer feedback
   112	
   113	AI PRs are first-class citizens here. We just want transparency so reviewers know what to look for.
   114	
   115	## Current Focus & Roadmap 🗺
   116	
   117	We are currently prioritizing:
   118	
   119	- **Stability**: Fixing edge cases in channel connections (WhatsApp/Telegram).
   120	- **UX**: Improving the onboarding wizard and error messages.
   121	- **Skills**: For skill contributions, head to [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/) — the community hub for OpenClaw skills.
   122	- **Performance**: Optimizing token usage and compaction logic.
   123	
   124	Check the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues) for
   125	["good first issue"](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)
   126	labels. If none are open, pick a small docs or bug issue and leave a quick comment saying
   127	you'd like to work on it.
   128	
   129	## Maintainers
   130	
   131	We're selectively expanding the maintainer team.
   132	If you're an experienced contributor who wants to help shape OpenClaw's direction — whether through code, docs, or community — we'd like to hear from you.
   133	
   134	Being a maintainer is a responsibility, not an honorary title. We expect active, consistent involvement — triaging issues, reviewing PRs, and helping move the project forward.
   135	
   136	Still interested? Email contributing@openclaw.ai with:
   137	
   138	- Links to your PRs on OpenClaw (if you don't have any, start there first)
   139	- Links to open source projects you maintain or actively contribute to
   140	- Your GitHub, Discord, and X/Twitter handles
   141	- A brief intro: background, experience, and areas of interest
   142	- Languages you speak and where you're based
   143	- How much time you can realistically commit
   144	
   145	We welcome people across all skill sets — engineering, documentation, community management, and more.
   146	We review every human-only-written application carefully and add maintainers slowly and deliberately.
   147	Please allow a few weeks for a response.
   148	
   149	## Report a Vulnerability
   150	
   151	We take security reports seriously. Report vulnerabilities directly to the repository where the issue lives:
   152	
   153	- **Core CLI and gateway** — [openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw)
   154	- **macOS desktop app** — [openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) (apps/macos)
   155	- **iOS app** — [openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) (apps/ios)
   156	- **Android app** — [openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) (apps/android)
   157	- **ClawHub** — [openclaw/clawhub](https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub)
   158	- **Trust and threat model** — [openclaw/trust](https://github.com/openclaw/trust)
   159	
   160	For issues that don't fit a specific repo, or if you're unsure, email **security@openclaw.ai** and we'll route it.
   161	
   162	### Required in Reports
   163	
   164	1. **Title**
   165	2. **Severity Assessment**
   166	3. **Impact**
   167	4. **Affected Component**
   168	5. **Technical Reproduction**
   169	6. **Demonstrated Impact**
   170	7. **Environment**
   171	8. **Remediation Advice**
   172	
   173	Reports without reproduction steps, demonstrated impact, and remediation advice will be deprioritized. Given the volume of AI-generated scanner findings, we must ensure we're receiving vetted reports from researchers who understand the issues.

## Summary

只读复核确认：OpenClaw **没有覆盖 `session.message` 定向投递的完整无丢帧机制**，但主会话漏掉了非定向事件已有的 per-connection `EventFrame.seq`/gap 检测，以及可用于事后对账的历史读取能力。当前正确路径是显式修订 RAE-0001 条件③，并用历史快照对账强化受控 e2e；不应为本轮扩展 fork 或等待上游协议改造。若未来必须建设，最小方案应复用现有连接级 envelope `seq`，而不是新增 per-session/per-subscription 字段。

## Files touched

none（只读评审，未修改代码、文档或状态文件）

## Acceptance verification (4/4)

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Q1：检索 cursor/watermark/replay/gap/恢复机制 | PASS | `server-broadcast.ts:157-263`、`protocol-client.ts:546-552`、`server-session-events.ts:186-260`、`session-history-state.ts:84-152`、`session-transcript-runtime.ts:195-238` |
| Q2：三选一明确裁决 | PASS | **显式修改验收条件**，辅以客户端历史对账；不改判旧轮次 |
| Q3：给出条件建设方案 | PASS | 作用域、协议、兼容、重连、扇出和测试均见下 |
| Q4：上游/fork/第三路裁决 | PASS | **当前两者都不走，第三路优先**；上游未来先 issue，fork 仅产品化紧急兜底 |

### Q1：没有完整现成机制；主会话结论“窄义成立、论证不完整”

现有机制如下：

- Gateway 已有真正的投递域序号：`clientSeq` 按连接保存（`kernels/openclaw/src/gateway/server-broadcast.ts:157`），非定向广播每个客户端独立编号，慢消费者被跳过时仍占号（`:229-263`）。官方 TS 客户端会在缺号时触发 `onGap`（`packages/gateway-client/src/protocol-client.ts:546-552`），官方 Swift 客户端也有同等逻辑（`apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawKit/GatewayChannel.swift:1138-1153`）。

- 但 `session.message` 走 `broadcastToConnIds`（`server-session-events.ts:247-260`）。广播器对 targeted 事件明确令 `eventSeq = undefined`，且 `dropIfSlow` 时不推进序号（`server-broadcast.ts:242-263`）。因此这套现成 gap 检测恰好覆盖不到目标路径。

- `messageSeq` 确实只是 transcript 水位：无订阅者会在计算前直接返回（`server-session-events.ts:181-215`），同一 transcript 条目还可能产生重复实时帧。它不能作为投递计数。

- 注释中的 “cursor-compatible live history” 指向历史分页水位。`SessionHistorySseState` 的 cursor 返回的是 cursor **之前**的旧消息窗口（`session-history-state.ts:124-152`），不是从缺口向前重放 WS 帧。

- 另有真正支持 append-resume 的 opaque transcript cursor：`readSessionTranscriptRawDelta` / `readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta`（`src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime.ts:195-238`）。但这是内核内 Plugin SDK 的持久 transcript 读取能力，不是外部 gateway-client 的 WS 重放接口，也不证明某个订阅者收到了哪些帧。

- `sessions.messages.subscribe` 只有 approval 的 snapshot/replay；普通 `session.message` 没有 replay（`server-methods/sessions-subscriptions.ts:91-137`）。

所以 Q2–Q4 不作废。主会话“当前 kernel-client 无法仅靠现有 wire 序号断言 `session.message` 无丢失”成立；“不存在任何可利用的相邻机制”则不成立。

### Q2：选择“修改验收条件”，但不得只删掉丢帧要求

不建议建设序号，也不建议本项目主线修成可靠消息服务。原因：

- 单加序号只能检测 `dropIfSlow`，检测不到 `connIds.size === 0` 的订阅前丢失；后者还需要等待 subscribe ACK。
- 真正“不丢”需要 ACK、背压、持久重放和重连恢复，远超本轮验证范围。
- 修改第三方内核后再据此验收，会把“验证 OpenClaw 适配”悄悄变成“验证定制 fork”。

建议把条件③改为：

> 在本层可观察域内，D2 序号及 wire `messageSeq` 不乱序；受控新会话中，将收到的 assistant `session.message` 的 `(messageId, messageSeq)` 与运行结束后的权威 history 快照对账，确认预期消息全部出现。协议级、任意连接生命周期的无丢帧保证列为内核已知缺口。

对账可行的依据：实时帧同时携带 `messageId/messageSeq`（`server-session-events.ts:238-255`），历史读取也为消息附加相同 id/seq 元数据（`session-transcript-readers.ts:214-226`）。

必须保留破坏性反证：从 wire 集合删除一条 assistant 消息后，对账应变红。旧 rounds/0012 仍维持 fail；只有条件经显式修订、重新执行后，才能产生新 verdict。

### Q3：若未来建设，作用域必须是 connection incarnation

最小方案不是新增 payload 字段，而是让 targeted 事件也使用现有顶层 `EventFrame.seq`；该字段已经是 optional 协议字段（`packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/frames.ts:164-170`）。

具体形状：

- 作用域：一个 WebSocket 连接生命周期，即 `connId`/connection generation。
- 编号位置：完成权限、scope、target 过滤后，在检查慢消费者前分配；即使 `dropIfSlow` 跳过也推进计数。
- targeted 与 broadcast 共用同一连接序列。多个 session 在同一 socket 上本就是一个有序复用流；per-session 序列反而无法表达跨事件交错。
- 多订阅者各自编号；同一源事件在连接 A、B 上可以分别是 7、14。
- 重连建立新 epoch，序号从头开始；不得把新旧连接直接比较。
- 老客户端兼容：字段已经存在且可选，忽略它的客户端行为不变；现成官方客户端能直接触发 gap 回调。
- 订阅竞态必须配套修复：`send/stop` 应等待 subscribe RPC 成功响应，而非只等请求帧 dispatch。否则事件在注册订阅前被 early-return，任何连接序号都无从占号。
- gap 后恢复：session 消息重新读取 history；不可重放的临时 agent/approval 状态应清理并重新获取快照。若要求逐帧重放，还需另建带 resume token 的持久 ring/ledger，已经不是“小加一个字段”。

最低测试矩阵：

1. targeted 与 broadcast 交错时，每个接收连接序号连续。
2. 发给其他连接的 targeted 事件不消耗本连接序号。
3. targeted 慢消费者丢弃一帧，下一 heartbeat 产生 gap。
4. 两个订阅者收到独立序号。
5. 重连重置 epoch，不误报跨连接 gap。
6. 延迟 subscribe handler 时，send 等待 ACK，首条消息不丢。
7. 人为移除已编号 targeted 帧，TS/Swift gap 检测变红。
8. 旧客户端可继续解码和消费事件。

### Q4：当前不走上游 PR，也不扩 fork；第三路优先

- 上游：若未来产品化，先开 issue，给出 “targeted `dropIfSlow` 不占 `EventFrame.seq`，现有 `onGap` 因此失效” 的最小复现。OpenClaw 自身要求新特性/架构先讨论，且说明多数特性不会接受（`kernels/openclaw/CONTRIBUTING.md:17-22`）。新增 replay/新协议字段的接受概率低；复用已有 envelope `seq`、作为行为缺陷修复，现实概率明显更高，但仍应先取得维护者认可。

- Fork：当前 submodule 已固定到自有 `agent-app-persession` 分支（`.gitmodules:10-13`）。只读命令显示 fork 已在上游基线之上携带 4 个提交、7 个文件约 `+280/-9`；再叠协议语义会扩大每次升级的冲突和回归矩阵。submodule pin 能保证构建可复现，但不能消除长期 rebase 成本。

- 第三路：先让当前 Swift client 记录已有外层 `frame["seq"]`；它目前只分派 event，完全不读取该字段（`OpenclawGatewayKernelClient.swift:1288-1327`）。对 targeted `session.message`，用运行后 history 的 message id/seq 做受控对账。这不提供通用可靠传输，但足以给 RAE 一个有牙齿、可破坏验证且不要求 fork 协议扩展的判据。

任务 brief 中 [PR #118674](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118674) 的 OPEN 状态只说明上游排期不可控；该 PR 与投递序号无关，不能作为等待它或预测新协议 PR 会合入的依据。

## Decisions / deviations

- 将 PR #118674 的状态与时长视为任务 brief 的冻结事实；受限环境未能独立读取 GitHub PR API。
- 未运行会生成缓存或产物的测试；本任务为只读方案审查。
- 否决了“必须新增 per-subscription 字段”这一预设：若建设，应复用 per-connection envelope `seq`。

## Verdict

**PASS_WITH_NOTE**

四问均已给出可执行裁决；NOTE 是主会话漏报了现成的连接级 gap 机制和历史对账路径，但这些仍不足以直接证明当前 targeted WS 订阅无丢帧。

## Next recommendation

先起草并显式确认新的 RAE-0001 条件③，保持旧轮次 fail；随后增加“assistant messageId/history 对账 + 人为删帧变红”的独立验收任务。当前不要修改 OpenClaw fork，也不要以新的上游协议 PR 阻塞 L1 收口。
